news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Week 1 disaster: Dak Prescott's costly mistake and defensive issues (again)
news_mentions.body_text: east rutherford n j jerry jones acknowledged before the game that he was 34 anxious 34 and 34 nervous 34 about watching the dallas cowboys 39 season opener against the new york giants one of the last things he was probably concerned about was dak prescott the franchise quarterback was part of the biggest play sunday night at metlife stadium it wasn 39 t a good one his lone interception helped provide the giants with a spark that eventually turned into a 28 20 week 1 cowboys loss 34 that was crucial 34 prescott said 34 i was trying to throw the ball away the guy made a hell of a play i got to make sure that it 39 s out of bounds though i was surprised it 39 s one i want back obviously i think that was a huge point in the game 34 facing third and 5 with just under a minute left in the second quarter and the score tied 7 7 prescott was flushed out of the pocket drifting 17 yards behind the line of scrimmage when he threw off his back foot giants safety jevon holland made a sliding grab near the cowboys sideline new york scored six plays later taking a 14 7 lead into the halftime locker room the giants then received the second half kickoff and scored again 12 plays later 34 that was a big momentum swing 34 cowboys coach brian schottenheimer said of the interception the cowboys were never able to overcome that 21 7 deficit midway through the third quarter as they only had the ball for two possessions in the second half aside from the turnover prescott didn 39 t have a bad game the giants displayed a strong pass rush but he was never sacked he was accurate most of the night even when he wasn 39 t getting much help early from his top playmakers it was expected entering the season that with star wide receivers ceedee lamb and george pickens dallas would simply pick up where it left off a year ago as one of the nfl 39 s best offenses that didn 39 t happen sunday night pickens had two costly drops in the first half which was especially surprising because he was the cowboys 39 best training camp performer he didn 39 t have two drops all of camp but he had two on his first four targets against the giants the cowboys 39 top two offensive weapons had only 27 receiving yards in the first half with most of their big plays coming from drawing defensive pass interference calls pickens finished with only three catches for 28 yards lamb totaled five for 44 yards and a touchdown 34 it 39 ll get back to clicking 34 prescott said 34 those guys had some uncharacteristic drops i know that they 39 re upset about them immediately came and made a comment about them and they moved on as they should we 39 ll get back to it 34 if they don 39 t the season could quickly become a repeat of a year ago because the defense still has plenty of issues no one expected christian parker 39 s debut as defensive coordinator to go so poorly giants quarterback jaxson dart was outstanding completing 23 of 29 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing for 54 yards on 11 carries he never seemed rushed in his decision making as he constantly appeared to have all the answers to the test that 39 s concerning because that was a major issue for the cowboys a year ago under matt eberflus far too often opposing quarterbacks would have a career day against dallas 34 this defensive unit is really good 34 cowboys defensive tackle quinnen williams said 34 we got the guys to be accountable and get better 133 we can be better and we will be better 34 one of the biggest issues sunday night was how easily the giants were able to complete short passes into the flat for notable gains that clearly bothered schottenheimer 34 you got young players 34 he said 34 young player closes and jaxson dart boots and gets outside we don 39 t push three different times the f ing flat route excuse my language those are going to happen and we 39 re going to have to coach the young players better but when you play young players it 39 s part of the deal and they need to learn quickly 34 since trading micah parsons before the start of last season the cowboys have emphasized making roster moves that would help them stop the run the giants had little problem in that area however running 37 times for 165 yards and controlling the clock with relative ease it appears the cowboys have some quality pieces on defense most notably williams and rookie defensive back caleb downs but the overall talent looked thin sunday night there were notable weaknesses on all three levels 34 this is a humbling business 34 schottenheimer said 34 we got humbled tonight that 39 s what i told the guys we lost mile 1 of a 17 mile marathon 34 what prevents him from watching that performance and thinking the defense was similar to last season 34 every day we went against them in practice 34 schottenheimer responded 34 the defense we saw in practice was not what we saw tonight 34 one game is too soon to panic it 39 s realistic to think a team that doesn 39 t play its starters in the preseason could make a significant jump in week 2 but there was too much bad to not be somewhat concerned the offense has the weapons to put up points against any team but the absence of standout left guard tyler smith was felt against the giants particularly in the run game early 34 i 39 m still optimistic 34 prescott said 34 that doesn 39 t change our goals it doesn 39 t change how we feel about our team this is a marathon it 39 s a long season we 39 re going to respond 34 defensively the inside linebacker play wasn 39 t great and starting middle linebacker demarvion overshown left the game early with a hamstring injury starting safety malik hooker left with what is feared to be a fractured forearm physically the giants had the edge there wasn 39 t enough pass rush from the cowboys and there weren 39 t many opportunities where dart was forced to throw the ball into a risky space mentally new york made fewer costly errors overshown hit dart out of bounds early on a key play to get things going for the giants running back javonte williams uncharacteristically held the ball out to a defender as he was crossing the goal line late in the game leading to a taunting penalty that pushed back the point after attempt from brandon aubrey which he missed combine all of that and the recipe that beat the cowboys on sunday night will be copied going forward keep their talented offense on the sideline as much as possible establish the run game and put together long drives that eat up the majority of the clock the giants had the ball for more than 13 minutes longer than the cowboys many have been skeptical of those singing the cowboys 39 praises for how quietly things were during the offseason the vibe had been feeling different around the team for the first time in the last three years there was a lot of positive momentum but maybe this outcome just shows why jones was feeling so anxious an hour before kickoff sunday night 34 i know the way we approach things 34 prescott said 34 i know that our routine i know that our standard i know that the way we practice is the right way my message is echoing 39 don 39 t change don 39 t flinch don 39 t blink 39 this is a long year we have to stick together we 39 re hanging our hat on our brotherhood and that 39 s who we believe that we are so there 39 s no better time to show than after a loss 34 a little bit of adversity we got to make sure that we use it as a lesson 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane to miss several weeks with fractured wrist
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens receiver Ja'Kobi Lane suffered a fractured wrist in Sunday's win over the Colts and will miss several weeks.
news_mentions.body_text: ja 39 kobi lane s promising start with the baltimore ravens has hit a speed bump out of the gate lane suffered a fractured wrist in the ravens 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts and is expected to miss several weeks nfl network insiders mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported sunday night lane will undergo future testing to determine the full extent of the ailment it s a tough blow for lane and the ravens who also lost top wideout zay flowers to a hamstring injury in the victory rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury isn t considered serious lane s first nfl game saw him register one catch on three targets for 11 yards the ravens swooped on lane in the third round of the 2026 nfl draft and the usc product quickly grew buzz during the offseason and training camp work now he ll have to rebound from an injury and so too will the ravens devontez walker was inactive with a groin injury sunday and now with lane out for multiple weeks baltimore will need bigger contributions from lajohntay wester and chris moore from an already thin wr room the ravens 1 0 host the new orleans saints 0 1 on week 2 sunday

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray suffers concussion in first quarter of win over Packers
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Sunday's  39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers and did not return.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray suffered a concussion in sunday s 39 22 win over the green bay packers and did not return on a third and 7 scramble in the first quarter murray slid but took a big hit from packers defenders lukas van ness and javon bullard murray s helmet came off on the play and the veteran qb remained on the turf at u s bank stadium before eventually walking off under his own power and exiting to the locker room i have no update on how those evaluations have gone head coach kevin o connell said after the game we ll take it day by day and see how he comes in tomorrow o connell added that murray seemed to be doing well after the game but i wouldn t medically quote me on that bullard was flagged for unnecessary roughness on the play to prolong the vikings drive murray was just 11 plays into his debut with the vikings before exiting and went 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception carson wentz took over under center for minnesota going 12 of 19 for 133 yards with three touchdowns to lead the vikings to a comeback win

news_mentions.headline: Ravens RB Derrick Henry passes Marcus Allen for third on all-time rushing TD list
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens RB Derrick Henry rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of Sunday's win over the Indianapolis Colts to move into third all-time on the league's rushing TD list.
news_mentions.body_text: another season another year derrick henry appears set to defy father time the baltimore ravens running back rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of sunday s season opening 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts to move into third all time on the league s rushing td list he later added a third touchdown to cement another career day in his likely hall of fame career henry now has 125 career scores on the ground two ahead of hall of famer marcus allen 123 love marcus allen henry said after the game he s a great dude and for my name to be mentioned over his is an honor i m very grateful his record breaking score came in vintage henry fashion as he rumbled through the colts defense for an explosive 32 yard td to contribute to a 31 point first half for first year coach jesse minter henry finished with 144 yards on 24 carries as baltimore moved to 1 0

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Rams' Myles Garrett to undergo knee surgery, miss at least 4 games while on IR
news_mentions.description: Rams star defensive end Myles Garrett is set to undergo arthroscopic knee surgery and will be placed on injured reserve, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: myles garrett admitted he wasn t himself in thursday s loss to the san francisco 49ers now he ll be sidelined at least the next four weeks the los angeles rams pass rusher will undergo surgery on the knee that limited him during training camp and the season opener nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday garrett will head to injured reserve where he ll miss at least four games the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news following his offseason blockbuster trade from the cleveland browns garrett missed time due to a nagging knee injury the player and team both dismissed the issue as minor and suggested his absence was mostly maintenance however during thursday s season opener garrett clearly wasn t himself and admitted afterward that he was concerned about his knee during the game surely the 15 hour flight to and from australia didn t help the matter the reigning defensive player of the year generated a team high five qb pressures but earned zero sacks and zero tackles in the blowout loss losing garrett takes a bite out of the rams pass rush getting aaron donald who sat out week 1 on the field will be of some aid but losing garrett off the edge hurts the entire defense offenses won t have to worry about sending as many chips and helps that way for at least four games the rams face the giants broncos eagles and bills the next four weeks l a hosts the cardinals in week 6 the first game garrett would be eligible to return

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling out at least a month with ankle sprain
news_mentions.description: The 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season. First-year receiver De'Zhaun Stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle.
news_mentions.body_text: the 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season first year receiver de 39 zhaun stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday per sources stribling is still seeking medical opinions and surgery is an option though not currently planned rapoport added the rookie wr suffered the injury in the first quarter of the 49ers season opening win over the rams in melbourne australia this past week stribling left the game in the second quarter without a target on 21 snaps san francisco selected stribling with the first pick of the second round of the 2026 nfl draft its first overall selection stribling s setback is the 49ers latest significant injury just as they were getting healthier ricky pearsall is already out for the season having undergone knee surgery in august defensive tackle alfred collins tore his patellar tendon during practice in australia and tight end jake tonges left the rams game with a knee injury george kittle and nick bosa just returned to game action this week from their 2025 season ending injuries without the rookie in brock purdy s receiving corps demarcus robinson deebo samuel and jacob cowing are slated for more action than expected early on newcomer mike evans led all 49ers wideouts with 48 snaps against l a followed by robinson 40 and samuel 26 san francisco 1 0 hosts the dolphins in its home opener on sept 20 at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Broncos vs. Chiefs: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 1 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs.
news_mentions.body_text: monday night football opens up with a doozy pitting the reigning afc west champions against the squad that dominated the division with nine straight first place finishes before finally losing the throne how will the broncos fare at long last being chased rather than acting as the chasers denver topped the afc west in 2025 and finished as the top seed in the conference by going 14 3 despite their mighty record they ll kick off the new campaign fighting against a regression narrative the broncos had 11 one possession wins last year tying the 2024 chiefs and 2022 vikings two clubs that would go on to miss the playoffs the following season for the most in nfl history their opponents the chiefs will be looking to pick themselves back up after a shocking six win campaign that marked their first losing season since 2012 was it a true sign of the end or simply the setup to a redemptive chapter in kansas city s dynasty beating the broncos who bested them in a pair of one possession games last year would nudge the answer toward the latter these two teams will meet again in week 8 when we have a much clearer picture of where their seasons are heading but first they ll have a chance to set the tone in a star studded week 1 finale three must know storylines 1 both qbs are coming off major injuries patrick mahomes is set to make his much anticipated return after tearing his acl in week 15 last season his reward for working his way back to the field in roughly nine months facing a ferocious denver defense that has led the league in sacks for two straight years he will also be without left tackle josh simmons due to a back injury putting undrafted rookie kahlil benson in line to serve as his blindside blocker it s a heck of a test but the two time most valuable player is as capable as anyone of working his way through it whereas mahomes didn t play at all in the preseason bo nix suited up for two drives in denver s second preseason game as part of his process of coming back from a broken ankle suffered in the divisional round he looked comfortable in the limited action going 6 of 9 for 76 yards and a touchdown but he wasn t required to move around a ton and test out his mobility it ll be the real deal against the chiefs who will do their best to flush him out and make him uncomfortable 2 broncos chiefs taking different backfield approaches denver enters the season with a deep versatile running back room j k dobbins and rj harvey who combined for 1 705 scrimmage yards and 16 scores last season are back atop the depth chart dobbins is the better all around back but he s struggled to stay on the field throughout his career as evidenced by the running back missing the broncos final nine games last season including playoffs he nonetheless led the team in rushing yards as harvey proved dynamic in the passing game but took time to find his footing they won t be powering denver s ground game alone though despite being listed third on the depth chart rookie jonah coleman has the talent to carve out a role sooner rather than later giving sean payton three ball carriers with which to attack kansas city s front the chiefs are likely to feature more of a solo act after missing out on playing in the super bowl for just the second time in seven years they signed the super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker it s been a while since andy reid s chiefs utilized a true workhorse running back such as when kareem hunt shouldered the load during his first stint in kansas city or jamaal charles spearheaded the attack during reid s early years with the club both produced tremendous results and now 2026 figures to be the kwiii show he ll play a vital role in helping the offense function at a high level while patrick mahomes gets fully back to himself 3 broncos upgraded passing attack vs chiefs new look secondary after finishing last season with an offense that ranked just above average 14th in points scored the broncos went out and traded for an x factor jaylen waddle the perception of waddle might have taken a bit of a hit first as he took a backseat to tyreek hill in miami and then as the dolphins offense waned in effectiveness the past couple years but he is a highly efficient pass catching weapon in three of the past four seasons waddle has finished as a top 15 wr in yards per route twice ranking in the top six per nfl pro he is the perfect complement to courtland sutton and there were rave reviews of pat bryant out of camp too the trio s task will be to dismantle a kansas city secondary transformed by the offseason the chiefs defense lost six players who started 10 plus games last season including safety bryan cook cornerback jaylen watson and cb trent mcduffie k c let the former two walk in free agency and traded mcduffie to the rams part of a recurring strategy by general manager brett veach to reshuffle his secondary rather than pay big money extensions he did the same in 2024 with l 39 jarius sneed who is back and joined by 2026 no 6 overall pick mansoor delane and free agent signing alohi gilman as part of the new look defensive backfield the difference in the game could come down to which revamped group starts the season stronger

news_mentions.headline: Report: Texans, QB C.J. Stroud tabling extension talks until after season
news_mentions.description: After previously attempting to reach an extension, the Houston Texans and QB C.J. Stroud have agreed to table negotiations until after this season, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: c j stroud won t be among those striking a deadline deal ahead of sunday of week 1 after previously attempting to reach an extension the houston texans and their quarterback have agreed to pause negotiations until after this season nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported saturday stroud set to turn 25 on oct 3 is heading into his fourth season with the texans and despite discussions there doesn t need to be a great rush to get something done unlike tampa bay buccaneers qb baker mayfield and green bay packers tight end tucker kraft who each signed extensions this week to avoid playing out 2026 on a contract year stroud has two seasons remaining on his rookie deal after houston picked up his fifth year option the quarterback market is forever climbing topped by the kansas city chiefs patrick mahomes 64 million per year salary so stroud stands to make more money as long as he s patient and proves himself worthy of such a lucrative deal stroud s upcoming campaign will be crucial in regard to the latter element of the equation after winning offensive rookie of the year in 2023 with 4 108 passing yards 23 touchdowns and five interceptions stroud has played far more unevenly the past two seasons he s thrown for 6 768 yards 39 tds and 20 ints since 2024 with an 89 6 passer rating compared to his 100 8 rating as a rookie while it was uncharacteristic of a qb who still adeptly managed his squad to three playoff trips in three tries stroud melted down in his most recent postseason tossing five picks and fumbling five times across two games the texans have done nothing but sing his praises since though with countless players and personnel backing the qb should stroud rebound in year 4 and perhaps help shatter the divisional round ceiling that has limited houston in recent trips it ll only up his worth when the sides come back to the table stroud and houston kick off the 26 season with a heavyweight bout against the buffalo bills on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (knee) has no injury status, cleared for comeback Monday night vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Patrick Mahomes, nine months removed from tearing his ACL and LCL, has no injury designation and will start for his Chiefs on Monday night against the visiting Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: patrick mahomes is cleared for his comeback launch mahomes nine months removed from tearing his acl and lcl has no injury designation and will start for his kansas city chiefs on monday night against the visiting denver broncos this has been the goal all offseason for mahomes and the expectation as of late the three time super bowl winner was a full participant throughout the thursday saturday practice week while a major hurdle has been cleared for mahomes just how he performs on his surgically repaired knee is a question still left to be answered he ll have a tall task facing the broncos reigning afc west champions denver is bolstered by a stellar nik bonitto led pass rush and the chiefs are set to start undrafted free agent kahlil benson at left tackle in place of an injured josh simmons kansas city is coming off a 6 11 season in which it failed to make the playoffs for the first time since 2014 and had its streak of nine straight afc west titles snapped mahomes who had never fallen short of the postseason much less a division title until last season had his worst passing season statistically since becoming the chiefs starter in 2018 denver swept kansas city in 2025 though mahomes missed the second tilt after he tore multiple ligaments in week 15 against the los angeles chargers over 14 starts mahomes threw for 3 587 yards 22 touchdowns and 11 interceptions a six time pro bowler and three time super bowl mvp mahomes is set to begin his 10th year and age 31 season with his birthday right around the corner on sept 17 with mahomes and the chiefs looking for a massive comeback season the quarterback will make his eighth straight week 1 start when kansas city kicks off against denver at 8 15 p m et monday

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Packers TE Tucker Kraft agrees to 4-year, $75M extension right before Week 1
news_mentions.description: Tucker Kraft and the Packers have agreed to terms on a four-year, $75 million contract extension that can be worth up to $92 million, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: tucker kraft s 2025 season was cut short but he s most certainly in the green bay packers long term plans kraft and the packers have agreed to terms on a four year 75 million contract extension through 2030 that can be worth up to 92 million nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on saturday rapoport added that kraft received a 26 5 million signing bonus in the deal struck just a day before green bay s week 1 game against the minnesota vikings the packers have since announced extending kraft it s the latest extension doled out by the packers with general manager brian gutekunst having clearly identified the core players on the squad he wants to build around green bay s offseason has seen its share of departures such as wide receivers romeo doubs and dontayvion wicks but the packers have locked up cornerstone players on both sides of the ball kraft follows jayden reed and christian watson as offensive players who have recently received new contracts while linebacker isaiah mcduffie and defensive lineman devonte wyatt also earned extensions following news of wyatt s extension on july 20 rapoport said kraft could be next up in the extension line that s proved to be true as green bay has taken on a bit of a different connotation of late kraft s new deal comes with ample uncertainty as he s coming back from a torn acl that cut a sterling 2025 campaign short the 25 year old is good to go in week 1 without restrictions and green bay is clearly confident enough in his health to make a lucrative investment a third round pick in the 2023 nfl draft kraft emerged in his second season recording 50 receptions for 707 yards and seven touchdowns in 2025 though kraft was off to a scintillating start right along with the packers over the first seven games of the season green bay was 5 1 1 with kraft posting 30 catches 469 yards and six tds his run after the catch ability something to behold right along with his chemistry with quarterback jordan love he was injured in a week 9 upset loss to the carolina panthers and love and the packers offense were clearly hindered by his absence for the remainder of the season packers brass is banking on being buoyed by kraft s return in 2026 and beyond

news_mentions.headline: Report: Bears, D'Andre Swift agree to three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million in guaranteed money, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: d 39 andre swift s 2026 season will not be a contract year after all the chicago bears and swift have agreed to a three year 33 75 million extension that includes 27 5 million in guaranteed money espn s adam schefter reported on friday chicago officially announced swift s extension saturday morning the extension provides swift with a raise of more than 3 million in average annual salary and secures the running back s services through his age 30 season 2029 while also locking down a quality running back at a rate that fits swift s production and is also friendlier to the bears salary cap management swift began his career in detroit as a 2020 second round pick out of georgia and never quite progressed to a stage that warranted an extension with the lions who traded swift to philadelphia in 2023 after enjoying a career best year 1 263 scrimmage yards six total touchdowns with the eagles swift moved to chicago signing a three year 24 million deal with the bears in 2024 since then swift has proven himself as a reliably productive weapon averaging 1 365 5 scrimmage yards in his first two seasons with the bears and forming one half of a contrasting tandem with bruising back kyle monangai last season with swift in the window to sign one more lucrative deal and the final year of his existing contract beginning in 2026 bears general manager ryan poles made sure to sign his top back before the season began they ll kick off their 2026 journey on sunday against the panthers with one less financial matter on their checklist

news_mentions.headline: Report: 49ers give HC Kyle Shanahan multiyear contract extension
news_mentions.description: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason, ESPN confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: kyle shanahan kicked off 2026 with a masterful showing in the 49ers victory over the rams in australia but it wasn t the only win he scored this year the 49ers coach signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason espn confirmed friday the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news terms of the deal aren t yet known but shanahan s extension represents a deserved reward and sign of stability in san francisco where the coach has worked in tandem with general manager john lynch since both were hired in 2017 since the start of their partnership the 49ers have won three nfc west titles two nfc championships and have appeared in four conference championship games rising to the upper crust of the nfl hierarchy shanahan has a record of 83 67 over that span shanahan accomplished what was arguably his greatest feat last season guiding the injury ravaged 49ers to a 12 5 finish and a playoff win over the eagles on wild card weekend with that success still fresh in the minds of 49ers ownership the team decided it was time to reward the coach with additional security his performance in week 1 added a cherry on top shanahan previously was under contract through 2027

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive news_mentions.description: Are the two NFL teams with the widest range of outcomes in 2026 meeting in Week 1? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks breaks down a pair of true wild cards. Plus, three bounce-back candidates.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three teams that could make the playoffs after falling short last season but first a look at two genuine wild cards in 2026 in my opinion the cincinnati bengals enter this season with the widest range of potential outcomes in the afc i can envision cincy seriously competing for the lombardi trophy or missing the playoffs for a fourth straight year and in the nfc that team is the tampa bay buccaneers the bucs entered last season with hype and started out 6 2 but then they came apart after the bye ultimately finishing with a losing record and watching the postseason from home ironically these two teams open the 2026 season against each other with the bengals hosting the bucs at paycor stadium on sunday so one of them will get off on the right foot while the other will start the new campaign with a stumble but what s the long view on each squad can both realize their upside in the coming months here are my thoughts three bounce back candidates the bengals and buccaneers aren t the only teams with the potential to return to the postseason after a playoff free 2025 campaign here are three talented squads that could rebound in a major way in 2026

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes
