star pass rusher plucked a cooper rush pass and dashed to the end zone for the eventual game deciding touchdown the pittsburgh defensive line controlled most of the contest holding bijan robinson down early and bamboozling rush the stars shined for the steelers watt generated two sacks ditto for alex highsmith cameron heyward was playing volleyball swatting three passes pittsburgh held atlanta to 2 of 12 on third downs and 238 total yards it might not have been pretty but the steelers d showed it can keep the club stable until the offense gets clicking bijan can t do it alone the star running back generated 173 of the falcons 263 scrimmage yards 83 rushing yards on 21 carries 90 receiving yards on eight catches with a td cooper rush was thrust into a tough spot making the week 1 start after joining the club late in the process the issues were obvious rush was inconsistent missing targets and rarely threatening downfield ten of his 21 attempts came behind the line of scrimmage with very little passing threat the steelers defense was able to prioritize slowing the ground attack it was a testament to robinson s talent that he averaged 4 0 yards per carry until the falcons qb situation is sorted atlanta will struggle to put up points pittsburgh offense dk had a forgettable week 1 the positive a 42 year old aaron rodgers looked spry enough and comfortable in mike mccarthy s offense rodgers attempted to stretch the field more than last year but had little success doing so going 0 of 6 on passes of 20 plus air yards a few of those deep tosses should have connected but dk metcalf struggled to come down the ball repeatedly metcalf caught just four of 10 targets for 40 yards and was called for a couple of offensive pass interference penalties metcalf flubbed several potential big plays on beautiful throws from rodgers the run game was silenced averaging 2 8 yards per carry with neither jaylen warren nor rico dowdle able to find any consistency put in poor down and distance repeatedly the steelers generated just 15 first downs and 264 total yards while going 3 13 on third downs next gen stats insight for steelers falcons via nfl pro aaron rodgers 9 2 air yards per target against the falcons are the most he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw being the third highest average in a game as a steeler on passes under 10 air yards rodgers completed 20 of his 24 attempts 83 3 with 11 of these pass attempts being quick passes under 2 5 second ttt as he pushed the ball on downfield throws 10 plus air yards his passing efficiency dropped completing just four of 12 33 3 of his passes for 73 yards and one touchdown nfl research t j watt joined julius peppers as the only players with 100 plus sacks and 10 plus interceptions since sacks were first tracked in 1982 back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways jets start season at cruising altitude aaron glenn didn t earn his first win as head coach until week 8 of his first season in charge one game into 2026 his jets boast a winning record for the first time since week 3 of the 2024 campaign and deservedly so gang green was clicking all sides of the ball with a few exceptions geno smith played error free ball spreading the ball around to eight different receivers breece hall and braelon allen paced the offense with a plus rushing attack 142 yards on 32 carries new york dominated time of possession in part thanks to a second quarter near 12 minute drive glenn s defense much maligned in 2025 was stalwart allowing just 112 yards and six first downs through three quarters as the jets built a 20 3 lead qwan 39 tez stiggers and the jets special teams delivered some key stops and a takeaway on titans returns too new york hasn t looked this composed in all three phases in some time the jets lowly opponent notwithstanding they couldn t have asked for a better week 1 underwhelming start of saleh era in nashville donning fresh kits and a new outlook the titans looked on sunday like the same outfit that stumbled to a 3 14 campaign in 2025 robert saleh s defense was run through and put little pressure on new york s offensive line brian daboll s offense had no explosion the titans longest play was 14 yards and tennessee averaged just 4 0 yards per play cam ward was swamped by the jets pass rush getting pressured on 41 of his dropbacks and taking three sacks nissan stadium emptied out early partially due to a stifling tennessee heat but mostly due to the titans poor play leaving remaining local fans to boo and scream fire saleh audibly enough to be picked up by cbs boom mics and a sizable jets contingent to break out their notorious j e t s chants for saleh a former jets coach the result was the last thing he could have wanted with so much new in nashville an adjustment period is to be expected but the new look titans still look like a team at least a year away from contending gang green rookies don t look green the jets used their three first round picks to load up on talent with pass rusher david bailey tight end kenyon sadiq and wide receiver omar cooper all three made their presences felt on sunday if only briefly cooper delivered a yac happy 30 yard catch and run on new york s opening scoring drive that march ended with a nifty end around touchdown run for sadiq an athletic tight end with the motor to beat linebackers to the edge in the process sadiq joined hall of famer ozzie newsome 1978 as the only tes in nfl history with a rushing td in their first career game bailey got home in the third quarter logging his first nfl sack with help from the boundary and was a constant force in the backfield the no 2 pick logged a game high six qb pressures the one drawback cooper was forced from the game in the first half with an ankle injury and did not return but for bailey and sadiq the latter of whom was held out of most of training camp with an injury the opener was an unquestioned success and hopefully for new york a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for jets titans via nfl pro the jets ran from under center on 69 4 of called runs their highest rate under aaron glenn totaling 25 of their 36 called runs for 115 yards and two rushing touchdowns breece hall led with 17 under center rushing attempts for 85 yards and a touchdown including three explosive runs 10 yards tied for a career high nfl research the jets outgained tennessee by 172 total yards their largest total yards margin in week 1 since 2014 the last time geno smith was new york s week 1 starter back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways cards capitalize on chargers fourth quarter miscues mike lafleur s bunch was sunday s biggest surprise snapping a nine game losing streak carried over from the 2025 season the cardinals had a fourth quarter for the books one that included a blocked punt and two huge defensive stands the dam began to break for the chargers early in the fourth trailing 16 14 when cardinal simi fehoko shot through the middle to block a punt deep in chargers territory two plays later jacoby brissett hit trey mcbride for a 3 yard touchdown and a daniel carlson extra point put the cards up by two scores the flood gates continued to open on the next two chargers possessions as undrafted eighth year safety andrew wingard picked off a deep justin herbert pass before the cardinals forced a turnover on downs with 4 minutes to play holding los angeles to just seven second half points the cardinals couldn t ask for a better start to this new era lafleur s offense cooks with balanced effort the cardinals did a lot of good things offensively sunday mike lafleur with an infusion of shifts and motions orchestrated a balanced offense 34 rushes to 37 pass plays and put up nearly 400 yards the unit s first punt occurred with 2 minutes 47 seconds remaining in the third quarter and jacoby brissett looked more than worth that reworked contract playing efficiently and often delivering quick and accurate strikes he finished 27 of 37 passing for 277 yards and a touchdown to no one s surprise trey mcbride was his top target nine catches 95 yards and one td on 13 targets and it was promising to see kendrick bourne so involved he hauled in all eight of his targets for 75 yards it s worth noting marvin harrison made one catch albeit a nice one on three targets predictably tyler allgeier and jeremiyah love split the backfield workload with the veteran taking 17 carries for 61 yards on 41 snaps and the rookie 11 totes for 41 yards including a 5 yard touchdown run on 32 snaps there s a lot to like about this offense at first blush if it cleans up the pre snap penalties it ll keep arizona in a lot of games sluggish start for herbert l a our real first look at justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense was a mixed bag herbert looked dialed early leading an eight play 77 yard scoring drive hitting ladd mcconkey three times for 60 yards mcconkey was far and away herbert s favorite receiver in this one hauling in five catches for 82 yards with an 8 yard touchdown before a chest injury sidelined him just before the third quarter concluded his exit left los angeles without a reliable possession receiver and it showed as the chargers offense failed to reach cardinals territory on four fourth quarter possessions veteran tight end david njoku also had five catches sunday for 58 yards while herbert finished 17 of 27 for 209 yards a td and int with three sacks the offense converted twice on eight third down tries was 0 of 3 on fourth down and lost the possession battle by 15 minutes this offense has talent to be sure but this was one of the more concerning storylines from sunday next gen stats insight for cardinals chargers via nfl pro jeremiyah love forced six missed tackles in his nfl debut on 11 carries generating 38 of his 41 rushing yards after forcing a missed tackle most of his rushing production came on outside runs to the right side of the formation 28 yards on six carries with only two carries coming between the tackles nfl research mike lafleur became the first non interim head coach for the cardinals to win his first game since don coryell in 1973 back to top dan parr s takeaways raiders take baby steps it wasn t always pretty but first year head coach klint kubiak showed in the opener that he has elevated las vegas from the depths it fell to in recent years after spending the last two seasons at the bottom of the league the 27 13 win showed there is now a gap between them and a dolphins team that appears to be at the bottom right now it was the franchise s largest margin of victory since week 17 of the 2024 season and its first double digit win to open a season since 2017 ashton jeanty had one of the best games of his young career gaining 147 scrimmage yards on 29 touches 5 1 yards per touch and posting two touchdown catches the offensive line was functioning at a level that was missing all too often last year the raiders didn t even punt until the fourth quarter and scored 27 points a mark they reached only once last season in a week 9 loss qb questions for raiders are not going away kirk cousins isn t going to build confidence that he s long for the starting job with his performance on sunday yes cousins finished with three touchdown passes and completed 70 of his throws but he couldn t get much of anything going downfield he was 1 of 7 for 21 yards no tds and two interceptions on passes of 10 or more air yards per next gen stats he was without his top pass catcher tight end brock bowers but miami s four starters in the secondary had a combined three career starts entering sunday vegas is going to need more from cousins to be competitive against the league s better teams the drumbeat to start first overall pick fernando mendoza will grow louder with each week if the veteran qb can t connect with deep targets and turns the ball over like he did on sunday dolphins still have a long way to go week 1 confirmed that miami is very much in the beginning of a rebuild under new general manager jon eric sullivan and head coach jeff hafley in his first start with his new team quarterback malik willis had some nice moments but he also looked indecisive at times perhaps because his young wide receivers were not open and took five sacks the dolphins went 2 for 10 on third down and converted on only 1 of 3 trips to the red zone they didn t sack cousins and too often shot themselves in the foot including on special teams allowing two kick returns of 40 plus yards and missing a 41 yard field goal it s only going to get tougher from here with miami visiting the 49ers next week next gen stats insight for dolphins raiders via nfl pro the raiders used 21 personnel 2 rb 1 te 2 wr on 24 of their 67 offensive plays 35 8 their highest rate in the ngs era since 2016 las vegas posted 154 yards and two touchdowns out of 21 personnel averaging 6 4 yards per play both tds were scored by ashton jeanty who caught all four of his targets for 36 yards out of the grouping nfl research the raiders 27 point performance extended their streak to 38 consecutive games without reaching 30 points the longest active streak in the nfl back to top nick shook s takeaways flores defense keys comeback notorious for his penchant for dialing up blitzes minnesota defensive coordinator brian flores threw caution to the wind to start the season and sent his soldiers after the opposition all afternoon minnesota blitzed on 78 3 of defensive plays logging a pressure rate of 50 and throwing a massive purple and gold wrench into green bay s offensive plans though present throughout the contest and a frequent disruptor for green bay s offense in the first half the aggressive approach truly swung the game in favor of the vikings in the second half when flores understood green bay s offensive line could not properly handle his blitzes and he could manufacture one or more free rushers on any given down with the packers behind the sticks and desperate for a response flores unleashed his attacks wrecking jordan love s chances of keying a late rally and forcing takeaways that helped the vikings run away with the win even with an offseason of change intended to balance out the team s strengths the defense got the job done once again packers still can t overcome adversity for most of sunday s contest green bay appeared to be the better team the packers were leading despite lacking a running game their defense was causing all sorts of problems for carson wentz and the vikings offense they were outgaining minnesota significantly and it seemed they were one or two more stops from wrapping up a week 1 win over their division rivals it all fell apart in one possession though with a few questionable calls buying the vikings second third and fourth lives on a drive that ended with an aaron jones rushing score from there the wheels flew off the packers bus with flores sending relentless pressure and green bay s offensive line completely failing to pick up minnesota s blitzes jordan love melted down fumbling away possession and throwing an interception on the packers next drive in a fashion that was painfully reminiscent of the end of green bay s 2025 season in seemingly a flash the packers went from a likely week 1 winner to a runaway loser and despite all of the attempts to fix their issues in the offseason they ll walk away from this game mired in the same familiar feeling of disappointment nightmarish debut for kyler the kyler murray era was supposed to commence happily on sunday instead it began with an interception on murray s first attempt a desperation heave in the face of unblocked pressure murray s day didn t last much longer a third down scramble midway through the first quarter ended with murray sliding late and suffering a concussion when he was hit late sending the vikings back to the familiar place known as plan b carson wentz replaced murray and did a serviceable job but with murray entering concussion protocol the vikings might again find themselves in a position in which they must rely on a backup and hope for the best fortunately for them it worked out in their favor sunday next gen stats insight for packers vikings via nfl pro justin jefferson s 39 yard td reception from carson wentz was jefferson s first deep td 20 plus air yards since week 16 2024 nfl research sunday s win was the first game in vikings franchise history that it has won by 15 plus points despite being outgained by 150 plus total yards back to top kevin patra s takeaways eagles use big plays to outlast commanders much like the last several seasons the eagles offense wasn t pretty but it got the job done eking out a two point win over a division rival philly s offense was an inconsistent mess for much of the day with the offensive line struggling to pick up the new blocking scheme allowing far too many free runners into the backfield however nick sirianni s club used a trove of big plays that made the difference saquon barkley had a 42 yard scamper that helped set up a second quarter score jalen hurts who was up and down splashed three passes that went at least 30 yards including the difference making 43 yard catch and run td from dallas goedert the big plays covered for an offense that went three and out four times including three straight to start the second half there are obvious kinks to iron out with sean mannion s system but a win s a win commanders offense takes too long to get started like its counterpart washington s newly installed offense took time to make moves at times with both clubs breaking in new play callers sunday s game in philadelphia had a preseason feel through two quarters jayden daniels completed just six of 16 passes for 43 yards in the second half daniels picked things up used his legs more effectively and got an offense that was mostly stuck in the mud early into gear daniels guided the commanders to back to back fourth quarter touchdown drives using a slew of quick passes to knife through a good eagles d however a two point attempt shovel pass to tight end john bates was doa as the commanders fell shy new offensive coordinator david blough would probably like that call back returning after an injury riddled 2025 campaign to face a stout philly d in a new offense was a tough first ask for daniels washington s offense has a lot to clean up moving forward but at least the offensive line didn t get the qb killed allowing just two qb hits and one sack baun swarms for fangio s defense philly s lack of consistent pass rush is a concern especially given the state of the commanders offensive line yet linebacker zack baun continued to anchor the middle of the defense the pro bowler flew all over the field gobbling up 12 tackles including one for loss and generated the eagles only two passes defensed on the day baun stood out among a philly d that was solid but not otherworldly as they ve been cooper dejean got worked at times allowing seven catches on nine targets in coverage for 83 yards and a td the pass rush went silent for stretches and didn t provide enough pop the middle of the d led by jalen carter jordan davis and moro ojomo however was solid combining for 13 tackles two run stuffs and ojomo destroyed the two point attempt the eagles held the commanders to 295 total yards the 19th game holding their opponent under 300 yards since vic fangio took over in 2024 second in the nfl behind the seahawks 21 next gen stats insight for commanders eagles via nfl pro jalen hurts completed six of nine downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage total on those throws was the eighth highest of his career while he threw three or more downfield touchdowns for just the sixth time nfl research the eagles won their sixth straight week 1 game the longest active streak in the nfl nick sirianni is the fifth head coach to win each of his first six career season openers joining jim harbaugh mike shanahan potsy clark and hall of famer george allen back to top grant gordon s takeaways what a way to kick off the harbaugh era jaxson dart was back so too were malik nabers and cam skattebo each of them making contributions to knock off the rival cowboys in head coach john harbaugh s gotham debut facing a franchise that popularized the triplets term the giants young franchise trio of dart nabers and skattebo proved to be the offensive catalyst buoyed by their defense forcing an opening three and out the giants offense responded with a 10 play 83 yard scoring march in which dart used his arm and legs to guide them when the quarterback took a dirty and savage hit along the sideline that drew a flag his teammates surrounded him in unity dart was marvelous to the tune of 23 of 29 passing for 230 yards three touchdowns and 54 rushing yards nabers six receptions for 69 yards got his first licks out of the way coming back from a torn acl and meniscus that had sidelined him since week 4 of last year after his opening score skattebo coming back from a busted ankle predictably backflipped and proceeded to churn out 81 hard yards this was the start harbaugh and the franchise needed and wanted their young guns were firing against a hated adversary this wasn t a pretty game too many penalties too many fumbles some drops but for harbaugh and new york it was a beautiful result for the franchise s new dawn cowboys start big season with dud brian schottenheimer dak prescott and co haven t shied away from proclaiming their belief that they can and will be going to the super bowl an uncharacteristically drama free offseason helped to fuel the confidence but dallas fell flat to start the season with an surprisingly dreadful offensive performance that equated to a loss to a division rival it s used to dominating deep into the fourth quarter prescott s offense had less than 200 yards ceedee lamb and george pickens had bad drops prescott 175 yards two touchdowns had an ugly interception and everything looked off even when the cowboys made it a one score game javonte williams foolishly drew an unsportsmanlike penalty on his touchdown catch high hopes aren t shot down in week 1 but dallas was reminded nothing s coming easy and these cowboys aren t riding into the sunset anytime soon if they don t execute to their potential harbaugh giants hold tight john harbaugh s time in baltimore came to a close after his 19th season with the campaign ending well short of expectations thanks to five one score losses and three blown fourth quarter leads in 2025 the first of those was a bitter 41 40 loss to the bills on sunday night to open the campaign last september the 2025 giants meanwhile blew an incredible five fourth quarter leads in a victory symbolic of exorcising the ghosts of blown leads past these giants held on when the cowboys cut the deficit to the final score big blue s second year qb found his most fitting target isaiah likely who converted a third and 9 with a 12 yard pick up likely converted another third down later on the drive before skattebo salted away the win with the final first down needed likely a longtime former raven had a game high eight catches for 78 yards and two scores in so many ways this is a great vibes win for new york as it aims to build a winner next gen stats insight for cowboys giants via nfl pro odell beckham playing his first game with the giants since dec 12 2018 played 11 snaps with seven routes run and no targets nfl research sunday night saw the giants defeat the cowboys for just the third time in the last 19 meetings it was the 12th week 1 meeting between the rivals and new york won for just the second time in such instances back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: New York Giants training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the New York Giants' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs' Travis Kelce moves into second place for all-time tight end receiving yards
news_mentions.description: Travis Kelce moved into second place all-time for receiving yards by a tight end during the Chiefs’ season opener Monday night against the Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: it was quite a milestone offseason for travis kelce the kansas city chiefs tight end wasted no time in making it a milestone regular season as well kelce moved into second all time for receiving yards by a tight end during the chiefs 31 10 season opening monday night win over the denver broncos predictably kelce downplayed the individual milestone when speaking to espn s laura rutledge after the game it s a good feeling to get this win all the other stuff is just hoopla now he said kelce caught a 59 yard pass from old friend patrick mahomes in the third quarter to put him past longtime dallas cowboys stalwart jason witten for second all time ahead of monday s season opener kelce had 13 002 yards needing 45 to surpass witten 13 046 the catch was a turn back the clock moment for kelce standing as his longest reception since week 15 2021 when he turned in a 69 yarder versus the los angeles chargers it was a memorable way to begin kelce s 14th and perhaps final season the three time super bowl winner now trails only hall of famer tony gonzalez 15 127 in receiving yards by a tight end though the 36 year old s career is winding down his star status is not thanks in large part to his recent nuptials to pop megastar taylor swift a no doubt future hall of famer kelce an 11 time pro bowler and four time all pro ranks fifth among tight ends with 82 touchdowns and third in receptions 1 083 among his other notable accomplishments kelce has the most 100 yard games by a tight end 38 and his 1 416 yards in 2020 remaining a single season best at the position kelce s earned another tip of the helmet for what s been an astounding career but this season is just beginning as he aims to help his chiefs return to prior heavyweight status

news_mentions.headline: 5 storylines to know from Week 1 of 2026 season: Bears, Ravens amaze and a tale of two LaFleurs
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at five key storylines to know from Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: the first week of the nfl season plays out as a mirage offering glimpses of thirst quenching promise for a football starved diaspora with a minuscule sample things aren t always what they seem after one game in a gauntlet of a season remember a year ago when the raiders knocked off the patriots in week 1 in foxborough las vegas wound up with the no 1 overall pick new england played in the super bowl week 1 lies like a toddler who just doesn t know any better as the young season wears on there will be twists plummets and vaults teams that looked good on sunday will falter clubs that struggled out of the gate will find a groove with franchises mostly holding starters out of preseason action many tilts around the nfl looked like exhibition matches early in particular some squads breaking in new coordinators philly and washington come to mind looked like they had a lot of kinks to iron out no one won a lombardi trophy on sunday no one lost one either the first sunday was an important first step in the march to february but it s not the be all and end all each monday during the season i ll take a look at five key storylines from sunday s slate of contests starting today with week 1 s points a palooza and including john harbaugh s prime time win in his n y debut josh allen bills exorcising demons in houston a tale of two lafleurs for arizona and green bay sunday s big day for star rbs around the nfl 1 sunday s points bonanza has nfl on brink of history yesterday s 13 games averaged 53 3 points the highest scoring week 1 sunday in league history per nfl research entering monday night football the average for the entire week 1 slate is 50 0 points per game which if it holds tonight when the denver broncos take on the kansas city chiefs would mark a super bowl era record six tilts on sunday saw at least 60 combined points i d like to highlight two teams that particularly stood out on offense baltimore and chicago new ravens oc declan doyle actually spent last season on ben johnson s bears staff so perhaps it shouldn t be too surprising that baltimore authored the most explosive output beyond chicago lamar jackson looked like his two time mvp self zipping darts into open windows escaping sure sacks for first downs and looking far fresher and less frazzled than he did last year his rapport with zay flowers was otherworldly before the wideout left with a hamstring injury assuming the issue doesn t linger nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that the setback isn t considered serious the duo could be something special this season doyle did an excellent job mixing up his calls schemed players open for easy jackson reads and kept the colts off balance add in that derrick henry still runs like he s 25 years old bulldozing his way to 144 yards and three tds for his own record setting day and baltimore s offense looked deadly in putting up 41 points in a blowout win at indianapolis the sample is small but if the ravens can stay healthy a big if they could eat up points meanwhile johnson entered the season saying he wanted to employ the best offense in league history the bears went out and showed they have the horses to do so in a 59 37 win at carolina after the game chicago s second year head coach doubled down on the ambition that will always be the goal johnson said we want to be the highest scoring we want to have the most wins we want to win super bowls that s what we do we didn t get into this profession trying to be mediocre or average sure it came against a panthers defense that entered the season with significant questions after making splashes in free agency to upgrade the unit but the base of what transpired sunday in charlotte is replicable perhaps the bears won t put up 59 points and 552 yards with two rushers hitting the century mark but johnson s offense proved it can score from anywhere on the field caleb williams shut down questions about whether the offseason hype would prove unfounded the madden cover athlete built on his 2025 breakout season made some incredible throws and used his legs as a weapon williams is the first player in bears history with at least 200 passing yards two passing touchdowns 50 rushing yards and two rushing tds in a single game per nfl research he is the third player over the last five seasons to reach those marks in a single game joining the bills josh allen three times and the eagles jalen hurts two times the qb can still improve against pressure 0 for 5 passing with two sacks on 13 pressured dropbacks per next gen stats but the 72 4 completion rate is what stood out it s a figure he never really came close to in his first season under johnson the question all offseason was if williams could smooth out the rough patches and become more consistent down to down sunday was an excellent step in that direction 2 john harbaugh era gets off to roaring start the giants actually looked like a professional operation on sunday night for the first time in a while the mistakes and roller coaster play that had come to define the club were smoothed into effective showings on both sides of the ball harbaugh s squad ran efficiently on offense taking advantage of a cowboys defense that hasn t fixed all its issues from last season and blocked very well and the defense while having some hiccups in the secondary was mostly on the spot in allowing 244 total yards for the game the most notable improvement came from under center where jaxson dart played the most proficient game of his career the qb logged his first career outing with three or more pass touchdowns and zero interceptions dart 23 is the youngest player to accomplish the feat in a week 1 prime time game and the first under the age of 25 to do so since patrick mahomes 2020 vs texans as a rookie dart showed he could make backyard plays big time throws and gash defenses with his legs however it always felt helter skelter his hair always on fire on sunday night the second year qb looked calm smooth and never out of sync dart was content to make the cowboys pay for poor coverage not forcing balls or hunting big plays he showed he could make the ho hum play needed to elevate an offense sometimes boring qb play is the best qb play add in malik nabers return from last year s season ending injury six catches for 69 yards on a team high nine targets and it was a smashing opening night at metlife stadium 3 bills exorcise houston demons in joe brady s first game as head coach the last two times josh allen and the bills traveled to houston things ended poorly in last year s meeting allen was crunched taking a career high eight sacks and throwing two ints in the loss with that backdrop on sunday the joe brady era took flight facing what was expected to be one of the best defenses in football if not the best allen ripped passes through the texans secondary the buffalo o line did a smashing job against a beast of a front after the bills allowed eight sacks last year in houston allen faced just nine total pressures this time and took two sacks the qb was 5 of 7 passing for 85 yards under pressure per next gen stats in total allen completed 20 of his 29 pass attempts for 334 yards and two touchdowns in the bills week 1 win against the texans adding another two scores with his legs allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest in a game since week 18 of 2022 the star signal caller completed 11 of his 16 passes of 10 plus air yards with two tds the 286 downfield passing yards were the most the texans have allowed in a game since demeco ryans took over as head coach in 2023 per nfl research as always allen got away with a few iffy balls i e kamari lassiter s dropped int late but the good outweighed the bad and houston failed to capitalize on the mistakes buffalo s 36 points represented the most a ryans led defense has given up since his first season in houston with brady being elevated from oc to the big chair it was worth wondering how much the offense might change with the restrictor plate off it s just one week but with the addition of dj moore 5 100 1 and the healthy status of dalton kincaid 5 130 the bills offense leaned on allen and splashed big play after big play coming against ryans defense it was a massive statement 4 good lafleur bad lafleur the stunner of the week came in los angeles where the cardinals handled jim harbaugh s chargers a trendy pick to go deep in the playoffs the true shocker wasn t that the cards whose projected win total entering the season was roughly four pulled off the upset it was that they controlled much of the tilt new head coach mike lafleur showed a deft hand in deploying his array of weapons keeping the bolts defense off balance the offensive line held up well and jacoby brissett once again showed that he s a professional quarterback who s unafraid to attack completing 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards per next gen stats if the cards can keep this up while avoiding turnovers they ll be a pest brissett has proven he can fling it around the park and he looked comfortable in lafleur s offense the cardinals defense which is solid on paper but hasn t been able to stay healthy in recent years held justin herbert and the mike mcdaniel led offense to 268 total yards and 17 first downs the d also forced two turnovers and gobbled up three sacks add in a blocked punt by the special teams and it was a three phase win in lafleur s first game we ve seen this show before where teams expected to be bad show up in week 1 and surprise last year arizona won its season opener before ultimately finishing 3 14 i don t expect a similar crash it s just one week but lafleur showed he can coach and the cards displayed they have the talent to be frisky if they can stay healthy with games against the seahawks and 49ers on tap they ll have a chance to prove week 1 was more than just a flash in the pan the other lafleur brother didn t fare so well packers hc matt lafleur watched a 12 point third quarter lead disintegrate in minnesota against backup vikings quarterback carson wentz who played the majority of the game after kyler murray suffered a concussion in the first half yes several questionable penalties went against the packers but flags didn t cause the rest of the miscues from the moment the elder lafleur took three points off the board in the fourth quarter to fall short on a fourth and 1 play the packers crumbled we re gonna be aggressive and we re gonna try to go for the throat in that situation matt lafleur said of the decision they missed the throat and stabbed their own leg the offensive line completely fell apart in the face of brian flores relentless pressure minnesota had a 78 3 blitz rate on jordan love dropbacks the fourth highest figure by a defense in a game since at least 2018 per next gen stats love fumbled deep in his own territory and later threw an int to cap off the fourth quarter collapse blown leads in winnable games have become a staple under matt lafleur sunday s flop was of the epic variety the vikings who scored 29 unanswered points became the first team in nfl history to trail by 12 plus points with under 20 minutes left in regulation and win by 17 plus points per nfl research speaking of minnesota wentz proved kevin o connell made the correct call in naming him the backup over j j mccarthy he s not a perfect qb but the veteran plays well enough in koc s offense to move the ball 5 big time day for lead rbs running backs got paid this offseason then went on to prove the investments were worth it sunday saw a trove of rbs scamper all over defenses the top of the charts was a veritable who s who of workhorses jahmyr gibbs led all players with 34 touches 186 scrimmage yards and 156 rushing yards he also forced 12 missed tackles the most in any game of his career after the contest gibbs suggested he could ve had 40 touches if needed currently he s on pace for a ridiculous 578 touches the all time record is 492 by james wilder in 1984 derrick henry galloped for 144 rushing yards and three tds on 24 totes and finished with 163 scrimmage yards give the ravens revamped o line some love henry finished with 110 yards before contact against the colts the third highest single game total of his career he was hit at the line of scrimmage on just 8 3 of his carries the lowest rate of his ravens career bijan robinson generated 173 scrimmage yards including 90 receiving yards most among all rbs through sunday robinson accounted for 65 8 of the falcons yards from scrimmage in week 1 the highest share by any player in a team s season opener since rams rb eric dickerson 66 6 in 1986 d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai formed a two headed monster for chicago the former gobbled up 124 rushing yards and three rushing tds while the latter scampered for 100 yards with a 61 yard td rumble add in caleb williams ground effort 65 yards two tds and the bears became the fourth team in the super bowl era to have three players with at least 65 rushing yards and at least one rushing touchdown in the same game first trio to include a qb per nfl research the last team to accomplish the feat was the 2013 rams in week 12 with wr tavon austin and rbs benny cunningham and zac stacy ashton jeanty gobbled up 147 scrimmage yards 102 rushing yards with 45 receiving yards team high and two td catches in the 27 13 win over miami jeanty generated 73 rushing yards after contact the third most in his career his three explosive runs of 10 plus yards tied for the second most in a game in his career pretty good for a player who suffered an ankle injury three weeks ago breece hall scampered for 102 rushing yards and a td and added two catches for 16 yards in the jets romp at tennessee perhaps most notable in gang green s revamped offense 17 of hall s 22 rushing attempts came with geno smith under center accounting for 85 yards and a td including three explosive runs tied for a career high per next gen stats jonathan taylor paced the colts offense with 121 scrimmage yards including 98 rushing yards and two rushing scores in the loss to baltimore it marked taylor s 14th career game with 100 plus scrimmage yards and two plus rushing touchdowns tying him with hall of famer edgerrin james for the most such games in colts franchise history david montgomery didn t put up gaudy rushing or scrimmage numbers in houston s loss 79 scrimmage yards 60 rushing 19 receiving but was one of just three players to score three scrimmage tds 2 rushing 1 receiving on sunday alongside derrick henry and d andre swift

news_mentions.headline: Report: Bears, D'Andre Swift agree to three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million in guaranteed money, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: d 39 andre swift s 2026 season will not be a contract year after all the chicago bears and swift have agreed to a three year 33 75 million extension that includes 27 5 million in guaranteed money espn s adam schefter reported on friday chicago officially announced swift s extension saturday morning the extension provides swift with a raise of more than 3 million in average annual salary and secures the running back s services through his age 30 season 2029 while also locking down a quality running back at a rate that fits swift s production and is also friendlier to the bears salary cap management swift began his career in detroit as a 2020 second round pick out of georgia and never quite progressed to a stage that warranted an extension with the lions who traded swift to philadelphia in 2023 after enjoying a career best year 1 263 scrimmage yards six total touchdowns with the eagles swift moved to chicago signing a three year 24 million deal with the bears in 2024 since then swift has proven himself as a reliably productive weapon averaging 1 365 5 scrimmage yards in his first two seasons with the bears and forming one half of a contrasting tandem with bruising back kyle monangai last season with swift in the window to sign one more lucrative deal and the final year of his existing contract beginning in 2026 bears general manager ryan poles made sure to sign his top back before the season began they ll kick off their 2026 journey on sunday against the panthers with one less financial matter on their checklist

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon
