news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their first 50 career games week 1 was gibbs 50th career game with two touchdowns in week 1 gibbs 51 career touchdowns only trail chuck foreman 55 jim brown 53 marcus allen 52 and larry johnson 52 on that list back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bills pull through in unexpected barnburner buffalo versus houston was expected to be one of the best matchups of week 1 that was certainly the case much less expected was the teams combining for 67 points in the end the bills did just enough on both ends to start the season with a win twice retaking the lead after houston was able to pull ahead in the fourth quarter their game winning drive was a seven play 96 yard march led by josh allen who hit dalton kincaid for a 35 yarder to flip the field and later josh palmer on a beautiful 34 yard strike for the go ahead score the drive was a microcosm of buffalo s day on offense as the bills still found resistance against houston s stellar d but was simply able to overcome it james cook nearly fumbled the game away on the drive s first play and allen threw a gimme to kamari lassiter one snap before buffalo s score that the cornerback couldn t corral despite racking up the most points houston has allowed since the 2023 season the bills still required a stop on defense as c j stroud began a potential statement drive with 1 36 remaining he did march the texans down to buffalo s 9 yard line but there the bills refused to break as deone walker sacked stroud on first and goal and gregory rousseau later clinched the win with a third down strip sack it was going to take a total team effort to beat a club of houston s quality and buffalo got one montgomery delivers back in workhorse role david montgomery came to houston for more opportunities and he saw plenty in his first game with the texans although he was inefficient on his carries 3 0 yards per attempt on 20 totes he exhibited a nose for the end zone scoring three of houston s four touchdowns he scored his first when the texans who notably struggled running in the red zone last year trusted him with three consecutive goal line carries his second an 18 yarder came as he cut into a huge hole opened by the texans offensive line and streaked untouched to the end zone montgomery also had three receptions for 19 yards including a 7 yard score he benefited the passing game beyond just his presence too the texans having a legitimate rushing game helped c j stroud 26 of 38 for 274 yards and two tds settle in and make some stellar throws it didn t result in a win sunday but the trade for montgomery looks like it will boost a texans offense that too often failed to hold up its end of the bargain in 2025 moore enjoys new digs it took a while for josh allen to target new acquisition dj moore but once he did the pair made the most of the new partnership moore collected his first look as a bill for an 18 yard catch with just under five minutes to play in the second quarter on the very next play he drew a 46 yard pass interference penalty that set up a 1 yard allen td plunge moore then made a brilliant catch on the following possession snagging the ball over a diving reed blankenship and keeping his feet in before streaking down the sideline for a 43 yard score though he was topped by dalton kincaid s 130 receiving yards which marked a career high for the tight end moore finished with a team leading eight targets five receptions 100 yards and the score his impact on buffalo s offense should silence those who thought he might be done after chicago or fail to carve out a role in a passing attack that loves to spread the ball around next gen stats insight for bills texans via nfl pro houston blitzed on only 18 8 of dropbacks allowing 287 passing yards two touchdowns and a 144 7 passer s offense was an inconsistent mess for much of the day with the offensive line struggling to pick up the new blocking scheme allowing far too many free runners into the backfield however nick sirianni s club used a trove of big plays that made the difference saquon barkley had a 42 yard scamper that helped set up a second quarter score jalen hurts who was up and down splashed three passes that went at least 30 yards including the difference making 43 yard catch and run td from dallas goedert the big plays covered for an offense that went three and out four times including three straight to start the second half there are obvious kinks to iron out with sean mannion s system but a win s a win commanders offense takes too long to get started like its counterpart washington s newly installed offense took time to make moves at times with both clubs breaking in new play callers sunday s game in philadelphia had a preseason feel through two quarters jayden daniels completed just six of 16 passes for 43 yards in the second half daniels picked things up used his legs more effectively and got an offense that was mostly stuck in the mud early into gear daniels guided the commanders to back to back fourth quarter touchdown drives using a slew of quick passes to knife through a good eagles d however a two point attempt shovel pass to tight end john bates was doa as the commanders fell shy new offensive coordinator david blough would probably like that call back returning after an injury riddled 2025 campaign to face a stout philly d in a new offense was a tough first ask for daniels washington s offense has a lot to clean up moving forward but at least the offensive line didn t get the qb killed allowing just two qb hits and one sack baun swarms for fangio s defense philly s lack of consistent pass rush is a concern especially given the state of the commanders offensive line yet linebacker zack baun continued to anchor the middle of the defense the pro bowler flew all over the field gobbling up 12 tackles including one for loss and generated the eagles only two passes defensed on the day baun stood out among a philly d that was solid but not otherworldly as they ve been cooper dejean got worked at times allowing seven catches on nine targets in coverage for 83 yards and a td the pass rush went silent for stretches and didn t provide enough pop the middle of the d led by jalen carter jordan davis and moro ojomo however was solid combining for 13 tackles two run stuffs and ojomo destroyed the two point attempt the eagles held the commanders to 295 total yards the 19th game holding their opponent under 300 yards since vic fangio took over in 2024 second in the nfl behind the seahawks 21 next gen stats insight for commanders eagles via nfl pro jalen hurts to win each of his first six career season openers joining jim harbaugh mike shanahan potsy clark and hall of famer george allen back to top grant gordon s takeaways what a way to kick off the harbaugh era jaxson dart was back so too were malik nabers and cam skattebo each of them making contributions to knock off the rival cowboys in head coach john harbaugh s gotham debut facing a franchise that popularized the triplets term the giants young franchise trio of dart nabers and skattebo proved to be the offensive catalyst buoyed by their defense forcing an opening three and out the giants offense responded with a 10 play 83 yard scoring march in which dart used his arm and legs to guide them when the quarterback took a dirty and savage hit along the sideline that drew a flag his teammates surrounded him in unity dart was marvelous to the tune of 23 of 29 passing for 230 yards three touchdowns and 54 rushing yards nabers six receptions for 69 yards got his first licks out of the way coming back from a torn acl and meniscus that had sidelined him since week 4 of last year after his opening score skattebo coming back from a busted ankle predictably backflipped and proceeded to churn out 81 hard yards this was the start harbaugh and the franchise needed and wanted their young guns were firing against a hated adversary this wasn t a pretty game too many penalties too many fumbles some drops but for harbaugh and new york it was a beautiful result for the franchise s new dawn cowboys start big season with dud brian schottenheimer dak prescott and co haven t shied away from proclaiming their belief that they can and will be going to the super bowl an uncharacteristically drama free offseason helped to fuel the confidence but dallas fell flat to start the season with an surprisingly dreadful offensive performance that equated to a loss to a division rival it s used to dominating deep into the fourth quarter prescott s offense had less than 200 yards ceedee lamb and george pickens had bad drops prescott 175 yards two touchdowns had an ugly interception and everything looked off even when the cowboys made it a one score game javonte williams foolishly drew an unsportsmanlike penalty on his touchdown catch high hopes aren t shot down in week 1 but dallas was reminded nothing s coming easy and these cowboys aren t riding into the sunset anytime soon if they don t execute to their potential harbaugh giants hold tight john harbaugh s time in baltimore came to a close after his 19th season with the campaign ending well short of expectations thanks to five one score losses and three blown fourth quarter leads in 2025 the first of those was a bitter 41 40 loss to the bills on sunday night to open the campaign last september the 2025 giants meanwhile blew an incredible five fourth quarter leads in a victory symbolic of exorcising the ghosts of blown leads past these giants held on when the cowboys cut the deficit to the final score big blue s second year qb found his most fitting target isaiah likely who converted a third and 9 with a 12 yard pick up likely converted another third down later on the drive before skattebo salted away the win with the final first down needed likely a longtime former raven had a game high eight catches for 78 yards and two scores in so many ways this is a great vibes win for new york as it aims to build a winner next gen stats insight for cowboys giants via nfl pro odell beckham playing his first game with the giants since dec 12 2018 played 11 snaps with seven routes run and second time in such instances back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top
