news_mentions.headline: Broncos-Chiefs on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Kansas City's 31-10 win
news_mentions.description: After failing to win the AFC West last season for the first time in a decade, the Kansas City Chiefs kicked off the new campaign by dominating the Denver Broncos, who dethroned them in 2025.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth dials up the kc frequency roughly eight months after taking home super bowl lx mvp honors with the seahawks kenneth walker hit the kansas city ground running and didn t look back walker was sensational from start to finish commanding the spotlight in a performance that lends credence to this being very much a new look and new approach chiefs offense walker s first game in a chiefs uniform ended with him rushing for a career high 173 yards including a 60 yard touchdown run to go with a 2 yard touchdown catch on a forward toss from the triumphantly returning patrick mahomes how walker began the game was probably just as telling he carried it on the chiefs first four plays and seven total on an opening td march that ended with mahomes scrambling in for a 15 yard score the chiefs haven t had a 1 000 yard rusher since kareem hunt in 2017 the last season mahomes wasn t a starter while walker won the super bowl s top individual honor he did so because his former seahawks teammate zach charbonnet was injured for the majority of 2025 walker split carries though the chiefs surprisingly ran roughshod over the broncos defense with rookie emmett johnson and mahomes also chipping in here and there this was walker s night and a message on the marquee the chiefs are going to run the ball and walker will be a workhorse davis denver offense stymied as patrick mahomes made his much ballyhooed return after tearing his acl and lcl last season his former texas tech teammate davis webb was making his debut as the broncos play caller and offensive coordinator monday went much better for mahomes webb and broncos qb bo nix in his first game since breaking his ankle in the divisional round never found any consistent success kenneth walker s 191 total yards for the chiefs bested the broncos 176 nix looked sharper earlier passing than mahomes but it made no matter as the game wore on with denver shockingly held to nine first downs and its ground game non existent j k dobbins was the leading ground gainer with a meager 36 yards while nix s 19 yard td toss to evan engram to tie the game in the first quarter was really the last splash of any kind had by webb s offense after the chiefs vaulted ahead 21 7 on a stellar 60 yard gallop by walker in the third quarter mahomes was picked off by brandon jones on the chiefs ensuing drive set up at the kc 5 yard line nix and the offense went backward and settled for a 31 yard field goal by wil lutz denver s last points of the game with such high expectations and such a disastrous debut for webb and the offense one has to wonder how long head coach sean payton will wait until snatching the offensive reins back mahomes returns chiefs win somehow some way patrick mahomes return nine months to the day of ripping multiple ligaments was overshadowed by the debut of a soft spoken loud running kenneth walker nonetheless mahomes had his moments in a return to action that had more good than bad but was hardly vintage pat the first six points of the game were had by mahomes when he scrambled up the gut and dove head first for a 15 yard touchdown carrying his hulking left knee brace along with him if any of the score s symbolism was lost mahomes made sure to underscore it by flexing his right arm to the camera he was back strong as ever the three time super bowl mvp showed some unease in the pocket though often more comfortable perhaps surprisingly on the move and was at times woefully inaccurate he finished 15 of 27 for 184 yards two touchdowns and an interception he hit rashee rice on a screen that the receiver took in for a 13 yard score and his td pass to walker was an underhand toss there is plenty more for mahomes to show to prove the mahomes of old is back with walker in place though andy reid has made it known that the chiefs are changing gears this no longer has to be mahomes carrying the entire offense on his shoulders and surgically repaired knee he can progress week by week and the chiefs can still be viable they were dominant on monday thanks to walker and a stellar defensive performance most importantly mahomes is back and the chiefs returned to the winner s circle in his return stopping a three game skid against the broncos and an overall six game losing streak dating back to last season broncos d is no show for as problematic as the broncos offensive showing was their defensive performance was perhaps more worrisome bo nix and the offense beyond perhaps one of the better offensive lines in the game is truly still a work in progress vance joseph s defense is coming off back to back seasons as the no 3 unit in points allowed yet the chiefs dominated them in humbling fashion by running them over most troubling was that this vaunted group that s eyeing setting all time sack records was absolutely horrendous in its tackling or lack thereof eight broncos missed multiple tackles per next gen stats as a whole denver missed 28 tackles giving up 247 yards on those missed tackles which is the most by any defense since at least 2018 per ngs many were of the mind that if nix wasn t injured in the playoffs denver might well have advanced to the super bowl last season thusly many believed the broncos could be super bowl bound this year well denver got nix back but this certainly looked nothing like the defense of the last two seasons chiefs rookies show promise as uneven as patrick mahomes was passing the ball when he connected with travis kelce for a 59 yarder in the third quarter it was a snapshot of the glory days of the chiefs dynasty that really wasn t that long ago kansas city s win had plenty to do with new faces though most obvious was kenneth walker but undrafted free agent kahlil benson starting at left tackle where he didn t play in college and presented the team s biggest question mark was stellar in 32 pass block snaps he allowed just one qb pressure rookie second rounder r mason thomas had a pair of qb pressures and one of the chiefs four sacks first round pick mansoor delane had an interception before exiting with a shoulder injury which was easily the largest negative for the chiefs on the evening shifty rookie running back emmett johnson put together 68 scrimmage yards and the refurbishing of the chiefs after a 6 11 season is off and running with faces old and new making valuable contributions against an afc heavyweight next gen stats insight for broncos chiefs via nfl pro bo nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropacks the second highest pressure rate faced in his career nfl research kenneth walker had a career high 191 scrimmage yards in his chiefs debut the most scrimmage yards by a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 surpassing the previous record of 180 set by hall of famer jerry rice in 1989 walker s career best 173 rushing yards in week 1 are second by a veteran player in their debut with a new team behind michael turner s 220 yard performance in his 2008 debut with the falcons

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs' Travis Kelce moves into second place for all-time tight end receiving yards
news_mentions.description: Travis Kelce moved into second place all-time for receiving yards by a tight end during the Chiefs’ season opener Monday night against the Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: it was quite a milestone offseason for travis kelce the kansas city chiefs tight end wasted no time in making it a milestone regular season as well kelce moved into second all time for receiving yards by a tight end during the chiefs 31 10 season opening monday night win over the denver broncos predictably kelce downplayed the individual milestone when speaking to espn s laura rutledge after the game it s a good feeling to get this win all the other stuff is just hoopla now he said kelce caught a 59 yard pass from old friend patrick mahomes in the third quarter to put him past longtime dallas cowboys stalwart jason witten for second all time ahead of monday s season opener kelce had 13 002 yards needing 45 to surpass witten 13 046 the catch was a turn back the clock moment for kelce standing as his longest reception since week 15 2021 when he turned in a 69 yarder versus the los angeles chargers it was a memorable way to begin kelce s 14th and perhaps final season the three time super bowl winner now trails only hall of famer tony gonzalez 15 127 in receiving yards by a tight end though the 36 year old s career is winding down his star status is not thanks in large part to his recent nuptials to pop megastar taylor swift a no doubt future hall of famer kelce an 11 time pro bowler and four time all pro ranks fifth among tight ends with 82 touchdowns and third in receptions 1 083 among his other notable accomplishments kelce has the most 100 yard games by a tight end 38 and his 1 416 yards in 2020 remaining a single season best at the position kelce s earned another tip of the helmet for what s been an astounding career but this season is just beginning as he aims to help his chiefs return to prior heavyweight status

news_mentions.headline: 5 storylines to know from Week 1 of 2026 season: Bears, Ravens amaze and a tale of two LaFleurs
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at five key storylines to know from Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: the first week of the nfl season plays out as a mirage offering glimpses of thirst quenching promise for a football starved diaspora with a minuscule sample things aren t always what they seem after one game in a gauntlet of a season remember a year ago when the raiders knocked off the patriots in week 1 in foxborough las vegas wound up with the no 1 overall pick new england played in the super bowl week 1 lies like a toddler who just doesn t know any better as the young season wears on there will be twists plummets and vaults teams that looked good on sunday will falter clubs that struggled out of the gate will find a groove with franchises mostly holding starters out of preseason action many tilts around the nfl looked like exhibition matches early in particular some squads breaking in new coordinators philly and washington come to mind looked like they had a lot of kinks to iron out no one won a lombardi trophy on sunday no one lost one either the first sunday was an important first step in the march to february but it s not the be all and end all each monday during the season i ll take a look at five key storylines from sunday s slate of contests starting today with week 1 s points a palooza and including john harbaugh s prime time win in his n y debut josh allen bills exorcising demons in houston a tale of two lafleurs for arizona and green bay sunday s big day for star rbs around the nfl 1 sunday s points bonanza has nfl on brink of history yesterday s 13 games averaged 53 3 points the highest scoring week 1 sunday in league history per nfl research entering monday night football the average for the entire week 1 slate is 50 0 points per game which if it holds tonight when the denver broncos take on the kansas city chiefs would mark a super bowl era record six tilts on sunday saw at least 60 combined points i d like to highlight two teams that particularly stood out on offense baltimore and chicago new ravens oc declan doyle actually spent last season on ben johnson s bears staff so perhaps it shouldn t be too surprising that baltimore authored the most explosive output beyond chicago lamar jackson looked like his two time mvp self zipping darts into open windows escaping sure sacks for first downs and looking far fresher and less frazzled than he did last year his rapport with zay flowers was otherworldly before the wideout left with a hamstring injury assuming the issue doesn t linger nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that the setback isn t considered serious the duo could be something special this season doyle did an excellent job mixing up his calls schemed players open for easy jackson reads and kept the colts off balance add in that derrick henry still runs like he s 25 years old bulldozing his way to 144 yards and three tds for his own record setting day and baltimore s offense looked deadly in putting up 41 points in a blowout win at indianapolis the sample is small but if the ravens can stay healthy a big if they could eat up points meanwhile johnson entered the season saying he wanted to employ the best offense in league history the bears went out and showed they have the horses to do so in a 59 37 win at carolina after the game chicago s second year head coach doubled down on the ambition that will always be the goal johnson said we want to be the highest scoring we want to have the most wins we want to win super bowls that s what we do we didn t get into this profession trying to be mediocre or average sure it came against a panthers defense that entered the season with significant questions after making splashes in free agency to upgrade the unit but the base of what transpired sunday in charlotte is replicable perhaps the bears won t put up 59 points and 552 yards with two rushers hitting the century mark but johnson s offense proved it can score from anywhere on the field caleb williams shut down questions about whether the offseason hype would prove unfounded the madden cover athlete built on his 2025 breakout season made some incredible throws and used his legs as a weapon williams is the first player in bears history with at least 200 passing yards two passing touchdowns 50 rushing yards and two rushing tds in a single game per nfl research he is the third player over the last five seasons to reach those marks in a single game joining the bills josh allen three times and the eagles jalen hurts two times the qb can still improve against pressure 0 for 5 passing with two sacks on 13 pressured dropbacks per next gen stats but the 72 4 completion rate is what stood out it s a figure he never really came close to in his first season under johnson the question all offseason was if williams could smooth out the rough patches and become more consistent down to down sunday was an excellent step in that direction 2 john harbaugh era gets off to roaring start the giants actually looked like a professional operation on sunday night for the first time in a while the mistakes and roller coaster play that had come to define the club were smoothed into effective showings on both sides of the ball harbaugh s squad ran efficiently on offense taking advantage of a cowboys defense that hasn t fixed all its issues from last season and blocked very well and the defense while having some hiccups in the secondary was mostly on the spot in allowing 244 total yards for the game the most notable improvement came from under center where jaxson dart played the most proficient game of his career the qb logged his first career outing with three or more pass touchdowns and zero interceptions dart 23 is the youngest player to accomplish the feat in a week 1 prime time game and the first under the age of 25 to do so since patrick mahomes 2020 vs texans as a rookie dart showed he could make backyard plays big time throws and gash defenses with his legs however it always felt helter skelter his hair always on fire on sunday night the second year qb looked calm smooth and never out of sync dart was content to make the cowboys pay for poor coverage not forcing balls or hunting big plays he showed he could make the ho hum play needed to elevate an offense sometimes boring qb play is the best qb play add in malik nabers return from last year s season ending injury six catches for 69 yards on a team high nine targets and it was a smashing opening night at metlife stadium 3 bills exorcise houston demons in joe brady s first game as head coach the last two times josh allen and the bills traveled to houston things ended poorly in last year s meeting allen was crunched taking a career high eight sacks and throwing two ints in the loss with that backdrop on sunday the joe brady era took flight facing what was expected to be one of the best defenses in football if not the best allen ripped passes through the texans secondary the buffalo o line did a smashing job against a beast of a front after the bills allowed eight sacks last year in houston allen faced just nine total pressures this time and took two sacks the qb was 5 of 7 passing for 85 yards under pressure per next gen stats in total allen completed 20 of his 29 pass attempts for 334 yards and two touchdowns in the bills week 1 win against the texans adding another two scores with his legs allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest in a game since week 18 of 2022 the star signal caller completed 11 of his 16 passes of 10 plus air yards with two tds the 286 downfield passing yards were the most the texans have allowed in a game since demeco ryans took over as head coach in 2023 per nfl research as always allen got away with a few iffy balls i e kamari lassiter s dropped int late but the good outweighed the bad and houston failed to capitalize on the mistakes buffalo s 36 points represented the most a ryans led defense has given up since his first season in houston with brady being elevated from oc to the big chair it was worth wondering how much the offense might change with the restrictor plate off it s just one week but with the addition of dj moore 5 100 1 and the healthy status of dalton kincaid 5 130 the bills offense leaned on allen and splashed big play after big play coming against ryans defense it was a massive statement 4 good lafleur bad lafleur the stunner of the week came in los angeles where the cardinals handled jim harbaugh s chargers a trendy pick to go deep in the playoffs the true shocker wasn t that the cards whose projected win total entering the season was roughly four pulled off the upset it was that they controlled much of the tilt new head coach mike lafleur showed a deft hand in deploying his array of weapons keeping the bolts defense off balance the offensive line held up well and jacoby brissett once again showed that he s a professional quarterback who s unafraid to attack completing 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards per next gen stats if the cards can keep this up while avoiding turnovers they ll be a pest brissett has proven he can fling it around the park and he looked comfortable in lafleur s offense the cardinals defense which is solid on paper but hasn t been able to stay healthy in recent years held justin herbert and the mike mcdaniel led offense to 268 total yards and 17 first downs the d also forced two turnovers and gobbled up three sacks add in a blocked punt by the special teams and it was a three phase win in lafleur s first game we ve seen this show before where teams expected to be bad show up in week 1 and surprise last year arizona won its season opener before ultimately finishing 3 14 i don t expect a similar crash it s just one week but lafleur showed he can coach and the cards displayed they have the talent to be frisky if they can stay healthy with games against the seahawks and 49ers on tap they ll have a chance to prove week 1 was more than just a flash in the pan the other lafleur brother didn t fare so well packers hc matt lafleur watched a 12 point third quarter lead disintegrate in minnesota against backup vikings quarterback carson wentz who played the majority of the game after kyler murray suffered a concussion in the first half yes several questionable penalties went against the packers but flags didn t cause the rest of the miscues from the moment the elder lafleur took three points off the board in the fourth quarter to fall short on a fourth and 1 play the packers crumbled we re gonna be aggressive and we re gonna try to go for the throat in that situation matt lafleur said of the decision they missed the throat and stabbed their own leg the offensive line completely fell apart in the face of brian flores relentless pressure minnesota had a 78 3 blitz rate on jordan love dropbacks the fourth highest figure by a defense in a game since at least 2018 per next gen stats love fumbled deep in his own territory and later threw an int to cap off the fourth quarter collapse blown leads in winnable games have become a staple under matt lafleur sunday s flop was of the epic variety the vikings who scored 29 unanswered points became the first team in nfl history to trail by 12 plus points with under 20 minutes left in regulation and win by 17 plus points per nfl research speaking of minnesota wentz proved kevin o connell made the correct call in naming him the backup over j j mccarthy he s not a perfect qb but the veteran plays well enough in koc s offense to move the ball 5 big time day for lead rbs running backs got paid this offseason then went on to prove the investments were worth it sunday saw a trove of rbs scamper all over defenses the top of the charts was a veritable who s who of workhorses jahmyr gibbs led all players with 34 touches 186 scrimmage yards and 156 rushing yards he also forced 12 missed tackles the most in any game of his career after the contest gibbs suggested he could ve had 40 touches if needed currently he s on pace for a ridiculous 578 touches the all time record is 492 by james wilder in 1984 derrick henry galloped for 144 rushing yards and three tds on 24 totes and finished with 163 scrimmage yards give the ravens revamped o line some love henry finished with 110 yards before contact against the colts the third highest single game total of his career he was hit at the line of scrimmage on just 8 3 of his carries the lowest rate of his ravens career bijan robinson generated 173 scrimmage yards including 90 receiving yards most among all rbs through sunday robinson accounted for 65 8 of the falcons yards from scrimmage in week 1 the highest share by any player in a team s season opener since rams rb eric dickerson 66 6 in 1986 d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai formed a two headed monster for chicago the former gobbled up 124 rushing yards and three rushing tds while the latter scampered for 100 yards with a 61 yard td rumble add in caleb williams ground effort 65 yards two tds and the bears became the fourth team in the super bowl era to have three players with at least 65 rushing yards and at least one rushing touchdown in the same game first trio to include a qb per nfl research the last team to accomplish the feat was the 2013 rams in week 12 with wr tavon austin and rbs benny cunningham and zac stacy ashton jeanty gobbled up 147 scrimmage yards 102 rushing yards with 45 receiving yards team high and two td catches in the 27 13 win over miami jeanty generated 73 rushing yards after contact the third most in his career his three explosive runs of 10 plus yards tied for the second most in a game in his career pretty good for a player who suffered an ankle injury three weeks ago breece hall scampered for 102 rushing yards and a td and added two catches for 16 yards in the jets romp at tennessee perhaps most notable in gang green s revamped offense 17 of hall s 22 rushing attempts came with geno smith under center accounting for 85 yards and a td including three explosive runs tied for a career high per next gen stats jonathan taylor paced the colts offense with 121 scrimmage yards including 98 rushing yards and two rushing scores in the loss to baltimore it marked taylor s 14th career game with 100 plus scrimmage yards and two plus rushing touchdowns tying him with hall of famer edgerrin james for the most such games in colts franchise history david montgomery didn t put up gaudy rushing or scrimmage numbers in houston s loss 79 scrimmage yards 60 rushing 19 receiving but was one of just three players to score three scrimmage tds 2 rushing 1 receiving on sunday alongside derrick henry and d andre swift

news_mentions.headline: Broncos vs. Chiefs: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 1 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs.
news_mentions.body_text: monday night football opens up with a doozy pitting the reigning afc west champions against the squad that dominated the division with nine straight first place finishes before finally losing the throne how will the broncos fare at long last being chased rather than acting as the chasers denver topped the afc west in 2025 and finished as the top seed in the conference by going 14 3 despite their mighty record they ll kick off the new campaign fighting against a regression narrative the broncos had 11 one possession wins last year tying the 2024 chiefs and 2022 vikings two clubs that would go on to miss the playoffs the following season for the most in nfl history their opponents the chiefs will be looking to pick themselves back up after a shocking six win campaign that marked their first losing season since 2012 was it a true sign of the end or simply the setup to a redemptive chapter in kansas city s dynasty beating the broncos who bested them in a pair of one possession games last year would nudge the answer toward the latter these two teams will meet again in week 8 when we have a much clearer picture of where their seasons are heading but first they ll have a chance to set the tone in a star studded week 1 finale three must know storylines 1 both qbs are coming off major injuries patrick mahomes is set to make his much anticipated return after tearing his acl in week 15 last season his reward for working his way back to the field in roughly nine months facing a ferocious denver defense that has led the league in sacks for two straight years he will also be without left tackle josh simmons due to a back injury putting undrafted rookie kahlil benson in line to serve as his blindside blocker it s a heck of a test but the two time most valuable player is as capable as anyone of working his way through it whereas mahomes didn t play at all in the preseason bo nix suited up for two drives in denver s second preseason game as part of his process of coming back from a broken ankle suffered in the divisional round he looked comfortable in the limited action going 6 of 9 for 76 yards and a touchdown but he wasn t required to move around a ton and test out his mobility it ll be the real deal against the chiefs who will do their best to flush him out and make him uncomfortable 2 broncos chiefs taking different backfield approaches denver enters the season with a deep versatile running back room j k dobbins and rj harvey who combined for 1 705 scrimmage yards and 16 scores last season are back atop the depth chart dobbins is the better all around back but he s struggled to stay on the field throughout his career as evidenced by the running back missing the broncos final nine games last season including playoffs he nonetheless led the team in rushing yards as harvey proved dynamic in the passing game but took time to find his footing they won t be powering denver s ground game alone though despite being listed third on the depth chart rookie jonah coleman has the talent to carve out a role sooner rather than later giving sean payton three ball carriers with which to attack kansas city s front the chiefs are likely to feature more of a solo act after missing out on playing in the super bowl for just the second time in seven years they signed the super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker it s been a while since andy reid s chiefs utilized a true workhorse running back such as when kareem hunt shouldered the load during his first stint in kansas city or jamaal charles spearheaded the attack during reid s early years with the club both produced tremendous results and now 2026 figures to be the kwiii show he ll play a vital role in helping the offense function at a high level while patrick mahomes gets fully back to himself 3 broncos upgraded passing attack vs chiefs new look secondary after finishing last season with an offense that ranked just above average 14th in points scored the broncos went out and traded for an x factor jaylen waddle the perception of waddle might have taken a bit of a hit first as he took a backseat to tyreek hill in miami and then as the dolphins offense waned in effectiveness the past couple years but he is a highly efficient pass catching weapon in three of the past four seasons waddle has finished as a top 15 wr in yards per route twice ranking in the top six per nfl pro he is the perfect complement to courtland sutton and there were rave reviews of pat bryant out of camp too the trio s task will be to dismantle a kansas city secondary transformed by the offseason the chiefs defense lost six players who started 10 plus games last season including safety bryan cook cornerback jaylen watson and cb trent mcduffie k c let the former two walk in free agency and traded mcduffie to the rams part of a recurring strategy by general manager brett veach to reshuffle his secondary rather than pay big money extensions he did the same in 2024 with l 39 jarius sneed who is back and joined by 2026 no 6 overall pick mansoor delane and free agent signing alohi gilman as part of the new look defensive backfield the difference in the game could come down to which revamped group starts the season stronger

news_mentions.headline: Report: Texans, QB C.J. Stroud tabling extension talks until after season
news_mentions.description: After previously attempting to reach an extension, the Houston Texans and QB C.J. Stroud have agreed to table negotiations until after this season, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: c j stroud won t be among those striking a deadline deal ahead of sunday of week 1 after previously attempting to reach an extension the houston texans and their quarterback have agreed to pause negotiations until after this season nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported saturday stroud set to turn 25 on oct 3 is heading into his fourth season with the texans and despite discussions there doesn t need to be a great rush to get something done unlike tampa bay buccaneers qb baker mayfield and green bay packers tight end tucker kraft who each signed extensions this week to avoid playing out 2026 on a contract year stroud has two seasons remaining on his rookie deal after houston picked up his fifth year option the quarterback market is forever climbing topped by the kansas city chiefs patrick mahomes 64 million per year salary so stroud stands to make more money as long as he s patient and proves himself worthy of such a lucrative deal stroud s upcoming campaign will be crucial in regard to the latter element of the equation after winning offensive rookie of the year in 2023 with 4 108 passing yards 23 touchdowns and five interceptions stroud has played far more unevenly the past two seasons he s thrown for 6 768 yards 39 tds and 20 ints since 2024 with an 89 6 passer rating compared to his 100 8 rating as a rookie while it was uncharacteristic of a qb who still adeptly managed his squad to three playoff trips in three tries stroud melted down in his most recent postseason tossing five picks and fumbling five times across two games the texans have done nothing but sing his praises since though with countless players and personnel backing the qb should stroud rebound in year 4 and perhaps help shatter the divisional round ceiling that has limited houston in recent trips it ll only up his worth when the sides come back to the table stroud and houston kick off the 26 season with a heavyweight bout against the buffalo bills on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (knee) has no injury status, cleared for comeback Monday night vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Patrick Mahomes, nine months removed from tearing his ACL and LCL, has no injury designation and will start for his Chiefs on Monday night against the visiting Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: patrick mahomes is cleared for his comeback launch mahomes nine months removed from tearing his acl and lcl has no injury designation and will start for his kansas city chiefs on monday night against the visiting denver broncos this has been the goal all offseason for mahomes and the expectation as of late the three time super bowl winner was a full participant throughout the thursday saturday practice week while a major hurdle has been cleared for mahomes just how he performs on his surgically repaired knee is a question still left to be answered he ll have a tall task facing the broncos reigning afc west champions denver is bolstered by a stellar nik bonitto led pass rush and the chiefs are set to start undrafted free agent kahlil benson at left tackle in place of an injured josh simmons kansas city is coming off a 6 11 season in which it failed to make the playoffs for the first time since 2014 and had its streak of nine straight afc west titles snapped mahomes who had never fallen short of the postseason much less a division title until last season had his worst passing season statistically since becoming the chiefs starter in 2018 denver swept kansas city in 2025 though mahomes missed the second tilt after he tore multiple ligaments in week 15 against the los angeles chargers over 14 starts mahomes threw for 3 587 yards 22 touchdowns and 11 interceptions a six time pro bowler and three time super bowl mvp mahomes is set to begin his 10th year and age 31 season with his birthday right around the corner on sept 17 with mahomes and the chiefs looking for a massive comeback season the quarterback will make his eighth straight week 1 start when kansas city kicks off against denver at 8 15 p m et monday

news_mentions.headline: Bucs-Bengals features NFL's two biggest wild cards in 2026; plus, three bounce-back teams
news_mentions.description: Are the two NFL teams with the widest range of outcomes in 2026 meeting in Week 1? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks breaks down a pair of true wild cards. Plus, three bounce-back candidates.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three teams that could make the playoffs after falling short last season but first a look at two genuine wild cards in 2026 in my opinion the cincinnati bengals enter this season with the widest range of potential outcomes in the afc i can envision cincy seriously competing for the lombardi trophy or missing the playoffs for a fourth straight year and in the nfc that team is the tampa bay buccaneers the bucs entered last season with hype and started out 6 2 but then they came apart after the bye ultimately finishing with a losing record and watching the postseason from home ironically these two teams open the 2026 season against each other with the bengals hosting the bucs at paycor stadium on sunday so one of them will get off on the right foot while the other will start the new campaign with a stumble but what s the long view on each squad can both realize their upside in the coming months here are my thoughts three bounce back candidates the bengals and buccaneers aren t the only teams with the potential to return to the postseason after a playoff free 2025 campaign here are three talented squads that could rebound in a major way in 2026

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top
