news_mentions.headline: 5 storylines to know from Week 1 of 2026 season: Bears, Ravens amaze and a tale of two LaFleurs
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at five key storylines to know from Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: the first week of the nfl season plays out as a mirage offering glimpses of thirst quenching promise for a football starved diaspora with a minuscule sample things aren t always what they seem after one game in a gauntlet of a season remember a year ago when the raiders knocked off the patriots in week 1 in foxborough las vegas wound up with the no 1 overall pick new england played in the super bowl week 1 lies like a toddler who just doesn t know any better as the young season wears on there will be twists plummets and vaults teams that looked good on sunday will falter clubs that struggled out of the gate will find a groove with franchises mostly holding starters out of preseason action many tilts around the nfl looked like exhibition matches early in particular some squads breaking in new coordinators philly and washington come to mind looked like they had a lot of kinks to iron out no one won a lombardi trophy on sunday no one lost one either the first sunday was an important first step in the march to february but it s not the be all and end all each monday during the season i ll take a look at five key storylines from sunday s slate of contests starting today with week 1 s points a palooza and including john harbaugh s prime time win in his n y debut josh allen bills exorcising demons in houston a tale of two lafleurs for arizona and green bay sunday s big day for star rbs around the nfl 1 sunday s points bonanza has nfl on brink of history yesterday s 13 games averaged 53 3 points the highest scoring week 1 sunday in league history per nfl research entering monday night football the average for the entire week 1 slate is 50 0 points per game which if it holds tonight when the denver broncos take on the kansas city chiefs would mark a super bowl era record six tilts on sunday saw at least 60 combined points i d like to highlight two teams that particularly stood out on offense baltimore and chicago new ravens oc declan doyle actually spent last season on ben johnson s bears staff so perhaps it shouldn t be too surprising that baltimore authored the most explosive output beyond chicago lamar jackson looked like his two time mvp self zipping darts into open windows escaping sure sacks for first downs and looking far fresher and less frazzled than he did last year his rapport with zay flowers was otherworldly before the wideout left with a hamstring injury assuming the issue doesn t linger nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that the setback isn t considered serious the duo could be something special this season doyle did an excellent job mixing up his calls schemed players open for easy jackson reads and kept the colts off balance add in that derrick henry still runs like he s 25 years old bulldozing his way to 144 yards and three tds for his own record setting day and baltimore s offense looked deadly in putting up 41 points in a blowout win at indianapolis the sample is small but if the ravens can stay healthy a big if they could eat up points meanwhile johnson entered the season saying he wanted to employ the best offense in league history the bears went out and showed they have the horses to do so in a 59 37 win at carolina after the game chicago s second year head coach doubled down on the ambition that will always be the goal johnson said we want to be the highest scoring we want to have the most wins we want to win super bowls that s what we do we didn t get into this profession trying to be mediocre or average sure it came against a panthers defense that entered the season with significant questions after making splashes in free agency to upgrade the unit but the base of what transpired sunday in charlotte is replicable perhaps the bears won t put up 59 points and 552 yards with two rushers hitting the century mark but johnson s offense proved it can score from anywhere on the field caleb williams shut down questions about whether the offseason hype would prove unfounded the madden cover athlete built on his 2025 breakout season made some incredible throws and used his legs as a weapon williams is the first player in bears history with at least 200 passing yards two passing touchdowns 50 rushing yards and two rushing tds in a single game per nfl research he is the third player over the last five seasons to reach those marks in a single game joining the bills josh allen three times and the eagles jalen hurts two times the qb can still improve against pressure 0 for 5 passing with two sacks on 13 pressured dropbacks per next gen stats but the 72 4 completion rate is what stood out it s a figure he never really came close to in his first season under johnson the question all offseason was if williams could smooth out the rough patches and become more consistent down to down sunday was an excellent step in that direction 2 john harbaugh era gets off to roaring start the giants actually looked like a professional operation on sunday night for the first time in a while the mistakes and roller coaster play that had come to define the club were smoothed into effective showings on both sides of the ball harbaugh s squad ran efficiently on offense taking advantage of a cowboys defense that hasn t fixed all its issues from last season and blocked very well and the defense while having some hiccups in the secondary was mostly on the spot in allowing 244 total yards for the game the most notable improvement came from under center where jaxson dart played the most proficient game of his career the qb logged his first career outing with three or more pass touchdowns and zero interceptions dart 23 is the youngest player to accomplish the feat in a week 1 prime time game and the first under the age of 25 to do so since patrick mahomes 2020 vs texans as a rookie dart showed he could make backyard plays big time throws and gash defenses with his legs however it always felt helter skelter his hair always on fire on sunday night the second year qb looked calm smooth and never out of sync dart was content to make the cowboys pay for poor coverage not forcing balls or hunting big plays he showed he could make the ho hum play needed to elevate an offense sometimes boring qb play is the best qb play add in malik nabers return from last year s season ending injury six catches for 69 yards on a team high nine targets and it was a smashing opening night at metlife stadium 3 bills exorcise houston demons in joe brady s first game as head coach the last two times josh allen and the bills traveled to houston things ended poorly in last year s meeting allen was crunched taking a career high eight sacks and throwing two ints in the loss with that backdrop on sunday the joe brady era took flight facing what was expected to be one of the best defenses in football if not the best allen ripped passes through the texans secondary the buffalo o line did a smashing job against a beast of a front after the bills allowed eight sacks last year in houston allen faced just nine total pressures this time and took two sacks the qb was 5 of 7 passing for 85 yards under pressure per next gen stats in total allen completed 20 of his 29 pass attempts for 334 yards and two touchdowns in the bills week 1 win against the texans adding another two scores with his legs allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest in a game since week 18 of 2022 the star signal caller completed 11 of his 16 passes of 10 plus air yards with two tds the 286 downfield passing yards were the most the texans have allowed in a game since demeco ryans took over as head coach in 2023 per nfl research as always allen got away with a few iffy balls i e kamari lassiter s dropped int late but the good outweighed the bad and houston failed to capitalize on the mistakes buffalo s 36 points represented the most a ryans led defense has given up since his first season in houston with brady being elevated from oc to the big chair it was worth wondering how much the offense might change with the restrictor plate off it s just one week but with the addition of dj moore 5 100 1 and the healthy status of dalton kincaid 5 130 the bills offense leaned on allen and splashed big play after big play coming against ryans defense it was a massive statement 4 good lafleur bad lafleur the stunner of the week came in los angeles where the cardinals handled jim harbaugh s chargers a trendy pick to go deep in the playoffs the true shocker wasn t that the cards whose projected win total entering the season was roughly four pulled off the upset it was that they controlled much of the tilt new head coach mike lafleur showed a deft hand in deploying his array of weapons keeping the bolts defense off balance the offensive line held up well and jacoby brissett once again showed that he s a professional quarterback who s unafraid to attack completing 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards per next gen stats if the cards can keep this up while avoiding turnovers they ll be a pest brissett has proven he can fling it around the park and he looked comfortable in lafleur s offense the cardinals defense which is solid on paper but hasn t been able to stay healthy in recent years held justin herbert and the mike mcdaniel led offense to 268 total yards and 17 first downs the d also forced two turnovers and gobbled up three sacks add in a blocked punt by the special teams and it was a three phase win in lafleur s first game we ve seen this show before where teams expected to be bad show up in week 1 and surprise last year arizona won its season opener before ultimately finishing 3 14 i don t expect a similar crash it s just one week but lafleur showed he can coach and the cards displayed they have the talent to be frisky if they can stay healthy with games against the seahawks and 49ers on tap they ll have a chance to prove week 1 was more than just a flash in the pan the other lafleur brother didn t fare so well packers hc matt lafleur watched a 12 point third quarter lead disintegrate in minnesota against backup vikings quarterback carson wentz who played the majority of the game after kyler murray suffered a concussion in the first half yes several questionable penalties went against the packers but flags didn t cause the rest of the miscues from the moment the elder lafleur took three points off the board in the fourth quarter to fall short on a fourth and 1 play the packers crumbled we re gonna be aggressive and we re gonna try to go for the throat in that situation matt lafleur said of the decision they missed the throat and stabbed their own leg the offensive line completely fell apart in the face of brian flores relentless pressure minnesota had a 78 3 blitz rate on jordan love dropbacks the fourth highest figure by a defense in a game since at least 2018 per next gen stats love fumbled deep in his own territory and later threw an int to cap off the fourth quarter collapse blown leads in winnable games have become a staple under matt lafleur sunday s flop was of the epic variety the vikings who scored 29 unanswered points became the first team in nfl history to trail by 12 plus points with under 20 minutes left in regulation and win by 17 plus points per nfl research speaking of minnesota wentz proved kevin o connell made the correct call in naming him the backup over j j mccarthy he s not a perfect qb but the veteran plays well enough in koc s offense to move the ball 5 big time day for lead rbs running backs got paid this offseason then went on to prove the investments were worth it sunday saw a trove of rbs scamper all over defenses the top of the charts was a veritable who s who of workhorses jahmyr gibbs led all players with 34 touches 186 scrimmage yards and 156 rushing yards he also forced 12 missed tackles the most in any game of his career after the contest gibbs suggested he could ve had 40 touches if needed currently he s on pace for a ridiculous 578 touches the all time record is 492 by james wilder in 1984 derrick henry galloped for 144 rushing yards and three tds on 24 totes and finished with 163 scrimmage yards give the ravens revamped o line some love henry finished with 110 yards before contact against the colts the third highest single game total of his career he was hit at the line of scrimmage on just 8 3 of his carries the lowest rate of his ravens career bijan robinson generated 173 scrimmage yards including 90 receiving yards most among all rbs through sunday robinson accounted for 65 8 of the falcons yards from scrimmage in week 1 the highest share by any player in a team s season opener since rams rb eric dickerson 66 6 in 1986 d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai formed a two headed monster for chicago the former gobbled up 124 rushing yards and three rushing tds while the latter scampered for 100 yards with a 61 yard td rumble add in caleb williams ground effort 65 yards two tds and the bears became the fourth team in the super bowl era to have three players with at least 65 rushing yards and at least one rushing touchdown in the same game first trio to include a qb per nfl research the last team to accomplish the feat was the 2013 rams in week 12 with wr tavon austin and rbs benny cunningham and zac stacy ashton jeanty gobbled up 147 scrimmage yards 102 rushing yards with 45 receiving yards team high and two td catches in the 27 13 win over miami jeanty generated 73 rushing yards after contact the third most in his career his three explosive runs of 10 plus yards tied for the second most in a game in his career pretty good for a player who suffered an ankle injury three weeks ago breece hall scampered for 102 rushing yards and a td and added two catches for 16 yards in the jets romp at tennessee perhaps most notable in gang green s revamped offense 17 of hall s 22 rushing attempts came with geno smith under center accounting for 85 yards and a td including three explosive runs tied for a career high per next gen stats jonathan taylor paced the colts offense with 121 scrimmage yards including 98 rushing yards and two rushing scores in the loss to baltimore it marked taylor s 14th career game with 100 plus scrimmage yards and two plus rushing touchdowns tying him with hall of famer edgerrin james for the most such games in colts franchise history david montgomery didn t put up gaudy rushing or scrimmage numbers in houston s loss 79 scrimmage yards 60 rushing 19 receiving but was one of just three players to score three scrimmage tds 2 rushing 1 receiving on sunday alongside derrick henry and d andre swift

news_mentions.headline: Cowboys' Week 1 disaster: Dak Prescott's costly mistake and defensive issues (again)
news_mentions.body_text: east rutherford n j jerry jones acknowledged before the game that he was 34 anxious 34 and 34 nervous 34 about watching the dallas cowboys 39 season opener against the new york giants one of the last things he was probably concerned about was dak prescott the franchise quarterback was part of the biggest play sunday night at metlife stadium it wasn 39 t a good one his lone interception helped provide the giants with a spark that eventually turned into a 28 20 week 1 cowboys loss 34 that was crucial 34 prescott said 34 i was trying to throw the ball away the guy made a hell of a play i got to make sure that it 39 s out of bounds though i was surprised it 39 s one i want back obviously i think that was a huge point in the game 34 facing third and 5 with just under a minute left in the second quarter and the score tied 7 7 prescott was flushed out of the pocket drifting 17 yards behind the line of scrimmage when he threw off his back foot giants safety jevon holland made a sliding grab near the cowboys sideline new york scored six plays later taking a 14 7 lead into the halftime locker room the giants then received the second half kickoff and scored again 12 plays later 34 that was a big momentum swing 34 cowboys coach brian schottenheimer said of the interception the cowboys were never able to overcome that 21 7 deficit midway through the third quarter as they only had the ball for two possessions in the second half aside from the turnover prescott didn 39 t have a bad game the giants displayed a strong pass rush but he was never sacked he was accurate most of the night even when he wasn 39 t getting much help early from his top playmakers it was expected entering the season that with star wide receivers ceedee lamb and george pickens dallas would simply pick up where it left off a year ago as one of the nfl 39 s best offenses that didn 39 t happen sunday night pickens had two costly drops in the first half which was especially surprising because he was the cowboys 39 best training camp performer he didn 39 t have two drops all of camp but he had two on his first four targets against the giants the cowboys 39 top two offensive weapons had only 27 receiving yards in the first half with most of their big plays coming from drawing defensive pass interference calls pickens finished with only three catches for 28 yards lamb totaled five for 44 yards and a touchdown 34 it 39 ll get back to clicking 34 prescott said 34 those guys had some uncharacteristic drops i know that they 39 re upset about them immediately came and made a comment about them and they moved on as they should we 39 ll get back to it 34 if they don 39 t the season could quickly become a repeat of a year ago because the defense still has plenty of issues no one expected christian parker 39 s debut as defensive coordinator to go so poorly giants quarterback jaxson dart was outstanding completing 23 of 29 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing for 54 yards on 11 carries he never seemed rushed in his decision making as he constantly appeared to have all the answers to the test that 39 s concerning because that was a major issue for the cowboys a year ago under matt eberflus far too often opposing quarterbacks would have a career day against dallas 34 this defensive unit is really good 34 cowboys defensive tackle quinnen williams said 34 we got the guys to be accountable and get better 133 we can be better and we will be better 34 one of the biggest issues sunday night was how easily the giants were able to complete short passes into the flat for notable gains that clearly bothered schottenheimer 34 you got young players 34 he said 34 young player closes and jaxson dart boots and gets outside we don 39 t push three different times the f ing flat route excuse my language those are going to happen and we 39 re going to have to coach the young players better but when you play young players it 39 s part of the deal and they need to learn quickly 34 since trading micah parsons before the start of last season the cowboys have emphasized making roster moves that would help them stop the run the giants had little problem in that area however running 37 times for 165 yards and controlling the clock with relative ease it appears the cowboys have some quality pieces on defense most notably williams and rookie defensive back caleb downs but the overall talent looked thin sunday night there were notable weaknesses on all three levels 34 this is a humbling business 34 schottenheimer said 34 we got humbled tonight that 39 s what i told the guys we lost mile 1 of a 17 mile marathon 34 what prevents him from watching that performance and thinking the defense was similar to last season 34 every day we went against them in practice 34 schottenheimer responded 34 the defense we saw in practice was not what we saw tonight 34 one game is too soon to panic it 39 s realistic to think a team that doesn 39 t play its starters in the preseason could make a significant jump in week 2 but there was too much bad to not be somewhat concerned the offense has the weapons to put up points against any team but the absence of standout left guard tyler smith was felt against the giants particularly in the run game early 34 i 39 m still optimistic 34 prescott said 34 that doesn 39 t change our goals it doesn 39 t change how we feel about our team this is a marathon it 39 s a long season we 39 re going to respond 34 defensively the inside linebacker play wasn 39 t great and starting middle linebacker demarvion overshown left the game early with a hamstring injury starting safety malik hooker left with what is feared to be a fractured forearm physically the giants had the edge there wasn 39 t enough pass rush from the cowboys and there weren 39 t many opportunities where dart was forced to throw the ball into a risky space mentally new york made fewer costly errors overshown hit dart out of bounds early on a key play to get things going for the giants running back javonte williams uncharacteristically held the ball out to a defender as he was crossing the goal line late in the game leading to a taunting penalty that pushed back the point after attempt from brandon aubrey which he missed combine all of that and the recipe that beat the cowboys on sunday night will be copied going forward keep their talented offense on the sideline as much as possible establish the run game and put together long drives that eat up the majority of the clock the giants had the ball for more than 13 minutes longer than the cowboys many have been skeptical of those singing the cowboys 39 praises for how quietly things were during the offseason the vibe had been feeling different around the team for the first time in the last three years there was a lot of positive momentum but maybe this outcome just shows why jones was feeling so anxious an hour before kickoff sunday night 34 i know the way we approach things 34 prescott said 34 i know that our routine i know that our standard i know that the way we practice is the right way my message is echoing 39 don 39 t change don 39 t flinch don 39 t blink 39 this is a long year we have to stick together we 39 re hanging our hat on our brotherhood and that 39 s who we believe that we are so there 39 s no better time to show than after a loss 34 a little bit of adversity we got to make sure that we use it as a lesson 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their first 50 career games week 1 was gibbs 50th career game with two touchdowns in week 1 gibbs 51 career touchdowns only trail chuck foreman 55 jim brown 53 marcus allen 52 and larry johnson 52 on that list back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bills pull through in unexpected barnburner buffalo versus houston was expected to be one of the best matchups of week 1 that was certainly the case much less expected was the teams combining for 67 points in the end the bills did just enough on both ends to start the season with a win twice retaking the lead after houston was able to pull ahead in the fourth quarter their game winning drive was a seven play 96 yard march led by josh allen who hit dalton kincaid for a 35 yarder to flip the field and later josh palmer on a beautiful 34 yard strike for the go ahead score the drive was a microcosm of buffalo s day on offense as the bills still found resistance against houston s stellar d but was simply able to overcome it james cook nearly fumbled the game away on the drive s first play and allen threw a gimme to kamari lassiter one snap before buffalo s score that the cornerback couldn t corral despite racking up the most points houston has allowed since the 2023 season the bills still required a stop on defense as c j stroud began a potential statement drive with 1 36 remaining he did march the texans down to buffalo s 9 yard line but there the bills refused to break as deone walker sacked stroud on first and goal and gregory rousseau later clinched the win with a third down strip sack it was going to take a total team effort to beat a club of houston s quality and buffalo got one montgomery delivers back in workhorse role david montgomery came to houston for more opportunities and he saw plenty in his first game with the texans although he was inefficient on his carries 3 0 yards per attempt on 20 totes he exhibited a nose for the end zone scoring three of houston s four touchdowns he scored his first when the texans who notably struggled running in the red zone last year trusted him with three consecutive goal line carries his second an 18 yarder came as he cut into a huge hole opened by the texans offensive line and streaked untouched to the end zone montgomery also had three receptions for 19 yards including a 7 yard score he benefited the passing game beyond just his presence too the texans having a legitimate rushing game helped c j stroud 26 of 38 for 274 yards and two tds settle in and make some stellar throws it didn t result in a win sunday but the trade for montgomery looks like it will boost a texans offense that too often failed to hold up its end of the bargain in 2025 moore enjoys new digs it took a while for josh allen to target new acquisition dj moore but once he did the pair made the most of the new partnership moore collected his first look as a bill for an 18 yard catch with just under five minutes to play in the second quarter on the very next play he drew a 46 yard pass interference penalty that set up a 1 yard allen td plunge moore then made a brilliant catch on the following possession snagging the ball over a diving reed blankenship and keeping his feet in before streaking down the sideline for a 43 yard score though he was topped by dalton kincaid s 130 receiving yards which marked a career high for the tight end moore finished with a team leading eight targets five receptions 100 yards and the score his impact on buffalo s offense should silence those who thought he might be done after chicago or fail to carve out a role in a passing attack that loves to spread the ball around next gen stats insight for bills texans via nfl pro houston blitzed on only 18 8 of dropbacks allowing 287 passing yards two touchdowns and a 144 7 passer rating on plays without blitzing nfl research josh allen became the 12th player to reach 80 rushing touchdowns by his ninth season and the first quarterback in the nfl to have 80 career scores on the ground back to top bobby kownack s takeaways impressive ravens offense stalled by injuries baltimore s offense functioned seamlessly early on against the colts to put up 31 points before halftime the team s second most first half points to ever open a season the output was especially impressive considering lamar jackson and co were breaking in offensive coordinator declan doyle s new system jackson who struggled with injuries sapping his effectiveness throughout a trying 2025 season looked especially rejuvenated although he did lose a fumble jackson s signature elusiveness appeared to be back he rushed four times for 43 yards excluding three kneel downs and a score escaped sure sacks on several occasions and threw it tremendously too with 324 yards on 17 of 22 passing derrick henry continues to look ageless rumbling his way to 144 rushing yards and three touchdowns with a ferocity and the jackson zay flowers connection was unstoppable jackson enjoyed a perfect 158 3 passer rating on his six targets to flowers which went for five catches 150 yards and a touchdown unfortunately flowers left before halftime with a hamstring injury and rookie ja 39 kobi lane who was involved and caught a touchdown that was called back for offensive holding also got knocked out by a wrist injury the offense understandably looked different in the second half following those departures leaning on henry even more while adding just 10 more points while it was a tremendous play calling debut by doyle the injuries could loom large moving forward taylor was one of few bright spots for colts it was ugly for indianapolis which fell into a 28 6 hole after marching 65 yards for a touchdown to open the game outside of forcing a second quarter turnover to prevent baltimore from potentially putting together a third consecutive td drive and fortifying a bit after lamar jackson no longer had zay flowers to torment them with the colts were completely lost on defense they gave up 506 total net yards and were ineffective against the pass and the run perhaps the most important takeaway for indy long term is that daniel jones came away looking healthy but he never got much going jones finished 19 of 31 for 166 yards an early pick and a mostly meaningless late touchdown to tyler warren as has often been the case in recent years jonathan taylor proved to be the colts surest means of production he punched in two scores and collected 121 yards on 22 touches while averaging 5 2 yards per carry with five of his attempts going for 10 plus yards per next gen stats it s great knowing the colts can count on taylor but everyone else around him needs to raise their game minter gets a in first game as head coach it s hard to imagine a head coaching debut going much better than jesse minter s his ravens destroyed the colts even the lopsided 41 23 score made the result seem far closer than it was baltimore s defense the coach s specialty was unable to limit jonathan taylor but marlon humphrey did force and recover a fumble from the rb at a point when the game still felt somewhat in the balance roquan smith contributed 11 tackles and collected an interception after going without one for the first time in his career last year trey hendrickson also fit in spectacularly as he delivered a game high eight quarterback pressures and when things got a little hairy in the second half following an injury to zay flowers baltimore made the correct adjustments counting on derrick henry to help milk the game away this was minter s seventh week 1 as an nfl coach having spent four years on the ravens staff previously and the past two years as the chargers defensive coordinator his teams are now 7 0 in week 1 and his defenses have allowed 10 4 points per game in those contests per nfl research next gen stats insight for ravens colts via nfl pro the ravens defense posted a 58 6 pressure rate and two sacks when trey hendrickson was on the field nfl research zay flowers recorded a career high 150 receiving yards prior to leaving in the second quarter with a hamstring injury flowers has averaged 102 0 receiving yards per game in week 1 in his career the fourth most by a player in nfl history to have played multiple week 1 games michael irvin 106 8 tyreek hill 104 9 and antonio brown 103 3 back to top nick shook s takeaways jaguars pick up right where they left off one of the most entertaining storylines of the latter portion of the 2025 season existed in jacksonville where liam coen s offense hit its stride and became one of the most explosive units in football judging by how it performed sunday rust never had a chance of affecting this group trevor lawrence was dialed in from the start leading two touchdown drives that ended in much different but equally impressive lawrence touchdown passes jacksonville moved up and down the field with ease piling up 363 offensive yards and converting over 50 percent of its third downs at times it seemed as if lawrence was spending his sunday playing 7 on 7 bhayshul tuten got off to an encouraging start in his new role as lead back receiving 15 carries for 66 yards and parker washington five catches 83 yards one touchdown continued to be the most important player not named lawrence in jacksonville collectively it was business as usual in jacksonville which is just how the jaguars like it watson s first start goes even worse than expected deshaun watson s selection as browns starter defied logic and his performance sunday only made reality more frustrating for browns fans watson threw an ugly interception on his third pass attempt of the season routinely appeared overwhelmed by the speed of the game and a pass rush that eagerly feasted on his unusually long pass drops and frequently missed his targets even when free from pressure his only high quality throw of the game came in garbage time when he launched a deep ball to denzel boston for the rookie s first touchdown sure the browns didn t help themselves 11 accepted penalties for 75 yards but in any other scenario with any other team there would be no reason watson is playing these browns are a unique case though and they ll likely subject their fans to this misery again for at least one more week jacksonville s pass rush feasts when reviewing the jaguars entering the 2026 season it was fair to have some questions regarding their defense could josh hines allen and travon walker key a consistently effective pass rush might the secondary come together quickly especially with travis hunter back in the mix for one his first season in charge one game into 2026 his jets boast a winning record for the first time since week 3 of the 2024 campaign and deservedly so gang green was clicking all sides of the ball with carries new york dominated time of possession in part thanks to a second quarter near 12 minute drive glenn s defense much maligned in 2025 was stalwart allowing just 112 yards and six first downs through three quarters as the jets built a 20 3 lead qwan 39 tez stiggers and the jets special teams delivered some key stops and a takeaway on titans returns too new york hasn t looked this composed the titans looked on sunday like the same outfit that stumbled to a 3 14 campaign in 2025 robert saleh s defense was run through and put little pressure on new york s offensive line brian daboll s taking three sacks nissan stadium emptied out early partially due to a stifling tennessee heat but mostly due to the titans poor play leaving remaining local fans to boo and scream fire saleh audibly enough to be picked up by cbs boom mics and a sizable jets contingent to break out their notorious j e t s chants for saleh a former jets coach the result was the last thing he could have wanted with so much new in nashville an adjustment period is to be expected but the new look titans still look like a team at least a year away from contending gang green rookies don t look green the jets used their three first round picks to load up on talent with pass rusher david bailey tight end kenyon sadiq and wide receiver omar cooper all three made their presences felt on sunday if only briefly cooper delivered a yac happy 30 yard catch and run on new york s opening scoring drive that march ended with a nifty end around touchdown run for sadiq an athletic tight end with the motor to beat linebackers to the edge in the process sadiq joined hall of famer ozzie newsome 1978 as the only tes in nfl history with a rushing td in their first career game bailey got home in the third quarter logging his first nfl sack with help from the boundary and was a constant force in the backfield the no 2 pick logged a game high six qb pressures the one drawback cooper was forced from the game in the first half with an ankle injury and did not return but for bailey and sadiq the latter of whom was held out of most of training camp with an injury the opener was an unquestioned success and hopefully for new york a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for jets titans via nfl pro the jets ran from under center on 69 4 of called runs their highest rate under aaron glenn totaling 25 of their 36 called runs for 115 yards and two rushing touchdowns breece hall led with 17 under center rushing attempts for 85 yards and a touchdown including three explosive runs 10 yards tied for a career high nfl research the jets outgained tennessee by 172 total yards their largest total yards margin in week 1 since 2014 the last time geno smith was new york s week 1 starter back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways cards capitalize on chargers fourth quarter miscues mike lafleur s bunch was sunday s biggest surprise snapping a nine game losing streak carried over from the 2025 season the cardinals had a fourth quarter for the books one that included a blocked punt and two huge defensive stands the dam began to break for the chargers early in the fourth trailing 16 14 when cardinal simi fehoko shot through the middle to block a punt deep in chargers territory two plays later jacoby brissett hit trey mcbride for a 3 yard touchdown and a daniel carlson extra point put the cards up by two scores the flood gates continued to open on the next two chargers possessions as undrafted eighth year safety andrew wingard picked off a deep justin herbert pass before the cardinals forced a turnover on downs with 4 minutes to play holding los angeles to just seven second half points the cardinals couldn t ask for a better start to this new era lafleur s offense cooks with balanced effort the cardinals did a lot of good things offensively sunday mike lafleur with an infusion of shifts and motions orchestrated a balanced offense 34 rushes to 37 pass plays and put up nearly 400 yards the unit s first punt occurred with 2 minutes 47 seconds remaining in the third quarter and jacoby brissett looked more than worth that reworked contract playing efficiently and often delivering quick and accurate strikes he finished 27 of 37 passing for 277 yards and a touchdown to no one s surprise trey mcbride was his top target nine catches 95 yards and one td on 13 targets and it was promising to see kendrick bourne so involved he hauled in all eight of his targets for 75 yards it s worth noting marvin harrison made one catch albeit a nice one on three targets predictably tyler allgeier and jeremiyah love split the backfield workload with the veteran taking 17 carries for 61 yards on 41 snaps and the rookie 11 totes for 41 yards including a 5 yard touchdown run on 32 snaps there s a lot to like about this offense at first blush if it cleans up the pre snap penalties it ll keep arizona in a lot of games sluggish start for herbert l a our real first look at justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense was a mixed bag herbert looked dialed early leading an eight play 77 yard scoring drive hitting ladd mcconkey three times for 60 yards mcconkey was far and away herbert s favorite receiver in this one hauling in five catches for 82 yards with an 8 yard touchdown before a chest injury sidelined him just before the third quarter concluded his exit left los angeles without a reliable possession receiver and it showed as the chargers offense failed to reach cardinals territory on four fourth quarter possessions veteran tight end david njoku also had five catches sunday for 58 yards while herbert finished 17 of 27 for 209 yards a td and int with three sacks the offense converted twice on eight third down tries was 0 of 3 on fourth down and lost the possession battle by 15 minutes this offense has talent to be sure but this was one of the more concerning storylines from sunday next gen stats insight for cardinals chargers via nfl pro jeremiyah love forced six missed tackles in his nfl debut on 11 carries generating 38 of his 41 rushing yards after forcing a missed tackle most of his rushing production came on outside runs to the right side of the formation 28 yards on six carries with only two carries coming between the tackles nfl research mike lafleur became the first non interim head coach for the cardinals to win his first game since don coryell in 1973 back to top dan parr s takeaways raiders take baby steps it wasn t always pretty but first year head coach klint kubiak showed in the opener that he has elevated las vegas from the depths it fell to in recent years after spending the last two seasons at the bottom of the league the 27 13 win showed there is now a gap between them and a dolphins team that appears to be at the bottom right now it was the franchise s largest margin of victory since week 17 of the 2024 season and its first double digit win to open a season since 2017 ashton jeanty had one of the best games of his young career gaining 147 scrimmage yards on 29 touches 5 1 yards per touch and posting two touchdown catches the offensive line was functioning at a level that was missing all too often last year the raiders didn t even punt until the fourth quarter and scored 27 points a mark they reached only once last season in a week 9 loss qb questions for raiders are not going away kirk cousins isn t going to build confidence that he s long for the starting job with his performance on sunday yes cousins finished with three touchdown passes and completed 70 of his throws but he couldn t get much of anything going downfield he was 1 of 7 for 21 yards no tds and two interceptions on passes of 10 or more air yards per next gen stats he was without his top pass catcher tight end brock bowers but miami s four starters in the secondary had a combined three career starts entering sunday vegas is going to need more from cousins to be competitive against the league s better teams the drumbeat to start first overall pick fernando mendoza will grow louder with each week if the veteran qb can t connect with deep targets and turns the ball over like he did on sunday dolphins still have a long way to go week 1 confirmed that miami is very much in the beginning of a rebuild under new general manager jon eric sullivan and head coach jeff hafley in his first start with his new team quarterback malik willis had some nice moments but he also looked indecisive at times perhaps because his young wide receivers were not open and took five sacks the dolphins went 2 for 10 on third down and converted on only 1 of 3 trips to the red zone they didn t sack cousins and too often shot themselves in the foot including on special teams allowing two kick returns of 40 plus yards and missing a 41 yard field goal it s only going to get tougher from here with miami visiting the 49ers next week next gen stats insight for dolphins raiders via nfl pro the raiders used 21 personnel 2 rb 1 te 2 wr on 24 of their 67 offensive plays 35 8 their highest rate in the ngs era since 2016 las vegas posted 154 yards and two touchdowns out of 21 personnel averaging 6 4 yards per play both tds were scored by ashton jeanty who caught all four of his targets for 36 yards out of the grouping nfl research the raiders 27 point performance extended their streak to 38 consecutive games without reaching 30 points the longest active streak in the nfl back to top nick shook s takeaways flores defense keys comeback notorious for his penchant for dialing up blitzes minnesota defensive coordinator brian flores threw caution to the wind to start the season and sent his soldiers after the opposition all afternoon minnesota blitzed on 78 3 of defensive plays logging a pressure rate of 50 and throwing a massive purple and gold wrench into green bay s offensive plans though present throughout the contest and a frequent disruptor for green bay s offense in the first half the aggressive approach truly swung the game in favor of the vikings in the second half when flores understood green bay s offensive line could not properly handle his blitzes and he could manufacture one or more free rushers on any given down with the packers behind the sticks and desperate for a response flores unleashed his attacks wrecking jordan love s chances of keying a late rally and forcing takeaways that helped the vikings run away with the win even with an offseason of change intended to balance out the team s strengths the defense got the job done once again packers still can t overcome adversity for most of sunday s contest green bay appeared to be the better team the packers were leading despite lacking a running game their defense was causing all sorts of problems for carson wentz and the vikings offense they were outgaining minnesota significantly and it seemed they were one or two more stops from wrapping up a week 1 win over their division rivals it all fell apart in one possession though with a few questionable calls buying the vikings second third and fourth lives on a drive that ended with an aaron jones rushing score from there the wheels flew off the packers bus with flores sending relentless pressure and green bay s offensive line completely failing to pick up minnesota s blitzes jordan love melted down fumbling away possession and throwing an interception on the packers next drive in a fashion that was painfully reminiscent of the end of green bay s 2025 season in seemingly a flash the packers went from a likely week 1 winner to a runaway loser and despite all of the attempts to fix their issues in the offseason they ll walk away from this game mired in the same familiar feeling of disappointment nightmarish debut for kyler the kyler murray era was supposed to commence happily on sunday instead it began with an interception on murray s first attempt a desperation heave in the face of unblocked pressure murray s day didn t last much longer a third down scramble midway through the first quarter ended with murray sliding late and suffering a concussion when he was hit late sending the vikings back to the familiar place known as plan b carson wentz replaced murray and did a serviceable job but with murray entering concussion protocol the vikings might again find themselves in a position in which they must rely on a backup and hope for the best fortunately for them it worked out in their favor sunday next gen stats insight for packers vikings via nfl pro justin jefferson s 39 yard td reception from carson wentz was jefferson s first deep td 20 plus air yards since week 16 2024 nfl research sunday s win was the first game in vikings franchise history that it has won by 15 plus points despite being outgained by 150 plus total yards back to top kevin patra s takeaways eagles use big plays to outlast commanders much like the last several seasons the eagles offense wasn t pretty but it got the job done eking out a two point win over a division rival philly s offense was an inconsistent mess for much of the day with the offensive line struggling to pick up the new blocking scheme allowing far too many free runners into the backfield however nick sirianni s club used a trove of big plays that made the difference saquon barkley had a 42 yard scamper that helped set up a second quarter score jalen hurts who was up and down splashed three passes that went at least 30 yards including the difference making 43 yard catch and run td from dallas goedert the big plays covered for an offense that went three and out four times including three straight to start the second half there are obvious kinks to iron out with sean mannion s system but a win s a win commanders offense takes too long to get started like its counterpart washington s newly installed offense took time to make moves at times with both clubs breaking in new play callers sunday s game in philadelphia had a preseason feel through two quarters jayden daniels completed just six of 16 passes for 43 yards in the second half daniels picked things up used his legs more effectively and got an offense that was mostly stuck in the mud early into gear daniels guided the commanders to back to back fourth quarter touchdown drives using a slew of quick passes to knife through a good eagles d however a two point attempt shovel pass to tight end john bates was doa as the commanders fell shy new offensive coordinator david blough would probably like that call back returning after an injury riddled 2025 campaign to face a stout philly d in a new offense was a tough first ask for daniels washington s offense has a lot to clean up moving forward but at least the offensive line didn t get the qb killed allowing just two qb hits and one sack baun swarms for fangio s defense philly s lack of consistent pass rush is a concern especially given the state of the commanders offensive line yet linebacker zack baun continued to anchor the middle of the defense the pro bowler flew all over the field gobbling up 12 tackles including one for loss and generated the eagles only two passes defensed on the day baun stood out among a philly d that was solid but not otherworldly as they ve been cooper dejean got worked at times allowing seven catches on nine targets in coverage for 83 yards and a td the pass rush went silent for stretches and didn t provide enough pop the middle of the d led by jalen carter jordan davis and moro ojomo however was solid combining for 13 tackles two run stuffs and ojomo destroyed the two point attempt the eagles held the commanders to 295 total yards the 19th game holding their opponent under 300 yards since vic fangio took over in 2024 second in the nfl behind the seahawks 21 next gen stats insight for commanders eagles via nfl pro jalen hurts completed six of nine downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage total on those throws was the eighth highest of his career while he threw three or more downfield touchdowns for just the sixth time nfl research the eagles won their sixth straight week 1 game the longest active streak in the nfl nick sirianni is the fifth head coach to win each of his first six career season openers joining jim harbaugh mike shanahan potsy clark and hall of famer george allen back to top grant gordon s takeaways what a way to kick off the harbaugh era jaxson dart was back so too were malik nabers and cam skattebo each of them making contributions to knock off the rival cowboys in head coach john harbaugh s gotham debut facing a franchise that popularized the triplets term the giants young franchise trio of dart nabers and skattebo proved to be the offensive catalyst buoyed by their defense forcing an opening three and out the giants offense responded with a 10 play 83 yard scoring march in which dart used his arm and legs to guide them when the quarterback took a dirty and savage hit along the sideline that drew a flag his teammates surrounded him in unity dart was marvelous to the tune of 23 of 29 passing for 230 yards three touchdowns and 54 rushing yards nabers six receptions for 69 yards got his first licks out of the way coming back from a torn acl and meniscus that had sidelined him since week 4 of last year after his opening score skattebo coming back from a busted ankle predictably backflipped and proceeded to churn out 81 hard yards this was the start harbaugh and the franchise needed and wanted their young guns were firing against a hated adversary this wasn t a pretty game too many penalties too many fumbles some drops but for harbaugh and new york it was a beautiful result for the franchise s new dawn cowboys start big season with dud brian schottenheimer dak prescott and co haven t shied away from proclaiming their belief that they can and will be going to the super bowl an uncharacteristically drama free offseason helped to fuel the confidence but dallas fell flat to start the season with an surprisingly dreadful offensive performance that equated to a loss to a division rival it s used to dominating deep into the fourth quarter prescott s offense had less than 200 yards ceedee lamb and george pickens had bad drops prescott 175 yards two touchdowns had an ugly interception and everything looked off even when the cowboys made it a one score game javonte williams foolishly drew an unsportsmanlike penalty on his touchdown catch high hopes aren t shot down in week 1 but dallas was reminded nothing s coming easy and these cowboys aren t riding into the sunset anytime soon if they don t execute to their potential harbaugh giants hold tight john harbaugh s time in baltimore came to a close after his 19th season with the campaign ending well short of expectations thanks to five one score losses and three blown fourth quarter leads in 2025 the first of those was a bitter 41 40 loss to the bills on sunday night to open the campaign last september the 2025 giants meanwhile blew an incredible five fourth quarter leads in a victory symbolic of exorcising the ghosts of blown leads past these giants held on when the cowboys cut the deficit to the final score big blue s second year qb found his most fitting target isaiah likely who converted a third and 9 with a 12 yard pick up likely converted another third down later on the drive before skattebo salted away the win with the final first down needed likely a longtime former raven had a game high eight catches for 78 yards and two scores in so many ways this is a great vibes win for new york as it aims to build a winner next gen stats insight for cowboys giants via nfl pro odell beckham playing his first game with the giants since dec 12 2018 played 11 snaps with seven routes run and no targets nfl research sunday night saw the giants defeat the cowboys for just the third time in the last 19 meetings it was the 12th week 1 meeting between the rivals and new york won for just the second time in such instances back to top
