news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their first 50 career games week 1 was gibbs 50th career game with two touchdowns in week 1 gibbs 51 career touchdowns only trail chuck foreman 55 jim brown 53 marcus allen 52 and larry johnson 52 on that list back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bills pull through in unexpected barnburner buffalo versus houston was expected to be one of the best matchups of week 1 that was certainly the case much less expected was the teams combining for 67 points in the end the bills did just enough on both ends to start the season with a win twice retaking the lead after houston was able to pull ahead in the fourth quarter their game winning drive was a seven play 96 yard march led by josh allen who hit dalton kincaid for a 35 yarder to flip the field and later josh palmer on a beautiful 34 yard strike for the go ahead score the drive was a microcosm of buffalo s day on offense as the bills still found resistance against houston s stellar d but was simply able to overcome it james cook nearly fumbled the game away on the drive s first play and allen threw a gimme to kamari lassiter one snap before buffalo s score that the cornerback couldn t corral despite racking up the most points houston has allowed since the 2023 season the bills still required a stop on defense as c j stroud began a potential statement drive with 1 36 remaining he did march the texans down to buffalo s 9 yard line but there the bills refused to break as deone walker sacked stroud on first and goal and gregory rousseau later clinched the win with a third down strip sack it was going to take a total team effort to beat a club of houston s quality and buffalo got one montgomery delivers back in workhorse role david montgomery came to houston for more opportunities and he saw plenty in his first game with the texans although he was inefficient on his carries 3 0 yards per attempt on 20 totes he exhibited a nose for the end zone scoring three of houston s four touchdowns he scored his first when the texans who notably struggled running in the red zone last year trusted him with three consecutive goal line carries his second an 18 yarder came as he cut into a huge hole opened by the texans offensive line and streaked untouched to the end zone montgomery also had three receptions for 19 yards including a 7 yard score he benefited the passing game beyond just his presence too the texans having a legitimate rushing game helped c j stroud 26 of 38 for 274 yards and two tds settle in and make some stellar throws it didn t result in a win sunday but the trade for montgomery looks like it will boost a texans offense that too often failed to hold up its end of the bargain in 2025 moore enjoys new digs it took a while for josh allen to target new acquisition dj moore but once he did the pair made the most of the new partnership moore collected his first look as a bill for an 18 yard catch with just under five minutes to play in the second quarter on the very next play he drew a 46 yard pass interference penalty that set up a 1 yard allen td plunge moore then made a brilliant catch on the following possession snagging the ball over a diving reed blankenship and keeping his feet in before streaking down the sideline for a 43 yard score though he was topped by dalton kincaid s 130 receiving yards which marked a career high for the tight end moore finished with a team leading eight targets five receptions 100 yards and the score his impact on buffalo s offense should silence those who thought he might be done after chicago or fail to carve out a role in a passing attack that loves to spread the ball around next gen stats insight for bills texans via nfl pro houston blitzed on only 18 8 of dropbacks allowing 287 passing yards two touchdowns and a 144 7 passer rating on plays without blitzing nfl research josh allen became the 12th player to reach 80 rushing touchdowns by his ninth season and the first quarterback in the nfl to have 80 career scores on the ground back to top bobby kownack s takeaways impressive ravens offense stalled by injuries baltimore s offense functioned seamlessly early on against the colts to put up 31 points before halftime the team s second most first half points to ever open a season the output was especially impressive considering lamar jackson and co were breaking in offensive coordinator declan doyle s new system jackson who struggled with injuries sapping his effectiveness throughout a trying 2025 season looked especially rejuvenated although he did lose a fumble jackson s signature elusiveness appeared to be back he rushed four times for 43 yards excluding three kneel downs and a score escaped sure sacks on several occasions and threw it tremendously too with 324 yards on 17 of 22 passing derrick henry continues to look ageless rumbling his way to 144 rushing yards and three touchdowns with a ferocity and the jackson zay flowers connection was unstoppable jackson enjoyed a perfect 158 3 passer rating on his six targets to flowers which went for five catches 150 yards and a touchdown unfortunately flowers left before halftime with a hamstring injury and rookie ja 39 kobi lane who was involved and caught a touchdown that was called back for offensive holding also got knocked out by a wrist injury the offense understandably looked different in the second half following those departures leaning on henry even more while adding just 10 more points while it was a tremendous play calling debut by doyle the injuries could loom large moving forward taylor was one of few bright spots for colts it was ugly for indianapolis which fell into a 28 6 hole after marching 65 yards for a touchdown to open the game outside of forcing a second quarter turnover to prevent baltimore from potentially putting together a third consecutive td drive and fortifying a bit after lamar jackson no longer had zay flowers to torment them with the colts were completely lost on defense they gave up 506 total net yards and were ineffective against the pass and the run perhaps the most important takeaway for indy long term is that daniel jones came away looking healthy but he never got much going jones finished 19 of 31 for 166 yards an early pick and a mostly meaningless late touchdown to tyler warren as has often been the case in recent years jonathan taylor proved to be the colts surest means of production he punched in two scores and collected 121 yards on 22 touches while averaging 5 2 yards per carry with five of his attempts going for 10 plus yards per next gen stats it s great knowing the colts can count on taylor but everyone else around him needs to raise their game minter gets a in first game as head coach it s hard to imagine a head coaching debut going much better than jesse minter s his ravens destroyed the colts even the lopsided 41 23 score made the result seem far closer than it was baltimore s defense the coach s specialty was unable to limit jonathan taylor but marlon humphrey did force and recover a fumble from the rb at a point when the game still felt somewhat in the balance roquan smith contributed 11 tackles and collected an interception after going without one for the first time in his career last year trey hendrickson also fit in spectacularly as he delivered a game high eight quarterback pressures and when things got a little hairy in the second half following an injury to zay flowers baltimore made the correct adjustments counting on derrick henry to help milk the game away this was minter s seventh week 1 as an nfl coach having spent four years on the ravens staff previously and the past two years as the chargers defensive coordinator his teams are now 7 0 in week 1 and his defenses have allowed 10 4 points per game in those contests per nfl research next gen stats insight for ravens colts via nfl pro the ravens defense posted a 58 6 pressure rate and two sacks when trey hendrickson was on the field nfl research zay flowers recorded a career high 150 receiving yards prior to leaving in the second quarter with a hamstring injury flowers has averaged 102 0 receiving yards per game in week 1 in his career the fourth most by a player in nfl history to have played multiple week 1 games michael irvin 106 8 tyreek hill 104 9 and antonio brown 103 3 back to top nick shook s takeaways jaguars pick up right where they left off one of the most entertaining storylines of the latter portion of the 2025 season existed in jacksonville where liam coen s offense hit its stride and became one of the most explosive units in football judging by how it performed sunday rust never had a chance of affecting this group trevor lawrence was dialed in from the start leading two touchdown drives that ended in much different but equally impressive lawrence touchdown passes jacksonville moved up and down the field with ease piling up 363 offensive yards and converting over 50 percent of its third downs at times it seemed as if lawrence was spending his sunday playing 7 on 7 bhayshul tuten got off to an encouraging start in his new role as lead back receiving 15 carries for 66 yards and parker washington five catches 83 yards one touchdown continued to be the most important player not named lawrence in jacksonville collectively it was business as usual in jacksonville which is just how the jaguars like it watson s first start goes even worse than expected deshaun watson s selection as browns starter defied logic and his performance sunday only made reality more frustrating for browns fans watson threw an ugly interception on his third pass attempt of the season routinely appeared overwhelmed by the speed of the game and a pass rush that eagerly feasted on his unusually long pass drops and frequently missed his targets even when free from pressure his only high quality throw of the game came in garbage time when he launched a deep ball to denzel boston for the rookie s first touchdown sure the browns didn t help themselves 11 accepted penalties for 75 yards but in any other scenario with any other team there would be no reason watson is playing these browns are a unique case though and they ll likely subject their fans to this misery again for at least one more week jacksonville s pass rush feasts when reviewing the jaguars entering the 2026 season it was fair to have some questions regarding their defense could josh hines allen and travon walker key a consistently effective pass rush might the secondary come together quickly especially with travis hunter back in the mix for one week the answer was a resounding yes jacksonville piled up five sacks hines allen and walker combined for three of them limited the browns to 1 of 8 on third down forced two turnovers and was inches from a third and held cleveland to 132 total yards through three quarters this is only one game and isn t a proper barometer for where the jaguars stand but for one sunday it was magically delicious next gen stats insight for browns jaguars via nfl pro trevor lawrence was pressured on just five pass attempts and completed two for 62 yards and two touchdowns posting a stellar passer rating of 126 7 under duress nfl research the jaguars have won nine consecutive games dating back to last season tied for the second longest win streak in franchise history their 24 point victory is the second largest margin of victory in a season opener back to top kevin patra s takeaways watt d carried steelers to victory with the steelers offense unable to cash in t j watt decided to do it himself the reliable possession receiver and it showed as the chargers offense failed to reach cardinals territory on four fourth quarter possessions veteran tight end david njoku also had five catches sunday for 58 yards while herbert finished 17 of 27 for 209 yards a td and int with three sacks the offense converted twice on eight third down tries was 0 of 3 on fourth down and lost the possession battle by 15 minutes this offense has talent to be sure but this was one of the more concerning storylines from sunday next gen stats insight for cardinals chargers via nfl pro jeremiyah love forced six missed it was the franchise s largest margin of victory since week 17 of the 2024 season and its first double digit win to open a season since 2017 ashton jeanty had one of the best games of his young career gaining 147 scrimmage yards on 29 touches 5 1 yards per touch and posting two touchdown catches the offensive line was functioning at a level that was missing all too often last year the raiders didn starters in the secondary had a combined three career starts entering sunday vegas is going to need more from cousins to be competitive against the league s better teams the drumbeat to start first overall pick fernando mendoza will grow louder with each week if the veteran qb can t connect with deep targets and turns the ball over like he did on sunday dolphins still have a long way to go week 1 confirmed that miami is very much in the beginning of a rebuild under new general manager jon eric sullivan and head coach jeff hafley in his first start with his new team quarterback malik willis of 3 trips to the red zone they didn t sack cousins and too often shot themselves in the foot including on special teams allowing two kick returns of 40 plus yards and missing a 41 yard field goal it s only going to get tougher from here with miami visiting the 49ers next week next gen stats insight for dolphins raiders via nfl pro the raiders used 21 personnel 2 rb 1 te 2 wr on 24 of their 67 active streak in the nfl back to top nick shook s takeaways flores defense keys comeback notorious for his penchant for dialing up blitzes minnesota defensive coordinator brian flores threw caution to the wind to start the season and sent his soldiers after the opposition all afternoon minnesota blitzed on 78 3 of defensive plays logging a pressure rate of 50 and throwing a massive purple and gold wrench into green bay s offensive plans though present throughout the contest and a frequent disruptor for green bay s offense in the first half the aggressive approach truly swung the game in favor of the vikings in the second half when flores understood green bay s offensive line could not properly handle his blitzes and he could manufacture one or more free rushers on any given down with the packers behind the sticks and desperate for a response flores unleashed his attacks wrecking jordan love s chances of keying a late rally and forcing takeaways that helped the vikings run away with the win even with an offseason of change intended to balance out the team s strengths the defense got the job done once again packers still can t overcome adversity for most of sunday s contest green bay appeared to be the better team the packers were leading despite lacking a running game their defense was causing all sorts of problems for carson wentz and the vikings offense they were outgaining minnesota significantly and it seemed they were one or two more stops from wrapping up a week 1 win over their division rivals it all fell apart in one possession though with a few questionable calls buying the vikings second third and fourth lives on a drive that ended with an aaron jones rushing score from there the wheels flew off the packers bus with flores sending relentless pressure and green bay s offensive line completely failing to pick up minnesota s blitzes jordan love melted down fumbling away possession and throwing an interception on the packers next drive in a fashion that was painfully reminiscent of the end of green bay s 2025 season in seemingly a flash the packers went from a likely week 1 winner to a runaway loser and despite all of the attempts to fix their issues in the offseason they ll walk away from this game mired in the same familiar feeling of disappointment nightmarish debut for kyler the kyler murray era was supposed to commence happily on sunday instead it began with an interception on murray s first attempt a desperation heave in the face of unblocked pressure murray s day didn t last much longer a third down scramble midway through the first quarter ended with murray sliding late and suffering a concussion when he was hit late sending the vikings back to the familiar place known as plan b carson wentz replaced murray and did a serviceable job but with murray entering concussion protocol the vikings might again find themselves in a position in which they must rely on a backup and hope for the best fortunately for them it worked out in their favor sunday next gen stats insight for packers vikings via nfl pro justin jefferson s 39 yard td reception from carson wentz was jefferson s first deep td 20 plus air yards since week 16 2024 nfl research sunday s win was the first game in vikings franchise history that it has won by 15 plus points despite being outgained by 150 plus total yards back to top kevin patra s takeaways eagles use big plays to outlast commanders much like the last several seasons the eagles offense wasn t pretty but it got the job done eking out a two point win over a division rival philly s offense was an inconsistent mess for much of the day with the offensive line struggling to pick up the new blocking scheme allowing far too many free runners into the backfield however nick sirianni s club used a trove of big plays that made the difference saquon barkley had a 42 yard scamper that helped set up a second quarter score jalen hurts who was up and down splashed three passes that went at least 30 yards including the difference making 43 yard catch and run td from dallas goedert the big plays covered for an offense that went three and out four times including three straight to start the second half there are obvious kinks to iron out with sean mannion s system but a win s a win commanders offense takes too long to get started like its counterpart washington s newly installed offense took time to make moves at times with both clubs breaking in new play callers sunday s game in philadelphia had a preseason feel through two quarters jayden daniels completed just six of 16 passes for 43 yards in the second half daniels picked things up used his legs more effectively and got an offense that was mostly stuck in the mud early into gear daniels guided the commanders to back to back fourth quarter touchdown drives using a slew of quick passes to knife through a good eagles d however a two point attempt shovel pass to tight end john bates was doa as the commanders fell shy new offensive coordinator david blough would probably like that call back returning after an injury riddled 2025 campaign to face a stout philly d in a new offense was a tough first ask for daniels washington s offense has a lot to clean up moving forward but at least the offensive line didn t get the qb killed allowing just two qb hits and one sack baun swarms for fangio s defense philly s lack of consistent pass rush is a concern especially given the state of the commanders offensive line yet linebacker zack baun continued to anchor the middle of the defense the pro bowler flew all over the field gobbling up 12 tackles including one for loss and generated the eagles only two passes defensed on the day baun stood out among a philly d that was solid but not otherworldly as they ve been cooper dejean got worked at times allowing seven catches on nine targets in coverage for 83 yards and a td the pass rush went silent for stretches and didn t provide enough pop the middle of the d led by jalen carter jordan davis and moro ojomo however was solid combining for 13 tackles two run stuffs and ojomo destroyed the two point attempt the eagles held the commanders to 295 total yards the 19th game holding their opponent under 300 yards since vic fangio took over in 2024 second in the nfl behind the seahawks 21 next gen stats insight for commanders eagles via nfl pro jalen hurts completed six of nine downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage total on those throws was the eighth highest of his career while he threw three or more downfield touchdowns for just the sixth time nfl research the eagles won their sixth straight week 1 game the longest active streak in the nfl nick sirianni is the fifth head coach to win each of his first six career season openers joining jim harbaugh mike shanahan potsy clark and hall of famer george allen back to top grant gordon s takeaways what a way to kick off the harbaugh era jaxson dart was back so too were malik nabers and cam skattebo each of them making contributions to knock off the rival cowboys in head coach john harbaugh s gotham debut facing a franchise that popularized the triplets term the giants young franchise trio of dart nabers and skattebo proved to be the offensive catalyst buoyed by their defense forcing an opening three and out the giants offense responded with a 10 play 83 yard scoring march in which dart used his arm and legs to guide them when the quarterback took a dirty and savage hit along the sideline that drew a flag his teammates surrounded him in unity dart was marvelous to the tune of 23 of 29 passing for 230 yards three touchdowns and 54 rushing yards nabers six receptions for 69 yards got his first licks out of the way coming back from a torn acl and meniscus that had sidelined him since week 4 of last year after his opening score skattebo coming back from a busted ankle predictably backflipped and proceeded to churn out 81 hard yards this was the start harbaugh and the franchise needed and wanted their young guns were firing against a hated adversary this wasn t a pretty game too many penalties too many fumbles some drops but for harbaugh and new york it was a beautiful result for the franchise s new dawn cowboys start big season with dud brian schottenheimer dak prescott and co haven t shied away from proclaiming their belief that they can and will be going to the super bowl an uncharacteristically drama free offseason helped to fuel the confidence but dallas fell flat to start the season with an surprisingly dreadful offensive performance that equated to a loss to a division rival it s used to dominating deep into the fourth quarter prescott s offense had less than 200 yards ceedee lamb and george pickens had bad drops prescott 175 yards two touchdowns had an ugly interception and everything looked off even when the cowboys made it a one score game javonte williams foolishly drew an unsportsmanlike penalty on his touchdown catch high hopes aren t shot down in week 1 but dallas was reminded nothing s coming easy and these cowboys aren t riding into the sunset anytime soon if they don t execute to their potential harbaugh giants hold tight john harbaugh s time in baltimore came to a close after his 19th season with the campaign ending well short of expectations thanks to five one score losses and three blown fourth quarter leads in 2025 the first of those was a bitter 41 40 loss to the bills on sunday night to open the campaign last september the 2025 giants meanwhile blew an incredible five fourth quarter leads in a victory symbolic of exorcising the ghosts of blown leads past these giants held on when the cowboys cut the deficit to the final score big blue s second year qb found his most fitting target isaiah likely who converted a third and 9 with a 12 yard pick up likely converted another third down later on the drive before skattebo salted away the win with the final first down needed likely a longtime former raven had a game high eight catches for 78 yards and two scores in so many ways this is a great vibes win for new york as it aims to build a winner next gen stats insight for cowboys giants via nfl pro odell beckham playing his first game with the giants since dec 12 2018 played 11 snaps with seven routes run and no targets nfl research sunday night saw the giants defeat the cowboys for just the third time in the last 19 meetings it was the 12th week 1 meeting between the rivals and new york won for just the second time in such instances back to top

news_mentions.headline: Broncos vs. Chiefs: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 1 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs.
news_mentions.body_text: monday night football opens up with a doozy pitting the reigning afc west champions against the squad that dominated the division with nine straight first place finishes before finally losing the throne how will the broncos fare at long last being chased rather than acting as the chasers denver topped the afc west in 2025 and finished as the top seed in the conference by going 14 3 despite their mighty record they ll kick off the new campaign fighting against a regression narrative the broncos had 11 one possession wins last year tying the 2024 chiefs and 2022 vikings two clubs that would go on to miss the playoffs the following season for the most in nfl history their opponents the chiefs will be looking to pick themselves back up after a shocking six win campaign that marked their first losing season since 2012 was it a true sign of the end or simply the setup to a redemptive chapter in kansas city s dynasty beating the broncos who bested them in a pair of one possession games last year would nudge the answer toward the latter these two teams will meet again in week 8 when we have a much clearer picture of where their seasons are heading but first they ll have a chance to set the tone in a star studded week 1 finale three must know storylines 1 both qbs are coming off major injuries patrick mahomes is set to make his much anticipated return after tearing his acl in week 15 last season his reward for working his way back to the field in roughly nine months facing a ferocious denver defense that has led the league in sacks for two straight years he will also be without left tackle josh simmons due to a back injury putting undrafted rookie kahlil benson in line to serve as his blindside blocker it s a heck of a test but the two time most valuable player is as capable as anyone of working his way through it whereas mahomes didn t play at all in the preseason bo nix suited up for two drives in denver s second preseason game as part of his process of coming back from a broken ankle suffered in the divisional round he looked comfortable in the limited action going 6 of 9 for 76 yards and a touchdown but he wasn t required to move around a ton and test out his mobility it ll be the real deal against the chiefs who will do their best to flush him out and make him uncomfortable 2 broncos chiefs taking different backfield approaches denver enters the season with a deep versatile running back room j k dobbins and rj harvey who combined for 1 705 scrimmage yards and 16 scores last season are back atop the depth chart dobbins is the better all around back but he s struggled to stay on the field throughout his career as evidenced by the running back missing the broncos final nine games last season including playoffs he nonetheless led the team in rushing yards as harvey proved dynamic in the passing game but took time to find his footing they won t be powering denver s ground game alone though despite being listed third on the depth chart rookie jonah coleman has the talent to carve out a role sooner rather than later giving sean payton three ball carriers with which to attack kansas city s front the chiefs are likely to feature more of a solo act after missing out on playing in the super bowl for just the second time in seven years they signed the super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker it s been a while since andy reid s chiefs utilized a true workhorse running back such as when kareem hunt shouldered the load during his first stint in kansas city or jamaal charles spearheaded the attack during reid s early years with the club both produced tremendous results and now 2026 figures to be the kwiii show he ll play a vital role in helping the offense function at a high level while patrick mahomes gets fully back to himself 3 broncos upgraded passing attack vs chiefs new look secondary after finishing last season with an offense that ranked just above average 14th in points scored the broncos went out and traded for an x factor jaylen waddle the perception of waddle might have taken a bit of a hit first as he took a backseat to tyreek hill in miami and then as the dolphins offense waned in effectiveness the past couple years but he is a highly efficient pass catching weapon in three of the past four seasons waddle has finished as a top 15 wr in yards per route twice ranking in the top six per nfl pro he is the perfect complement to courtland sutton and there were rave reviews of pat bryant out of camp too the trio s task will be to dismantle a kansas city secondary transformed by the offseason the chiefs defense lost six players who started 10 plus games last season including safety bryan cook cornerback jaylen watson and cb trent mcduffie k c let the former two walk in free agency and traded mcduffie to the rams part of a recurring strategy by general manager brett veach to reshuffle his secondary rather than pay big money extensions he did the same in 2024 with l 39 jarius sneed who is back and joined by 2026 no 6 overall pick mansoor delane and free agent signing alohi gilman as part of the new look defensive backfield the difference in the game could come down to which revamped group starts the season stronger

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1
