news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.body_text: summer is over for pigskin professionals the nfl is back with training camps opening across the league it s time for the competitions for jobs to commence competition is the name of the game for every squad it s what breeds improvement and ultimately leads to winning certain positions with limited rep sharing lend themselves to more notable battles you won t see many defensive competitions highlighted mainly because the hefty rotations and matchup centric usage tend to make camp fights less impactful as the season approaches below are the top 10 camp battles i ll be monitoring throughout training camp and into the preseason

news_mentions.headline: New Orleans Saints training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the New Orleans Saints' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the new orleans saints offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location ochsner sports performance center metairie louisiana fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at los angeles chargers 4 05 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 10 week 2 vs jacksonville jaguars 1 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 17 week 3 vs denver broncos 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the saints are one of just three teams browns titans that do not have a prime time game on their schedule nfl research what you need to know 1 kellen moore s undertaking as head coach highlights the immense change happening in new orleans and how the saints adapt to a long overdue overhaul is at the forefront of everyone s mind entering 2025 coming off a super bowl winning season as the eagles offensive coordinator moore brings expertise on offense and a philosophy switch that has been yearned for in the big easy after former defensive coordinator dennis allen followed the sean payton era moore s lone season as oc in philadelphia offers some proof he can successfully acclimate his system to a new team but the disparity in talent won t make it such a seamless transition especially after derek carr s abrupt retirement in may moore s arrival is certainly a breath of fresh air on the surface but how the 36 year old rookie head coach the youngest in the nfl successfully acclimates to the role remains to be seen training camp will provide a first glimpse at moore s initial impact 2 moore s major project during training camp will be figuring out who will lead his offense under center jake haener spencer rattler and second round pick tyler shough enter a three way quarterback competition while undrafted rookie hunter dekkers also looks to get noticed the trial offers great challenges considering the young qbs and the entire offense will be learning a new system rattler enters with the most experience after notching six starts during his rookie season last year his struggles eventually had the saints turn to haener for a start but neither notched a win in carr s absence perhaps that s why shough enters his first training camp with the greatest anticipation in new orleans the 25 year old louisville product comes in with seven years of college experience sports a strong arm that sets him apart from his competition and has a good chance at becoming the first saints rookie to start week 1 since archie manning did it in 1971 having such a rare occurrence coincide with moore s undertaking makes for a stimulating storyline that s appropriate for this new era of saints football but the rookie must win the job first 3 the saints defense could provide some upside in moore s first season several familiar veterans remain at every level including cameron jordan demario davis and tyrann mathieu but the defense will need to adjust to new defensive coordinator brandon staley s 3 4 scheme after a decade under dennis allen the unit s roster makeup isn t short of talent or depth chase young carl granderson bryan bresee and khalen saunders return with jordan on a defensive line that welcomes newcomer davon godchaux davis and pete werner return as the team s leading tacklers last season and will help guide a tackling machine in rookie danny stutsman isaac yiadomwas signed to man the outside corner with kool aid mckinstry returning on the other side and alontae taylor manning the nickel justin reid is the biggest new addition to the defense bringing championship mettle after three seasons with the chiefs and completing a louisiana born backend alongside the honey badger the pieces are seemingly all there but how they fall into place is the big question

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs' Travis Kelce moves into second place for all-time tight end receiving yards
news_mentions.description: Travis Kelce moved into second place all-time for receiving yards by a tight end during the Chiefs’ season opener Monday night against the Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: it was quite a milestone offseason for travis kelce the kansas city chiefs tight end wasted no time in making it a milestone regular season as well kelce moved into second all time for receiving yards by a tight end during the chiefs 31 10 season opening monday night win over the denver broncos predictably kelce downplayed the individual milestone when speaking to espn s laura rutledge after the game it s a good feeling to get this win all the other stuff is just hoopla now he said kelce caught a 59 yard pass from old friend patrick mahomes in the third quarter to put him past longtime dallas cowboys stalwart jason witten for second all time ahead of monday s season opener kelce had 13 002 yards needing 45 to surpass witten 13 046 the catch was a turn back the clock moment for kelce standing as his longest reception since week 15 2021 when he turned in a 69 yarder versus the los angeles chargers it was a memorable way to begin kelce s 14th and perhaps final season the three time super bowl winner now trails only hall of famer tony gonzalez 15 127 in receiving yards by a tight end though the 36 year old s career is winding down his star status is not thanks in large part to his recent nuptials to pop megastar taylor swift a no doubt future hall of famer kelce an 11 time pro bowler and four time all pro ranks fifth among tight ends with 82 touchdowns and third in receptions 1 083 among his other notable accomplishments kelce has the most 100 yard games by a tight end 38 and his 1 416 yards in 2020 remaining a single season best at the position kelce s earned another tip of the helmet for what s been an astounding career but this season is just beginning as he aims to help his chiefs return to prior heavyweight status

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks: Sam Darnold has 'very unique' soft-tissue injury, no firm timeline for return
news_mentions.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is dealing with a "very unique soft-tissue injury" to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected, the team announced Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: seattle seahawks quarterback sam darnold is dealing with a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected the team announced monday darnold s injury is not considered to be a long term injury but there is no firm timeline on his return to the field darnold who led the seahawks to a super bowl title in his first season with the team exited wednesday s kickoff game win over the patriots with what was initially labeled a hip injury the seahawks returned to practice on monday and darnold was not seen on the field during the portion available to the media per espn seahawks head coach mike macdonald is next scheduled to speak to reporters on wednesday monday s update comes after nfl network insider ian rapoport reported thursday that darnold avoided a major injury and could miss a few weeks macdonald said during a radio interview that same day that the team received really really good news on darnold and later added that he hoped they would have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack by monday veteran drew lock would be in line to start seattle s week 2 game against the cardinals if darnold is unable to play lock went 16 of 22 for 187 yards with one touchdown in relief of darnold against new england

news_mentions.headline: 5 storylines to know from Week 1 of 2026 season: Bears, Ravens amaze and a tale of two LaFleurs
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra takes a look at five key storylines to know from Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: the first week of the nfl season plays out as a mirage offering glimpses of thirst quenching promise for a football starved diaspora with a minuscule sample things aren t always what they seem after one game in a gauntlet of a season remember a year ago when the raiders knocked off the patriots in week 1 in foxborough las vegas wound up with the no 1 overall pick new england played in the super bowl week 1 lies like a toddler who just doesn t know any better as the young season wears on there will be twists plummets and vaults teams that looked good on sunday will falter clubs that struggled out of the gate will find a groove with franchises mostly holding starters out of preseason action many tilts around the nfl looked like exhibition matches early in particular some squads breaking in new coordinators philly and washington come to mind looked like they had a lot of kinks to iron out no one won a lombardi trophy on sunday no one lost one either the first sunday was an important first step in the march to february but it s not the be all and end all each monday during the season i ll take a look at five key storylines from sunday s slate of contests starting today with week 1 s points a palooza and including john harbaugh s prime time win in his n y debut josh allen bills exorcising demons in houston a tale of two lafleurs for arizona and green bay sunday s big day for star rbs around the nfl 1 sunday s points bonanza has nfl on brink of history yesterday s 13 games averaged 53 3 points the highest scoring week 1 sunday in league history per nfl research entering monday night football the average for the entire week 1 slate is 50 0 points per game which if it holds tonight when the denver broncos take on the kansas city chiefs would mark a super bowl era record six tilts on sunday saw at least 60 combined points i d like to highlight two teams that particularly stood out on offense baltimore and chicago new ravens oc declan doyle actually spent last season on ben johnson s bears staff so perhaps it shouldn t be too surprising that baltimore authored the most explosive output beyond chicago lamar jackson looked like his two time mvp self zipping darts into open windows escaping sure sacks for first downs and looking far fresher and less frazzled than he did last year his rapport with zay flowers was otherworldly before the wideout left with a hamstring injury assuming the issue doesn t linger nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that the setback isn t considered serious the duo could be something special this season doyle did an excellent job mixing up his calls schemed players open for easy jackson reads and kept the colts off balance add in that derrick henry still runs like he s 25 years old bulldozing his way to 144 yards and three tds for his own record setting day and baltimore s offense looked deadly in putting up 41 points in a blowout win at indianapolis the sample is small but if the ravens can stay healthy a big if they could eat up points meanwhile johnson entered the season saying he wanted to employ the best offense in league history the bears went out and showed they have the horses to do so in a 59 37 win at carolina after the game chicago s second year head coach doubled down on the ambition that will always be the goal johnson said we want to be the highest scoring we want to have the most wins we want to win super bowls that s what we do we didn t get into this profession trying to be mediocre or average sure it came against a panthers defense that entered the season with significant questions after making splashes in free agency to upgrade the unit but the base of what transpired sunday in charlotte is replicable perhaps the bears won t put up 59 points and 552 yards with two rushers hitting the century mark but johnson s offense proved it can score from anywhere on the field caleb williams shut down questions about whether the offseason hype would prove unfounded the madden cover athlete built on his 2025 breakout season made some incredible throws and used his legs as a weapon williams is the first player in bears history with at least 200 passing yards two passing touchdowns 50 rushing yards and two rushing tds in a single game per nfl research he is the third player over the last five seasons to reach those marks in a single game joining the bills josh allen three times and the eagles jalen hurts two times the qb can still improve against pressure 0 for 5 passing with two sacks on 13 pressured dropbacks per next gen stats but the 72 4 completion rate is what stood out it s a figure he never really came close to in his first season under johnson the question all offseason was if williams could smooth out the rough patches and become more consistent down to down sunday was an excellent step in that direction 2 john harbaugh era gets off to roaring start the giants actually looked like a professional operation on sunday night for the first time in a while the mistakes and roller coaster play that had come to define the club were smoothed into effective showings on both sides of the ball harbaugh s squad ran efficiently on offense taking advantage of a cowboys defense that hasn t fixed all its issues from last season and blocked very well and the defense while having some hiccups in the secondary was mostly on the spot in allowing 244 total yards for the game the most notable improvement came from under center where jaxson dart played the most proficient game of his career the qb logged his first career outing with three or more pass touchdowns and zero interceptions dart 23 is the youngest player to accomplish the feat in a week 1 prime time game and the first under the age of 25 to do so since patrick mahomes 2020 vs texans as a rookie dart showed he could make backyard plays big time throws and gash defenses with his legs however it always felt helter skelter his hair always on fire on sunday night the second year qb looked calm smooth and never out of sync dart was content to make the cowboys pay for poor coverage not forcing balls or hunting big plays he showed he could make the ho hum play needed to elevate an offense sometimes boring qb play is the best qb play add in malik nabers return from last year s season ending injury six catches for 69 yards on a team high nine targets and it was a smashing opening night at metlife stadium 3 bills exorcise houston demons in joe brady s first game as head coach the last two times josh allen and the bills traveled to houston things ended poorly in last year s meeting allen was crunched taking a career high eight sacks and throwing two ints in the loss with that backdrop on sunday the joe brady era took flight facing what was expected to be one of the best defenses in football if not the best allen ripped passes through the texans secondary the buffalo o line did a smashing job against a beast of a front after the bills allowed eight sacks last year in houston allen faced just nine total pressures this time and took two sacks the qb was 5 of 7 passing for 85 yards under pressure per next gen stats in total allen completed 20 of his 29 pass attempts for 334 yards and two touchdowns in the bills week 1 win against the texans adding another two scores with his legs allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest in a game since week 18 of 2022 the star signal caller completed 11 of his 16 passes of 10 plus air yards with two tds the 286 downfield passing yards were the most the texans have allowed in a game since demeco ryans took over as head coach in 2023 per nfl research as always allen got away with a few iffy balls i e kamari lassiter s dropped int late but the good outweighed the bad and houston failed to capitalize on the mistakes buffalo s 36 points represented the most a ryans led defense has given up since his first season in houston with brady being elevated from oc to the big chair it was worth wondering how much the offense might change with the restrictor plate off it s just one week but with the addition of dj moore 5 100 1 and the healthy status of dalton kincaid 5 130 the bills offense leaned on allen and splashed big play after big play coming against ryans defense it was a massive statement 4 good lafleur bad lafleur the stunner of the week came in los angeles where the cardinals handled jim harbaugh s chargers a trendy pick to go deep in the playoffs the true shocker wasn t that the cards whose projected win total entering the season was roughly four pulled off the upset it was that they controlled much of the tilt new head coach mike lafleur showed a deft hand in deploying his array of weapons keeping the bolts defense off balance the offensive line held up well and jacoby brissett once again showed that he s a professional quarterback who s unafraid to attack completing 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards per next gen stats if the cards can keep this up while avoiding turnovers they ll be a pest brissett has proven he can fling it around the park and he looked comfortable in lafleur s offense the cardinals defense which is solid on paper but hasn t been able to stay healthy in recent years held justin herbert and the mike mcdaniel led offense to 268 total yards and 17 first downs the d also forced two turnovers and gobbled up three sacks add in a blocked punt by the special teams and it was a three phase win in lafleur s first game we ve seen this show before where teams expected to be bad show up in week 1 and surprise last year arizona won its season opener before ultimately finishing 3 14 i don t expect a similar crash it s just one week but lafleur showed he can coach and the cards displayed they have the talent to be frisky if they can stay healthy with games against the seahawks and 49ers on tap they ll have a chance to prove week 1 was more than just a flash in the pan the other lafleur brother didn t fare so well packers hc matt lafleur watched a 12 point third quarter lead disintegrate in minnesota against backup vikings quarterback carson wentz who played the majority of the game after kyler murray suffered a concussion in the first half yes several questionable penalties went against the packers but flags didn t cause the rest of the miscues from the moment the elder lafleur took three points off the board in the fourth quarter to fall short on a fourth and 1 play the packers crumbled we re gonna be aggressive and we re gonna try to go for the throat in that situation matt lafleur said of the decision they missed the throat and stabbed their own leg the offensive line completely fell apart in the face of brian flores relentless pressure minnesota had a 78 3 blitz rate on jordan love dropbacks the fourth highest figure by a defense in a game since at least 2018 per next gen stats love fumbled deep in his own territory and later threw an int to cap off the fourth quarter collapse blown leads in winnable games have become a staple under matt lafleur sunday s flop was of the epic variety the vikings who scored 29 unanswered points became the first team in nfl history to trail by 12 plus points with under 20 minutes left in regulation and win by 17 plus points per nfl research speaking of minnesota wentz proved kevin o connell made the correct call in naming him the backup over j j mccarthy he s not a perfect qb but the veteran plays well enough in koc s offense to move the ball 5 big time day for lead rbs running backs got paid this offseason then went on to prove the investments were worth it sunday saw a trove of rbs scamper all over defenses the top of the charts was a veritable who s who of workhorses jahmyr gibbs led all players with 34 touches 186 scrimmage yards and 156 rushing yards he also forced 12 missed tackles the most in any game of his career after the contest gibbs suggested he could ve had 40 touches if needed currently he s on pace for a ridiculous 578 touches the all time record is 492 by james wilder in 1984 derrick henry galloped for 144 rushing yards and three tds on 24 totes and finished with 163 scrimmage yards give the ravens revamped o line some love henry finished with 110 yards before contact against the colts the third highest single game total of his career he was hit at the line of scrimmage on just 8 3 of his carries the lowest rate of his ravens career bijan robinson generated 173 scrimmage yards including 90 receiving yards most among all rbs through sunday robinson accounted for 65 8 of the falcons yards from scrimmage in week 1 the highest share by any player in a team s season opener since rams rb eric dickerson 66 6 in 1986 d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai formed a two headed monster for chicago the former gobbled up 124 rushing yards and three rushing tds while the latter scampered for 100 yards with a 61 yard td rumble add in caleb williams ground effort 65 yards two tds and the bears became the fourth team in the super bowl era to have three players with at least 65 rushing yards and at least one rushing touchdown in the same game first trio to include a qb per nfl research the last team to accomplish the feat was the 2013 rams in week 12 with wr tavon austin and rbs benny cunningham and zac stacy ashton jeanty gobbled up 147 scrimmage yards 102 rushing yards with 45 receiving yards team high and two td catches in the 27 13 win over miami jeanty generated 73 rushing yards after contact the third most in his career his three explosive runs of 10 plus yards tied for the second most in a game in his career pretty good for a player who suffered an ankle injury three weeks ago breece hall scampered for 102 rushing yards and a td and added two catches for 16 yards in the jets romp at tennessee perhaps most notable in gang green s revamped offense 17 of hall s 22 rushing attempts came with geno smith under center accounting for 85 yards and a td including three explosive runs tied for a career high per next gen stats jonathan taylor paced the colts offense with 121 scrimmage yards including 98 rushing yards and two rushing scores in the loss to baltimore it marked taylor s 14th career game with 100 plus scrimmage yards and two plus rushing touchdowns tying him with hall of famer edgerrin james for the most such games in colts franchise history david montgomery didn t put up gaudy rushing or scrimmage numbers in houston s loss 79 scrimmage yards 60 rushing 19 receiving but was one of just three players to score three scrimmage tds 2 rushing 1 receiving on sunday alongside derrick henry and d andre swift

news_mentions.headline: Browns sticking with Deshaun Watson as starting QB for Week 2 game vs. Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: Despite a dismal season-opening performance, Browns coach Todd Monken is sticking with Deshaun Watson as his starting quarterback for Week 2 against the Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: despite a dismal season opening performance cleveland browns coach todd monken is sticking with deshaun watson as his starting quarterback for week 2 against the tampa bay buccaneers i anticipate deshaun will be our starter monken said monday watson finished 16 of 22 passing for 205 yards with a first drive interception and a final drive 46 yard touchdown pass in a depressing 34 10 road loss to the jacksonville jaguars the first year head coach noted that it d been 693 days since watson last started after he missed most of 2024 and all of 2025 due to multiple achilles injuries oh for sure and it s only been two weeks he s gotten all the reps monken said there were some really good things on film some things that you can build on and there were some others that operationally we ve got to get better at there s concepts that there s only so many looks you get from week to week be it red zone concepts third down concepts and i did think that when he had time when he understood the concepts he didn t play tentative that he lit it rip even the touchdown at the end sure that was garbage time but that was on their no 1 corner that was one of their starters out there that was a communication between him and the receiver so there was a lot of things to build on it wasn t perfect of course not otherwise we wouldn t have scored as few points as we did but i d like to see how we can build on that i liked his week of practice last week and i think he s only going to continue to get better monken can sugarcoat sunday s rotten performance from his club any way he d like the reality is no one played well in the blowout loss starting with the quarterback perhaps the long time off played a role but even before the litany of injuries watson was one of the worst quarterbacks in the nfl nothing changed sunday the 31 year old threw a rookie level int on the opening drive conducted an offense that couldn t get in and out of the huddle cleanly had far too many mental miscues struggled with pressure and barely threatened the jags d in the first half watson threw for a measly 75 yards with an int as the browns trailed 24 0 the entire second half was basically garbage time monken said the film validated watson getting another shot under center and highlighted that the entire team must play better it confirmed it when i looked at the tape he said we ve got to play better around him we ve got to call it better and he s got to play better our inability to function consistently as an offense was a byproduct of we coaching and playing the reality for the browns new coach is that barring some miraculous turnaround in tampa cleveland fans won t be a welcoming hoard for watson in week 3 he s destined to hear louder boos than those that got under his skin in the preseason from the moment watson was named the starter it felt like an untenable situation sunday s performance did nothing to change that perception monken seems to be hoping a trip to tampa can

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Sean McVay: No timeline on Myles Garrett's return post knee surgery
news_mentions.description: News broke Sunday that Myles Garrett would undergo knee surgery and land on injured reserve, which will knock him out a minimum of four weeks. He could be out longer depending on how the knee responds.
news_mentions.body_text: the los angeles rams won t set a timeline for myles garrett s return following monday s knee surgery i don t really have a timeline yet head coach sean mcvay told reporters on monday it s all contingent upon how do things go today you feel good about it but i think it d be unfair to him or really just without having the totality of all the information to put any sort of timeline on it we know that he ll be available in four weeks potentially so we ll just take that a day at a time news broke sunday that garrett will undergo knee surgery and land on injured reserve which will knock him out a minimum of four weeks he could be out longer depending on how the knee responds garrett played in last week s season opener in australia generating five pressures but failing to record a sack or a tackle the pass rusher admitted after the game that he wasn t himself and was concerned about his knee which had limited him during training camp mcvay said he knew immediately following the game that garrett would have to go on ir it was right after the game mcvay said honestly after i talked with him after the game after i d spoken with you guys and just seeing just how he felt you look at it we thought it was something that we d be able to kinda manage that wasn t necessarily the case so having that evidence and being able to say what s the next right thing it was right after the game just in terms of listening to how he felt how he was able to impact the game and even just like what you guys saw with how limited we had to be with him obviously we thought we were doing the right thing but in hindsight you ll always be able to learn from it the decision to play garrett who came over in a ballyhooed trade with the cleveland browns despite nursing the knee injury throughout training camp sat juxtaposed to that of aaron donald who didn t play week 1 after returning from a two year absence mcvay noted that the two situations were completely different the direction that we went with myles and the direction we went with aaron are two totally separate situations and circumstances he said with myles it was more along the lines of we had been aware of this thought it was something that he d be able to work through obviously being out there and playing in a real game you learn like hey maybe that s not the case so let s change course with that with aaron it was more just getting him up to speed mcvay said the club isn t sure if donald will play week 2 in prime time versus the 1 0 new york giants on sept 21 we haven t decided that yet mcvay said of donald he s gonna continue to work his process and we ll see what it looks like if donald isn t able to play a once vaunted looking defensive front on paper will be rather thin on the field

news_mentions.headline: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane to miss several weeks with fractured wrist
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens receiver Ja'Kobi Lane suffered a fractured wrist in Sunday's win over the Colts and will miss several weeks.
news_mentions.body_text: ja 39 kobi lane s promising start with the baltimore ravens has hit a speed bump out of the gate lane suffered a fractured wrist in the ravens 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts and is expected to miss several weeks nfl network insiders mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported sunday night lane will undergo future testing to determine the full extent of the ailment it s a tough blow for lane and the ravens who also lost top wideout zay flowers to a hamstring injury in the victory rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury isn t considered serious lane s first nfl game saw him register one catch on three targets for 11 yards the ravens swooped on lane in the third round of the 2026 nfl draft and the usc product quickly grew buzz during the offseason and training camp work now he ll have to rebound from an injury and so too will the ravens devontez walker was inactive with a groin injury sunday and now with lane out for multiple weeks baltimore will need bigger contributions from lajohntay wester and chris moore from an already thin wr room the ravens 1 0 host the new orleans saints 0 1 on week 2 sunday

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray suffers concussion in first quarter of win over Packers
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Sunday's  39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers and did not return.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray suffered a concussion in sunday s 39 22 win over the green bay packers and did not return on a third and 7 scramble in the first quarter murray slid but took a big hit from packers defenders lukas van ness and javon bullard murray s helmet came off on the play and the veteran qb remained on the turf at u s bank stadium before eventually walking off under his own power and exiting to the locker room i have no update on how those evaluations have gone head coach kevin o connell said after the game we ll take it day by day and see how he comes in tomorrow o connell added that murray seemed to be doing well after the game but i wouldn t medically quote me on that bullard was flagged for unnecessary roughness on the play to prolong the vikings drive murray was just 11 plays into his debut with the vikings before exiting and went 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception carson wentz took over under center for minnesota going 12 of 19 for 133 yards with three touchdowns to lead the vikings to a comeback win

news_mentions.headline: Ravens RB Derrick Henry passes Marcus Allen for third on all-time rushing TD list
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens RB Derrick Henry rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of Sunday's win over the Indianapolis Colts to move into third all-time on the league's rushing TD list.
news_mentions.body_text: another season another year derrick henry appears set to defy father time the baltimore ravens running back rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of sunday s season opening 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts to move into third all time on the league s rushing td list he later added a third touchdown to cement another career day in his likely hall of fame career henry now has 125 career scores on the ground two ahead of hall of famer marcus allen 123 love marcus allen henry said after the game he s a great dude and for my name to be mentioned over his is an honor i m very grateful his record breaking score came in vintage henry fashion as he rumbled through the colts defense for an explosive 32 yard td to contribute to a 31 point first half for first year coach jesse minter henry finished with 144 yards on 24 carries as baltimore moved to 1 0

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Rams' Myles Garrett to undergo knee surgery, miss at least 4 games while on IR
news_mentions.description: Rams star defensive end Myles Garrett is set to undergo arthroscopic knee surgery and will be placed on injured reserve, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: myles garrett admitted he wasn t himself in thursday s loss to the san francisco 49ers now he ll be sidelined at least the next four weeks the los angeles rams pass rusher will undergo surgery on the knee that limited him during training camp and the season opener nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday garrett will head to injured reserve where he ll miss at least four games the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news following his offseason blockbuster trade from the cleveland browns garrett missed time due to a nagging knee injury the player and team both dismissed the issue as minor and suggested his absence was mostly maintenance however during thursday s season opener garrett clearly wasn t himself and admitted afterward that he was concerned about his knee during the game surely the 15 hour flight to and from australia didn t help the matter the reigning defensive player of the year generated a team high five qb pressures but earned zero sacks and zero tackles in the blowout loss losing garrett takes a bite out of the rams pass rush getting aaron donald who sat out week 1 on the field will be of some aid but losing garrett off the edge hurts the entire defense offenses won t have to worry about sending as many chips and helps that way for at least four games the rams face the giants broncos eagles and bills the next four weeks l a hosts the cardinals in week 6 the first game garrett would be eligible to return

news_mentions.description: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown is expected to miss six weeks with the high ankle sprain he suffered in Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: more clarity has emerged on a j brown s timeline to return from his week 1 injury the patriots receiver is expected to miss six weeks with the high ankle sprain he suffered in wednesday s season opening loss to the seahawks nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday morning brown was placed on injured reserve this week knocking him out for a minimum of four weeks the new england wideout is slated to be sidelined for at least two more than necessary the reigning afc champions are now expected to be without their top offseason acquisition for over a quarter of the 2026 season new england plays four 2025 playoff clubs in its next six games vs steelers at jaguars at bills vs raiders vs jets at bears before exiting wednesday s loss brown had three catches on four targets for 26 yards in his first game for new england since his offseason trade from philadelphia the pressure will be on drake maye to elevate the play of romeo doubs mack hollins demario douglas and his other pass catchers with brown out new england 0 1 hosts pittsburgh in its foxborough opener next sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling out at least a month with ankle sprain
news_mentions.description: The 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season. First-year receiver De'Zhaun Stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle.
news_mentions.body_text: the 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season first year receiver de 39 zhaun stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday per sources stribling is still seeking medical opinions and surgery is an option though not currently planned rapoport added the rookie wr suffered the injury in the first quarter of the 49ers season opening win over the rams in melbourne australia this past week stribling left the game in the second quarter without a target on 21 snaps san francisco selected stribling with the first pick of the second round of the 2026 nfl draft its first overall selection stribling s setback is the 49ers latest significant injury just as they were getting healthier ricky pearsall is already out for the season having undergone knee surgery in august defensive tackle alfred collins tore his patellar tendon during practice in australia and tight end jake tonges left the rams game with a knee injury george kittle and nick bosa just returned to game action this week from their 2025 season ending injuries without the rookie in brock purdy s receiving corps demarcus robinson deebo samuel and jacob cowing are slated for more action than expected early on newcomer mike evans led all 49ers wideouts with 48 snaps against l a followed by robinson 40 and samuel 26 san francisco 1 0 hosts the dolphins in its home opener on sept 20 at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Report: Texans, QB C.J. Stroud tabling extension talks until after season
news_mentions.description: After previously attempting to reach an extension, the Houston Texans and QB C.J. Stroud have agreed to table negotiations until after this season, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: c j stroud won t be among those striking a deadline deal ahead of sunday of week 1 after previously attempting to reach an extension the houston texans and their quarterback have agreed to pause negotiations until after this season nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported saturday stroud set to turn 25 on oct 3 is heading into his fourth season with the texans and despite discussions there doesn t need to be a great rush to get something done unlike tampa bay buccaneers qb baker mayfield and green bay packers tight end tucker kraft who each signed extensions this week to avoid playing out 2026 on a contract year stroud has two seasons remaining on his rookie deal after houston picked up his fifth year option the quarterback market is forever climbing topped by the kansas city chiefs patrick mahomes 64 million per year salary so stroud stands to make more money as long as he s patient and proves himself worthy of such a lucrative deal stroud s upcoming campaign will be crucial in regard to the latter element of the equation after winning offensive rookie of the year in 2023 with 4 108 passing yards 23 touchdowns and five interceptions stroud has played far more unevenly the past two seasons he s thrown for 6 768 yards 39 tds and 20 ints since 2024 with an 89 6 passer rating compared to his 100 8 rating as a rookie while it was uncharacteristic of a qb who still adeptly managed his squad to three playoff trips in three tries stroud melted down in his most recent postseason tossing five picks and fumbling five times across two games the texans have done nothing but sing his praises since though with countless players and personnel backing the qb should stroud rebound in year 4 and perhaps help shatter the divisional round ceiling that has limited houston in recent trips it ll only up his worth when the sides come back to the table stroud and houston kick off the 26 season with a heavyweight bout against the buffalo bills on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (knee) has no injury status, cleared for comeback Monday night vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Patrick Mahomes, nine months removed from tearing his ACL and LCL, has no injury designation and will start for his Chiefs on Monday night against the visiting Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: patrick mahomes is cleared for his comeback launch mahomes nine months removed from tearing his acl and lcl has no injury designation and will start for his kansas city chiefs on monday night against the visiting denver broncos this has been the goal all offseason for mahomes and the expectation as of late the three time super bowl winner was a full participant throughout the thursday saturday practice week while a major hurdle has been cleared for mahomes just how he performs on his surgically repaired knee is a question still left to be answered he ll have a tall task facing the broncos reigning afc west champions denver is bolstered by a stellar nik bonitto led pass rush and the chiefs are set to start undrafted free agent kahlil benson at left tackle in place of an injured josh simmons kansas city is coming off a 6 11 season in which it failed to make the playoffs for the first time since 2014 and had its streak of nine straight afc west titles snapped mahomes who had never fallen short of the postseason much less a division title until last season had his worst passing season statistically since becoming the chiefs starter in 2018 denver swept kansas city in 2025 though mahomes missed the second tilt after he tore multiple ligaments in week 15 against the los angeles chargers over 14 starts mahomes threw for 3 587 yards 22 touchdowns and 11 interceptions a six time pro bowler and three time super bowl mvp mahomes is set to begin his 10th year and age 31 season with his birthday right around the corner on sept 17 with mahomes and the chiefs looking for a massive comeback season the quarterback will make his eighth straight week 1 start when kansas city kicks off against denver at 8 15 p m et monday

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Packers TE Tucker Kraft agrees to 4-year, $75M extension right before Week 1
news_mentions.description: Tucker Kraft and the Packers have agreed to terms on a four-year, $75 million contract extension that can be worth up to $92 million, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport reported on Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: tucker kraft s 2025 season was cut short but he s most certainly in the green bay packers long term plans kraft and the packers have agreed to terms on a four year 75 million contract extension through 2030 that can be worth up to 92 million nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on saturday rapoport added that kraft received a 26 5 million signing bonus in the deal struck just a day before green bay s week 1 game against the minnesota vikings the packers have since announced extending kraft it s the latest extension doled out by the packers with general manager brian gutekunst having clearly identified the core players on the squad he wants to build around green bay s offseason has seen its share of departures such as wide receivers romeo doubs and dontayvion wicks but the packers have locked up cornerstone players on both sides of the ball kraft follows jayden reed and christian watson as offensive players who have recently received new contracts while linebacker isaiah mcduffie and defensive lineman devonte wyatt also earned extensions following news of wyatt s extension on july 20 rapoport said kraft could be next up in the extension line that s proved to be true as green bay has taken on a bit of a different connotation of late kraft s new deal comes with ample uncertainty as he s coming back from a torn acl that cut a sterling 2025 campaign short the 25 year old is good to go in week 1 without restrictions and green bay is clearly confident enough in his health to make a lucrative investment a third round pick in the 2023 nfl draft kraft emerged in his second season recording 50 receptions for 707 yards and seven touchdowns in 2025 though kraft was off to a scintillating start right along with the packers over the first seven games of the season green bay was 5 1 1 with kraft posting 30 catches 469 yards and six tds his run after the catch ability something to behold right along with his chemistry with quarterback jordan love he was injured in a week 9 upset loss to the carolina panthers and love and the packers offense were clearly hindered by his absence for the remainder of the season packers brass is banking on being buoyed by kraft s return in 2026 and beyond

news_mentions.headline: Report: Bears, D'Andre Swift agree to three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million in guaranteed money, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: d 39 andre swift s 2026 season will not be a contract year after all the chicago bears and swift have agreed to a three year 33 75 million extension that includes 27 5 million in guaranteed money espn s adam schefter reported on friday chicago officially announced swift s extension saturday morning the extension provides swift with a raise of more than 3 million in average annual salary and secures the running back s services through his age 30 season 2029 while also locking down a quality running back at a rate that fits swift s production and is also friendlier to the bears salary cap management swift began his career in detroit as a 2020 second round pick out of georgia and never quite progressed to a stage that warranted an extension with the lions who traded swift to philadelphia in 2023 after enjoying a career best year 1 263 scrimmage yards six total touchdowns with the eagles swift moved to chicago signing a three year 24 million deal with the bears in 2024 since then swift has proven himself as a reliably productive weapon averaging 1 365 5 scrimmage yards in his first two seasons with the bears and forming one half of a contrasting tandem with bruising back kyle monangai last season with swift in the window to sign one more lucrative deal and the final year of his existing contract beginning in 2026 bears general manager ryan poles made sure to sign his top back before the season began they ll kick off their 2026 journey on sunday against the panthers with one less financial matter on their checklist

news_mentions.headline: Report: 49ers give HC Kyle Shanahan multiyear contract extension
news_mentions.description: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason, ESPN confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: kyle shanahan kicked off 2026 with a masterful showing in the 49ers victory over the rams in australia but it wasn t the only win he scored this year the 49ers coach signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason espn confirmed friday the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news terms of the deal aren t yet known but shanahan s extension represents a deserved reward and sign of stability in san francisco where the coach has worked in tandem with general manager john lynch since both were hired in 2017 since the start of their partnership the 49ers have won three nfc west titles two nfc championships and have appeared in four conference championship games rising to the upper crust of the nfl hierarchy shanahan has a record of 83 67 over that span shanahan accomplished what was arguably his greatest feat last season guiding the injury ravaged 49ers to a 12 5 finish and a playoff win over the eagles on wild card weekend with that success still fresh in the minds of 49ers ownership the team decided it was time to reward the coach with additional security his performance in week 1 added a cherry on top shanahan previously was under contract through 2027
