news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

subplots across the nfc west catch up on the seattle seahawks offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location virginia mason athletic center renton wash fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs las vegas raiders 10 p m et on thursday aug 7 nfl network week 2 vs kansas city chiefs 10 p m et on friday aug 15 nfl network week 3 at green bay packers 4 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note seattle begins its season with three of four games against teams that didn t make the 2024 postseason and ends it with four of five versus non playoff squads nfl research what you need to know 1 under center for a new look seahawks offense sam darnold will command a whole lot of attention throughout training camp after three seasons as the seattle starter with a pair of pro bowl campaigns included geno smith was traded to the las vegas raiders in lieu of the seahawks extending him enter darnold who inked a three year 100 5 million deal however darnold has no guaranteed salary after this season and the team can save 27 5 million with a post june 1 2026 cut so with darnold coming off an excellent overall 2024 with the minnesota vikings and two disastrous games to end his campaign the spotlight of scrutiny will be bright even in cloudy washington skies seattle also brought back veteran no 2 drew lock and drafted jalen milroe who possesses eye popping athleticism and the unknown potential of a rookie qb whom fans always clamor to see even in camp darnold s mistakes will be dissected so every snap is important even the ones that don t count toward a final score 2 much of the seahawks offseason was about the notable names they lost geno smith dk metcalf and tyler lockett however seattle made a couple of splashes with the veteran signings of ex dallas cowboys pro bowler demarcus lawrence and former los angeles rams triple crown winner cooper kupp established veteran talent doesn t usually need to show out in training camp but just how realistic it is to hope for career renaissances from kupp and lawrence will be glimpsed in the summer lawrence missed 13 games last season due to a foot injury while kupp s injury woes resulted in 18 games missed over the past three years combined kupp has two games against his former squad to look forward to and lawrence didn t hesitate to offer some shade to his ex club but just how much they have left is likely to be a major factor in the seahawks 2025 fortunes 3 over the 2024 regular season sam darnold threw for career highs of 4 319 yards and 35 touchdowns with the minnesota vikings he averaged 3 08 seconds to throw third longest time in the nfl as he attempted 73 2 of his passes after 2 5 seconds the highest rate in the league according to nfl pro in the vikings playoff loss to the los angeles rams darnold was sacked nine times resulting in his lowest total epa generated last year 27 4 translation for darnold to work within the seahawks offense he needs to be protected well left tackle charles cross is a stalwart and how 2025 first rounder grey zabel comes along at left guard will be crucial at right tackle the biggest question for abraham lucas is staying healthy he s played in just 13 of a potential 34 games over the past two seasons perhaps the largest quandary and camp battle will come at center and right guard olu oluwatimi and jalen sundell will likely duke it out for the starting center spot while christian haynes anthony bradford and possibly sixth rounder bryce cabeldue will decide the right guard slot giving darnold time to work is paramount working out who will be tasked with doing that will be decided in camp

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks: Sam Darnold has 'very unique' soft-tissue injury, no firm timeline for return
material_news_signals.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is dealing with a "very unique soft-tissue injury" to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected, the team announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: seattle seahawks quarterback sam darnold is dealing with a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected the team announced monday darnold s injury is not considered to be a long term injury but there is no firm timeline on his return to the field darnold who led the seahawks to a super bowl title in his first season with the team exited wednesday s kickoff game win over the patriots with what was initially labeled a hip injury the seahawks returned to practice on monday and darnold was not seen on the field during the portion available to the media per espn seahawks head coach mike macdonald is next scheduled to speak to reporters on wednesday monday s update comes after nfl network insider ian rapoport reported thursday that darnold avoided a major injury and could miss a few weeks macdonald said during a radio interview that same day that the team received really really good news on darnold and later added that he hoped they would have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack by monday veteran drew lock would be in line to start seattle s week 2 game against the cardinals if darnold is unable to play lock went 16 of 22 for 187 yards with one touchdown in relief of darnold against new england

news_mentions.headline: Report: Texans, QB C.J. Stroud tabling extension talks until after season
news_mentions.description: After previously attempting to reach an extension, the Houston Texans and QB C.J. Stroud have agreed to table negotiations until after this season, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Saturday.
news_mentions.body_text: c j stroud won t be among those striking a deadline deal ahead of sunday of week 1 after previously attempting to reach an extension the houston texans and their quarterback have agreed to pause negotiations until after this season nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported saturday stroud set to turn 25 on oct 3 is heading into his fourth season with the texans and despite discussions there doesn t need to be a great rush to get something done unlike tampa bay buccaneers qb baker mayfield and green bay packers tight end tucker kraft who each signed extensions this week to avoid playing out 2026 on a contract year stroud has two seasons remaining on his rookie deal after houston picked up his fifth year option the quarterback market is forever climbing topped by the kansas city chiefs patrick mahomes 64 million per year salary so stroud stands to make more money as long as he s patient and proves himself worthy of such a lucrative deal stroud s upcoming campaign will be crucial in regard to the latter element of the equation after winning offensive rookie of the year in 2023 with 4 108 passing yards 23 touchdowns and five interceptions stroud has played far more unevenly the past two seasons he s thrown for 6 768 yards 39 tds and 20 ints since 2024 with an 89 6 passer rating compared to his 100 8 rating as a rookie while it was uncharacteristic of a qb who still adeptly managed his squad to three playoff trips in three tries stroud melted down in his most recent postseason tossing five picks and fumbling five times across two games the texans have done nothing but sing his praises since though with countless players and personnel backing the qb should stroud rebound in year 4 and perhaps help shatter the divisional round ceiling that has limited houston in recent trips it ll only up his worth when the sides come back to the table stroud and houston kick off the 26 season with a heavyweight bout against the buffalo bills on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their first 50 career games week 1 was gibbs 50th career game with two touchdowns in week 1 gibbs 51 career touchdowns only trail chuck foreman 55 jim brown 53 marcus allen 52 and larry johnson 52 on that list back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bills pull through in unexpected barnburner buffalo versus houston was expected to be one of the best matchups of week 1 that was certainly the case much less expected was the teams combining for 67 points in the end the bills did just enough on both ends to start the season with a win twice retaking the lead after houston was able to pull ahead in the fourth quarter their game winning drive was a seven play 96 yard march led by josh allen who hit dalton kincaid for a 35 yarder to flip the field and later josh palmer on a beautiful 34 yard strike for the go ahead score the drive was a microcosm of buffalo s day on offense as the bills still found resistance against houston s stellar d but was simply able to overcome it james cook nearly fumbled the game away on the drive s first play and allen threw a gimme to kamari lassiter one snap before buffalo s score that the cornerback couldn t corral despite racking up the most points houston has allowed since the 2023 season the bills still required a stop on defense as c j stroud began a potential statement drive with 1 36 remaining he did march the texans down to buffalo s 9 yard line but there the bills refused to break as deone walker sacked stroud on first and goal and gregory rousseau later clinched the win with a third down strip sack it was going to take a total team effort to beat a club of houston s quality and buffalo got one montgomery delivers back in workhorse role david montgomery came to houston for more opportunities and he saw plenty in his first game with the texans although he was inefficient on his carries 3 0 yards per attempt on 20 totes he exhibited a nose for the end zone scoring three of houston s four touchdowns he scored his first when the texans who notably struggled running in the red zone last year trusted him with three consecutive goal line carries his second an 18 yarder came as he cut into a huge hole opened by the texans offensive line and streaked untouched to the end zone montgomery also had three receptions for 19 yards including a 7 yard score he benefited the passing game beyond just his presence too the texans having a legitimate rushing game helped c j stroud 26 of 38 for 274 yards and two tds settle in and make some stellar throws it didn t result in a win sunday but the trade for montgomery looks like it will boost a texans offense that too often failed to hold up its end of the bargain in 2025 moore enjoys new digs it took a while for josh allen to target new acquisition dj moore but once he did the pair made the most of the new partnership moore collected his first look as a bill for an 18 yard catch with just under five minutes to play in the second quarter on the very next play he drew a 46 yard pass interference penalty that set up a 1 yard allen td plunge moore then made a brilliant catch on the following possession snagging the ball over a diving reed blankenship and keeping his feet in before streaking down the sideline for a 43 yard score though he was topped by dalton kincaid s 130 receiving yards which marked a career high for the tight end moore finished with a team leading eight targets five receptions 100 yards and the score his impact on buffalo s offense should silence those who thought he might be done after chicago or fail to carve out a role in a passing interceptions since sacks were first tracked in 1982 back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways jets start season at cruising altitude aaron glenn didn t earn his first win as head coach until week 8 of his first season in charge one game into 2026 his jets boast a winning record for the first time since week 3 of the 2024 campaign and deservedly so gang green was clicking all sides of the ball with a few exceptions geno smith played error free ball spreading the ball around to eight different receivers breece hall and braelon allen paced the offense with a plus rushing attack 142 yards on 32 carries new york dominated time of possession in part thanks to a second quarter near 12 minute drive glenn s defense much maligned in 2025 was stalwart allowing just 112 yards and six first downs through three quarters as the jets built a 20 3 lead qwan 39 tez stiggers and the jets special teams delivered some key stops and a takeaway on titans returns too new york hasn t looked this composed in all three phases in some time the jets lowly opponent notwithstanding they couldn t have asked for a better week 1 underwhelming start of saleh era in nashville donning fresh kits and a new outlook the titans looked on sunday like the same outfit that stumbled to a 3 14 campaign in 2025 robert saleh s defense was run through and put little pressure on new york s offensive line brian daboll s offense had no explosion the titans longest play was 14 yards and tennessee averaged just 4 0 yards per play cam ward was swamped by the jets pass rush getting pressured on 41 of his dropbacks and taking three sacks nissan stadium emptied out early partially due to a stifling tennessee heat but mostly due to the titans poor play leaving remaining local fans to boo and scream fire saleh audibly enough to be picked up by cbs boom mics and a sizable jets contingent to break out their notorious j e t s chants for saleh a former jets coach the result was the last thing he could have wanted with so much new in nashville an adjustment period is to be expected but the new look titans still look like a team at least a year away from contending gang green rookies don t look green the jets used their three first round picks to load up on talent with pass rusher david bailey tight end kenyon sadiq and wide receiver omar cooper all three made their presences felt on sunday if only briefly cooper delivered a yac happy 30 yard catch and run on new york s opening scoring drive that march ended with a nifty end around touchdown run for sadiq an athletic tight end with the motor to beat linebackers to the edge in the process sadiq joined hall of famer ozzie newsome 1978 as the only tes in nfl history with a rushing td in their first career game bailey got home in the third quarter logging his first nfl sack with help from the boundary and was a constant force in the backfield the no 2 pick logged a game high six qb pressures the one drawback cooper was forced from the game in the first half with an ankle injury and did not return but for bailey and sadiq the latter of whom was held out of most of training camp with an injury the opener was an unquestioned success and hopefully for new york a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for jets titans via nfl pro the jets ran from under center on 69 4 of called runs their highest rate under aaron glenn totaling 25 of their 36 called runs for 115 yards and two rushing touchdowns breece hall led with 17 under center rushing attempts for 85 yards and a touchdown including three explosive runs 10 yards tied for a career high nfl research the jets outgained tennessee by 172 total yards their largest total yards margin in week 1 since 2014 the last time geno smith was new york s week 1 starter back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways cards capitalize on chargers fourth quarter miscues mike lafleur s bunch was sunday s biggest surprise snapping a nine game losing streak carried over from the 2025 season the cardinals had a fourth quarter for the books one that included a blocked punt and two huge defensive stands the dam began to break for the chargers early in the fourth trailing 16 14 when cardinal simi fehoko shot through the middle to block a punt deep in chargers territory two plays later jacoby brissett hit trey mcbride for a 3 yard touchdown and a daniel carlson extra point put the cards up by two scores the flood gates continued to open on the next two chargers possessions as undrafted eighth year safety andrew wingard picked off a deep justin herbert pass before the cardinals forced a turnover on downs with 4 minutes to play holding los angeles to just seven second half points the cardinals couldn t ask for a better start to this new era lafleur s offense cooks with balanced effort the cardinals did a lot of good things offensively sunday mike lafleur with an infusion of shifts and motions orchestrated a balanced offense 34 rushes to 37 pass plays and put up nearly 400 yards the unit s first punt occurred with 2 minutes 47 seconds remaining in the third quarter and jacoby brissett looked more than worth that reworked contract playing efficiently and often delivering quick and accurate strikes he finished 27 of 37 passing for 277 yards and a touchdown to no one s surprise trey mcbride was his top target nine catches 95 yards and one td on 13 targets and it was promising to see kendrick bourne so involved he hauled in all eight of his targets for 75 yards it s worth noting marvin harrison made one catch albeit a nice one on three targets predictably tyler allgeier and jeremiyah love split the backfield workload with the veteran taking 17 carries for 61 yards on 41 snaps and the rookie 11 totes for 41 yards including a 5 yard touchdown run on 32 snaps there s a lot to like about this offense at first blush if it cleans up the pre snap penalties it ll keep arizona in a lot of games sluggish start for herbert l a our real first look at justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense was a mixed bag herbert looked dialed early leading an eight play 77 yard scoring drive hitting ladd mcconkey three times for 60 yards mcconkey was far and away herbert s favorite receiver in this one hauling in five catches for 82 yards with an 8 yard touchdown before a chest injury sidelined him just before the third quarter concluded his exit left los angeles without a reliable possession receiver and it showed as the chargers offense failed to reach cardinals territory on four fourth quarter possessions veteran tight end david njoku also had five catches sunday for 58 yards while herbert finished 17 of 27 for 209 yards a td and int with three sacks the offense converted twice on eight third down tries was 0 of 3 on fourth down and lost the possession battle by 15 minutes this offense has talent to be sure but this was one of the more concerning storylines from sunday next gen stats insight for cardinals chargers via nfl pro jeremiyah love forced six missed tackles in his nfl debut on 11 carries generating 38 of his 41 rushing yards after forcing a missed tackle most of his rushing production came on outside runs to the right side of the formation 28 yards on six carries with only two carries coming between the tackles nfl research mike lafleur became the first non interim head coach for the cardinals to win his first game since don coryell in 1973 back to top dan parr s takeaways raiders take baby steps it wasn t always pretty but first year head coach klint kubiak showed in the opener that he has elevated las vegas from the depths it fell to in recent years after spending the last two seasons at the bottom of the league the 27 13 win showed there is now a gap between them and a dolphins team that appears to be at the bottom right now it was the franchise s largest margin of victory since week 17 of the 2024 season and its first double digit win to open a season since 2017 ashton jeanty had one of the best games of his young career gaining 147 scrimmage yards on 29 touches 5 1 yards per touch and posting two touchdown catches the offensive line was functioning at a level that was missing all too often last year the raiders didn t even punt until the fourth quarter and scored 27 points a mark they reached only once last season in a week 9 loss qb questions for raiders are not going away kirk cousins isn t going to build confidence that he s long for the starting job with his performance on sunday yes cousins finished with three touchdown passes and completed 70 of his throws but he couldn t get much of anything going downfield he was 1 of 7 for 21 yards no tds and two interceptions on passes of 10 or more air yards per next gen stats he was without his top pass catcher tight end brock bowers but miami s four starters in the secondary had a combined three career starts entering sunday vegas is going to need more from cousins to be competitive against the league s better teams the drumbeat to start first overall pick fernando mendoza will grow louder with each week if the veteran qb can t connect with deep targets and turns the ball over like he did on sunday dolphins still have a long way to go week 1 confirmed that miami is very much in the beginning of a rebuild under new general manager jon eric sullivan and head coach jeff hafley in his first start with his new team quarterback malik willis had some nice moments but he also looked indecisive at times perhaps because his young wide receivers were not open and took five sacks the dolphins went 2 for 10 on third down and converted on only 1 of 3 trips to the red zone they didn t sack cousins and too often shot themselves in the foot including on special teams allowing two kick returns of 40 plus yards and missing a 41 yard field goal it s only going to get tougher from here with miami visiting the 49ers next week next gen stats insight for dolphins raiders via nfl pro the raiders used 21 personnel 2 rb 1 te 2 wr on 24 of their 67 offensive plays 35 8 their highest rate in the ngs era since 2016 las vegas posted 154 yards and two touchdowns out of 21 personnel averaging 6 4 yards per play both tds were scored by ashton jeanty who caught all four of his targets for 36 yards out of the grouping nfl research the raiders 27 point performance extended their streak to 38 consecutive games without reaching 30 points the longest active streak in the nfl back to top nick shook s takeaways flores defense keys comeback notorious for his penchant for dialing up blitzes minnesota defensive coordinator brian flores threw caution to the wind to start the season and sent his soldiers after the opposition all afternoon minnesota blitzed on 78 3 of defensive plays logging a pressure rate of 50 and throwing a massive purple and gold wrench into green bay s offensive plans though present throughout the contest and a frequent disruptor for green bay s offense in the first half the aggressive approach truly swung the game in favor of the vikings in the second half when flores understood green bay s offensive line could not properly handle his blitzes and he could manufacture one or more free rushers on any given down with the packers behind the sticks and desperate for a response flores unleashed his attacks wrecking jordan love s chances of keying a late rally and forcing takeaways that helped the vikings run away with the win even with an offseason of change intended to balance out the team s strengths the defense got the job done once again packers still can t overcome adversity for most of sunday s contest green bay appeared to be the better team the packers were leading despite lacking a running game their defense was causing all sorts of problems for carson wentz and the vikings offense they were outgaining minnesota significantly and it seemed they were one or two more stops from wrapping up a week 1 win over their division rivals it all fell apart in one possession though with a few questionable calls buying the vikings second third and fourth lives on a drive that ended with an aaron jones rushing score from there the wheels flew off the packers bus with flores sending relentless pressure and green bay s offensive line completely failing to pick up minnesota s blitzes jordan love melted down fumbling away possession and throwing an interception on the packers next drive in a fashion that was painfully reminiscent of the end of green bay s 2025 season in seemingly a flash the packers went from a likely week 1 winner to a runaway loser and despite all of the attempts to fix their issues in the offseason they ll walk away from this game mired in the same familiar feeling of disappointment nightmarish debut for kyler the kyler murray era was supposed to commence happily on sunday instead it began with an interception on murray s first attempt a desperation heave in the face of unblocked pressure murray s day didn t last much longer a third down scramble midway through the first quarter ended with murray sliding late and suffering a concussion when he was hit late sending the vikings back to the familiar place known as plan b carson wentz replaced murray and did a serviceable job but with murray entering concussion protocol the vikings might again find themselves in a position in which they must rely on a backup and hope for the best fortunately for them it worked out in their favor sunday next gen stats insight for packers vikings via nfl pro justin jefferson s 39 yard td reception from carson wentz was jefferson s first deep td 20 plus air yards since week 16 2024 nfl research sunday s win was the first game in vikings franchise history that it has won by 15 plus points despite being outgained by 150 plus total yards back to top kevin patra s takeaways eagles use big plays to outlast commanders much like the last several seasons the eagles offense wasn t pretty but it got the job done eking out a two point win over a division rival philly s offense was an inconsistent mess for much of the day with the offensive line struggling to pick up the new blocking scheme allowing far too many free runners into the backfield however nick sirianni s club used a trove of big plays that made the difference saquon barkley had a 42 yard scamper that helped set up a second quarter score jalen hurts who was up and down splashed three passes that went at least 30 yards including the difference making 43 yard catch and run td from dallas goedert the big plays covered for an offense that went three and out four times including three straight to start the second half there are obvious kinks to iron out with sean mannion s system but a win s a win commanders offense takes too long to get started like its counterpart washington s newly installed offense took time to make moves at times with both clubs breaking in new play callers sunday s game in philadelphia had a preseason feel through two quarters jayden daniels completed just six of 16 passes for 43 yards in the second half daniels picked things up used his legs more effectively and got an offense that was mostly stuck in the mud early into gear daniels guided the commanders to back to back fourth quarter touchdown drives using a slew of quick passes to knife through a good eagles d however a two point attempt shovel pass to tight end john bates was doa as the commanders fell shy new offensive coordinator david blough would probably like that call back returning after an injury riddled 2025 campaign to face a stout philly d in a new offense was a tough first ask for daniels washington s offense has a lot to clean up moving forward but at least the offensive line didn t get the qb killed allowing just two qb hits and one sack baun swarms for fangio s defense philly s lack of consistent pass rush is a concern especially given the state of the commanders offensive line yet linebacker zack baun continued to anchor the middle of the defense the pro bowler flew all over the field gobbling up 12 tackles including one for loss and generated the eagles only two passes defensed on the day baun stood out among a philly d that was solid but not otherworldly as they ve been cooper dejean got worked at times allowing seven catches on nine targets in coverage for 83 yards and a td the pass rush went silent for stretches and didn t provide enough pop the middle of the d led by jalen carter jordan davis and moro ojomo however was solid combining for 13 tackles two run stuffs and ojomo destroyed the two point attempt the eagles held the commanders to 295 total yards the 19th game holding their opponent under 300 yards since vic fangio took over in 2024 second in the nfl behind the seahawks 21 next gen stats insight for commanders eagles via nfl pro jalen hurts completed six of nine downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage total on those throws was the eighth highest of his career while he threw three or more downfield touchdowns for just the sixth time nfl research the eagles won their sixth straight week 1 game the longest active streak in the nfl nick sirianni is the fifth head coach to win each of his first six career season openers joining jim harbaugh mike shanahan potsy clark and hall of famer george allen back to top grant gordon s takeaways what a way to kick off the harbaugh era jaxson dart was back so too were malik nabers and cam skattebo each of them making contributions to knock off the rival cowboys in head coach john harbaugh s gotham debut facing a franchise that popularized the triplets term the giants young franchise trio of dart nabers and skattebo proved to be the offensive catalyst buoyed by their defense forcing an opening three and out the giants offense responded with a 10 play 83 yard scoring march in which dart used his arm and legs to guide them when the quarterback took a dirty and savage hit along the sideline that drew a flag his teammates surrounded him in unity dart was marvelous to the tune of 23 of 29 passing for 230 yards three touchdowns and 54 rushing yards nabers six receptions for 69 yards got his first licks out of the way coming back from a torn acl and meniscus that had sidelined him since week 4 of last year after his opening score skattebo coming back from a busted ankle predictably backflipped and proceeded to churn out 81 hard yards this was the start harbaugh and the franchise needed and wanted their young guns were firing against a hated adversary this wasn t a pretty game too many penalties too many fumbles some drops but for harbaugh and new york it was a beautiful result for the franchise s new dawn cowboys start big season with dud brian schottenheimer dak prescott and co haven t shied away from proclaiming their belief that they can and will be going to the super bowl an uncharacteristically drama free offseason helped to fuel the confidence but dallas fell flat to start the season with an surprisingly dreadful offensive performance that equated to a loss to a division rival it s used to dominating deep into the fourth quarter prescott s offense had less than 200 yards ceedee lamb and george pickens had bad drops prescott 175 yards two touchdowns had an ugly interception and everything looked off even when the cowboys made it a one score game javonte williams foolishly drew an unsportsmanlike penalty on his touchdown catch high hopes aren t shot down in week 1 but dallas was reminded nothing s coming easy and these cowboys aren t riding into the sunset anytime soon if they don t execute to their potential harbaugh giants hold tight john harbaugh s time in baltimore came to a close after his 19th season with the campaign ending well short of expectations thanks to five one score losses and three blown fourth quarter leads in 2025 the first of those was a bitter 41 40 loss to the bills on sunday night to open the campaign last september the 2025 giants meanwhile blew an incredible five fourth quarter leads in a victory symbolic of exorcising the ghosts of blown leads past these giants held on when the cowboys cut the deficit to the final score big blue s second year qb found his most fitting target isaiah likely who converted a third and 9 with a 12 yard pick up likely converted another third down later on the drive before skattebo salted away the win with the final first down needed likely a longtime former raven had a game high eight catches for 78 yards and two scores in so many ways this is a great vibes win for new york as it aims to build a winner next gen stats insight for cowboys giants via nfl pro odell beckham playing his first game with the giants since dec 12 2018 played 11 snaps with seven routes run and no targets nfl research sunday night saw the giants defeat the cowboys for just the third time in the last 19 meetings it was the 12th week 1 meeting between the rivals and new york won for just the second time in such instances back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top
