news_mentions.body_text: i may be biased but i strongly believe this is one of the most important articles in all of fantasy the week 2 waiver wire column some of the names listed below could end up winning leagues at the very least several of them could be difference makers in the immediate future do not take the waiver wire for granted this is where the rubber meets the road in our imaginary game i ll be here every week from now until fantasy championships hope to have you along for the full ride let s win some hardware notes players must be rostered in less than 60 of espn leagues to be eligible for the column all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted and here are my top waiver targets by position quarterbacks running backs minnesota vikings rb jordan mason is too highly rostered to make our list 68 but he s still available in more than 30 of espn leagues if yours is one of them add mason immediately wide receivers san francisco 49ers wr deebo samuel is already rostered in 68 of leagues but he might be worth adding in the other 32 with de zhaun stribling out at least a month tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray suffers concussion in first quarter of win over Packers
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Sunday's  39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers and did not return.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray suffered a concussion in sunday s 39 22 win over the green bay packers and did not return on a third and 7 scramble in the first quarter murray slid but took a big hit from packers defenders lukas van ness and javon bullard murray s helmet came off on the play and the veteran qb remained on the turf at u s bank stadium before eventually walking off under his own power and exiting to the locker room i have no update on how those evaluations have gone head coach kevin o connell said after the game we ll take it day by day and see how he comes in tomorrow o connell added that murray seemed to be doing well after the game but i wouldn t medically quote me on that bullard was flagged for unnecessary roughness on the play to prolong the vikings drive murray was just 11 plays into his debut with the vikings before exiting and went 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception carson wentz took over under center for minnesota going 12 of 19 for 133 yards with three touchdowns to lead the vikings to a comeback win

news_mentions.headline: Report: Bears, D'Andre Swift agree to three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million in guaranteed money, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: d 39 andre swift s 2026 season will not be a contract year after all the chicago bears and swift have agreed to a three year 33 75 million extension that includes 27 5 million in guaranteed money espn s adam schefter reported on friday chicago officially announced swift s extension saturday morning the extension provides swift with a raise of more than 3 million in average annual salary and secures the running back s services through his age 30 season 2029 while also locking down a quality running back at a rate that fits swift s production and is also friendlier to the bears salary cap management swift began his career in detroit as a 2020 second round pick out of georgia and never quite progressed to a stage that warranted an extension with the lions who traded swift to philadelphia in 2023 after enjoying a career best year 1 263 scrimmage yards six total touchdowns with the eagles swift moved to chicago signing a three year 24 million deal with the bears in 2024 since then swift has proven himself as a reliably productive weapon averaging 1 365 5 scrimmage yards in his first two seasons with the bears and forming one half of a contrasting tandem with bruising back kyle monangai last season with swift in the window to sign one more lucrative deal and the final year of his existing contract beginning in 2026 bears general manager ryan poles made sure to sign his top back before the season began they ll kick off their 2026 journey on sunday against the panthers with one less financial matter on their checklist

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their first 50 career games week 1 was gibbs 50th career game with two touchdowns in week 1 gibbs 51 career touchdowns only trail chuck foreman 55 jim brown 53 marcus allen 52 and larry johnson 52 on that list back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bills pull through in unexpected barnburner buffalo versus houston was expected to be one of the best matchups of week 1 that was certainly the case much less expected was the teams combining for 67 points in the end the bills did just enough on both ends to start the season with a win twice retaking the lead after houston was able to pull ahead in the fourth quarter their game winning drive was a seven play 96 yard march led by josh allen who hit dalton kincaid for a 35 yarder to flip the field and later josh palmer on a beautiful 34 yard strike for the go ahead score the drive was a microcosm of buffalo s day on offense as the bills still found resistance against houston s stellar d but was simply able to overcome it james cook nearly fumbled the game away on the drive s first play and allen threw a gimme to kamari lassiter one snap before buffalo s score that the cornerback couldn t corral despite racking up the most points houston has allowed since the 2023 season the bills still required a stop on defense as c j stroud began a potential statement drive with 1 36 remaining he did march the texans down to buffalo s 9 yard line but there the bills refused to break as deone walker sacked stroud on first and goal and gregory rousseau later clinched the win with a third down strip sack it was going to take a total team effort to beat a club of houston s quality and buffalo got one montgomery delivers back in workhorse role david montgomery came to houston for more opportunities and he saw plenty in his first game with the texans although he was inefficient on his carries 3 0 yards per attempt on 20 totes he exhibited a nose for the end zone scoring three of houston s four touchdowns he scored his first when the texans who notably struggled running in the red zone last year trusted him with three consecutive goal line carries his second an 18 yarder came as he cut into a huge hole opened by the texans offensive line and streaked untouched to the end zone montgomery also had three receptions for 19 yards including a 7 yard score he benefited the passing game beyond just his presence too the texans having a legitimate rushing game helped c j stroud 26 of 38 for 274 yards and two tds settle in and make some stellar throws it didn t result in a win sunday but the trade for montgomery looks like it will boost a texans offense that too often failed to hold up its end of the bargain in 2025 moore enjoys new digs it took a while for josh allen to target new acquisition dj moore but once he did the pair made the most of the new partnership moore collected his first look as a bill for an 18 yard catch with just under five minutes to play in the second quarter on the very next play he drew a 46 yard pass interference penalty that set up a 1 yard allen td plunge moore then made a brilliant catch on the following possession snagging the ball over a diving reed blankenship and keeping his feet in before streaking down the sideline for a 43 yard score though he was topped by dalton kincaid s 130 receiving yards which marked a career high for the tight end moore finished with a team leading eight targets five receptions 100 yards and the score his impact on buffalo s offense should silence those who thought he might be done after chicago or fail to carve out a role in a passing attack that loves to spread the ball around next gen stats insight for bills texans via nfl pro houston blitzed on only 18 8 of dropbacks allowing 287 passing yards two touchdowns and a 144 7 passer rating on plays without blitzing nfl research josh allen became the 12th player to reach 80 rushing touchdowns by his ninth season and the first quarterback in the nfl to have 80 career scores on the ground back to top bobby kownack s takeaways impressive ravens offense stalled by injuries baltimore s offense functioned seamlessly early on against the colts to put up 31 points before halftime the team s second most first half points to ever open a season the output was especially impressive considering lamar jackson and co were breaking in offensive coordinator declan doyle s new system jackson who struggled with injuries sapping his effectiveness throughout a trying 2025 season looked especially rejuvenated although he did lose a fumble jackson s signature elusiveness appeared to be back he rushed four times for 43 yards excluding three kneel downs and a score escaped sure sacks on several occasions and threw it tremendously too with 324 yards on 17 of 22 passing derrick henry continues to look ageless rumbling his way to 144 rushing yards and three touchdowns with a ferocity and the jackson zay flowers connection was unstoppable jackson enjoyed a perfect 158 3 passer rating on his six targets to flowers which went for five catches 150 yards and a touchdown unfortunately flowers left before halftime with a hamstring injury and rookie ja 39 kobi lane who was involved and caught a touchdown that was called back for offensive holding also got knocked out by a wrist injury the offense understandably looked different in the second half following those departures leaning on henry even more while adding just 10 more points while it was a tremendous play calling debut by doyle the injuries could loom large moving forward taylor was one of few bright spots for colts it was ugly for indianapolis which fell into a 28 6 hole after marching 65 yards for a touchdown to open the game outside of forcing a second quarter turnover to prevent baltimore from potentially putting together a third consecutive td drive and fortifying a bit after lamar jackson no longer had zay flowers to torment them with the colts were completely lost on defense they gave up 506 total net yards and were ineffective against the pass and the run perhaps the most important takeaway for indy long term is that daniel jones came away looking healthy but he never got much going jones finished 19 of 31 for 166 yards an early pick and a mostly meaningless late touchdown to tyler warren as has often been the case in recent years jonathan taylor proved to be the colts surest means of production he punched in two scores and collected 121 yards on 22 touches while averaging 5 2 yards per carry with five of his attempts going for 10 plus yards per next gen stats it s great knowing the colts can count on taylor but everyone else around him needs to raise their game minter gets a in first game as head coach it s hard to imagine a head coaching debut going much better than jesse minter s his ravens destroyed the colts even the lopsided 41 23 score made the result seem far closer than it was baltimore s defense the coach s specialty was unable to limit jonathan taylor but marlon humphrey did force and recover a fumble from the rb at a point when the game still felt somewhat in the balance roquan smith contributed 11 tackles and collected an interception after going without one for the first time in his career last year trey hendrickson also fit in spectacularly as he delivered a game high eight quarterback pressures and when things got a little hairy in the second half following an injury to zay flowers baltimore made the correct adjustments counting on derrick henry to help milk the game away this was minter s seventh week 1 as an nfl coach having spent four years on the ravens staff previously and the past two years as the chargers defensive coordinator his teams are now 7 0 in week 1 and his defenses have allowed 10 4 points per game in those contests per nfl research next gen stats insight for ravens colts via nfl pro the ravens defense posted a 58 6 pressure rate and two sacks when trey hendrickson was on the field nfl research zay flowers recorded a career high 150 receiving yards prior to leaving in the second quarter with a hamstring injury flowers has averaged 102 0 receiving yards per game in week 1 in his career the fourth most by a player in nfl history to have played multiple week 1 games michael irvin 106 8 tyreek hill 104 9 and antonio brown 103 3 back to top nick shook s takeaways jaguars pick up right where they left off one of the most entertaining storylines of the latter portion of the 2025 season existed in jacksonville where liam coen s offense hit its stride and became one of the most explosive units in football judging by how it performed sunday rust never had a chance of affecting this group trevor lawrence was dialed in from the start leading two touchdown drives that ended in much different but equally impressive lawrence touchdown passes jacksonville moved up and down the field with ease piling up 363 offensive yards and converting over 50 percent of its third downs at times it seemed as if lawrence was spending his sunday playing 7 on 7 bhayshul tuten got off to an encouraging start in his new role as lead back receiving 15 carries for 66 yards and parker washington five catches 83 yards one touchdown continued to be the most important player not named lawrence in jacksonville collectively it was business as usual in jacksonville which is just how the jaguars like it watson s first start goes even worse than expected deshaun watson s selection as browns starter defied logic and his performance sunday only made reality more frustrating for browns fans watson threw an ugly interception on his third pass attempt of the season routinely appeared overwhelmed by the speed of the game and a pass rush that eagerly feasted on his unusually long pass drops and frequently missed his targets even when free from pressure his only high quality throw of the game came in garbage time when he launched a deep ball to denzel boston for the rookie s first touchdown sure the browns didn t help themselves 11 accepted penalties for 75 yards but in any other scenario with any other team there would be no reason watson is playing these browns are a unique case though and they ll likely subject their fans to this misery again for at least one more week jacksonville s pass rush feasts when reviewing the jaguars entering the 2026 season it was fair to have some questions regarding their defense could josh hines allen and travon walker key a consistently effective pass rush might the secondary come together quickly especially with travis hunter back in the mix for one week the answer was a resounding yes jacksonville piled up five sacks hines allen and walker combined for three of them limited the browns to 1 of 8 on third down forced two turnovers and was inches from a third and held cleveland to 132 total yards through three quarters this is only one game and isn t a proper barometer for where the jaguars stand but for one sunday it was magically delicious next gen stats insight for browns jaguars via nfl pro trevor lawrence was pressured on just five pass attempts and completed two for 62 yards and two touchdowns posting a stellar passer rating of 126 7 under duress nfl research the jaguars have won nine consecutive games dating back to last season tied for the second longest win streak in franchise history their 24 point victory is the second largest margin of victory in a season opener back to top kevin patra s takeaways watt d carried steelers to victory with the steelers offense unable to cash in t j watt decided to do it himself the star pass rusher plucked a cooper rush pass and dashed to the end zone for the eventual game deciding touchdown the pittsburgh defensive line controlled most of the contest holding bijan robinson down early and bamboozling rush the stars shined for the steelers watt generated two sacks ditto for alex highsmith cameron heyward was playing volleyball swatting three passes pittsburgh held atlanta to 2 back generated 173 of the falcons 263 scrimmage yards 83 rushing yards on 21 carries 90 receiving yards on eight catches with a td cooper rush was thrust into a tough spot making the week 1 start situation is sorted atlanta will struggle to put up points pittsburgh offense dk had a forgettable week 1 the positive a 42 year old aaron rodgers looked spry enough and comfortable in mike mccarthy s metcalf struggled to come down the ball repeatedly metcalf caught just four of 10 targets for 40 yards and was called for a couple of offensive pass interference penalties metcalf flubbed several potential big plays on beautiful throws from rodgers the run game was silenced averaging 2 8 yards per carry with neither jaylen warren nor rico dowdle able to find any consistency put in poor down and distance repeatedly the steelers generated just 15 first downs and 264 total yards while going 3 13 on third downs next gen stats insight for steelers falcons via nfl pro aaron rodgers 9 2 air yards per target against the falcons are the most he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw being the third highest average in a game as a steeler on passes under efficiency dropped completing just four of 12 33 3 of his passes for 73 yards and one touchdown nfl research t j watt joined julius peppers as the only players with 100 plus sacks and 10 plus interceptions since sacks were first tracked in 1982 back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways jets start season at cruising altitude aaron glenn didn t earn his first win as head coach until week 8 of his first season in charge one game into 2026 his jets boast a winning record for the first time since week 3 of the 2024 campaign and deservedly so gang green was clicking all sides of the ball with a few exceptions geno smith played error free ball spreading the ball around to eight different receivers breece hall and braelon allen paced the offense with a plus rushing attack 142 yards on 32 carries new york dominated time of possession in part thanks to a second quarter near 12 minute drive glenn s defense much maligned in 2025 was stalwart allowing just 112 yards and six first downs through three quarters as the jets built a 20 3 lead qwan 39 tez stiggers and the jets special teams delivered some key stops and a takeaway on titans returns too new york hasn t looked this composed in all three phases in some time the jets lowly opponent notwithstanding they couldn t have asked for a better week 1 underwhelming start of saleh era in nashville donning fresh kits and a new outlook the titans looked on sunday like the same outfit that stumbled to a 3 14 campaign in 2025 robert saleh s defense was run through and put little pressure on new york s offensive line brian daboll s offense had no explosion the titans longest play was 14 yards and tennessee averaged just 4 0 yards per play cam ward was swamped by the jets pass rush getting pressured on 41 of his dropbacks and taking three sacks nissan stadium emptied out early partially due to a stifling tennessee heat but mostly due to the titans poor play leaving remaining local fans to boo and scream fire saleh audibly enough to be picked up by cbs boom mics and a sizable jets contingent to break out their notorious j e t s chants for saleh a former jets coach the result was the last thing he could have wanted with so much new in nashville an adjustment period is to be expected but the new look titans still look like a team at least a year away from contending gang green rookies don t look green the jets used their three first round picks to load up on talent with pass rusher david bailey tight end kenyon sadiq and wide receiver omar cooper all three made their presences felt on sunday if only briefly cooper delivered a yac happy 30 yard catch and run on new york s opening scoring drive that march ended with a nifty end around touchdown run for sadiq an athletic tight end with the motor to beat linebackers to the edge in the process sadiq joined hall of famer ozzie newsome 1978 as the only tes in nfl history with a rushing td in their first career game bailey got home in the third quarter logging his first nfl sack with help from the boundary and was a constant force in the backfield the no 2 pick logged a game high six qb pressures the one drawback cooper was forced from the game in the first half with an ankle injury and did not return but for bailey and sadiq the latter of whom was held out of most of training camp with an injury the opener was an unquestioned success and hopefully for new york a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for jets titans via nfl pro the jets ran from under center on 69 4 of called runs their highest rate under aaron glenn totaling 25 of their 36 called runs for 115 yards and two rushing touchdowns breece hall led with 17 under center rushing attempts for 85 yards and a touchdown including three explosive runs 10 yards tied for a career high nfl research the jets outgained tennessee by 172 total yards their largest total yards margin in week 1 since 2014 the last time geno smith was new york s week 1 starter back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways cards capitalize on chargers fourth quarter miscues mike lafleur s bunch was sunday s biggest surprise snapping a nine game losing streak carried over from the 2025 season the cardinals had a fourth quarter for the books one that included a blocked punt and two huge defensive stands the dam began to break for the chargers early in the fourth trailing 16 14 when cardinal simi fehoko shot through the middle to block a punt deep in chargers territory two plays later jacoby brissett hit trey mcbride for a 3 yard touchdown and a daniel carlson extra point put the cards up by two scores the flood gates continued to open on the next two chargers possessions as undrafted eighth year safety andrew wingard picked off a deep justin herbert pass before the cardinals forced a turnover on downs with 4 minutes to play holding los angeles to just seven second half points the cardinals couldn t ask for a better start to this new era lafleur s offense cooks with balanced effort the cardinals did a lot of good things offensively sunday mike lafleur with an infusion of shifts and motions orchestrated a balanced offense 34 rushes to 37 pass plays and put up nearly 400 yards the unit s first punt occurred with 2 minutes 47 seconds remaining in the third quarter and jacoby brissett looked more than worth that reworked contract playing efficiently and often delivering quick and accurate strikes he finished 27 of 37 passing for 277 yards and a touchdown to no one s surprise trey mcbride was his top target nine catches 95 yards and one td on 13 targets and it was promising to see kendrick bourne so involved he hauled in all eight of his targets for 75 yards it s worth noting marvin harrison made one catch albeit a nice one on three targets predictably tyler allgeier and jeremiyah love split the backfield workload with the veteran taking 17 carries for 61 yards on 41 snaps and the rookie 11 totes for 41 yards including a 5 yard touchdown run on 32 snaps there s a lot to like about this offense at first blush if it cleans up the pre snap penalties it ll keep arizona in a lot of games sluggish start for herbert l a our real first look at justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense was a mixed bag herbert looked dialed early leading an eight play 77 yard scoring drive hitting ladd mcconkey three times for 60 yards mcconkey was far and away herbert s favorite receiver in this one hauling in five catches for 82 yards with an 8 yard touchdown before a chest injury sidelined him just before the third quarter concluded his exit left los angeles without a reliable possession receiver and it showed as the chargers offense failed to reach cardinals territory on four fourth quarter possessions veteran tight end david njoku also had five catches sunday for 58 yards while herbert finished 17 of 27 for 209 yards a td and int with three sacks the offense converted twice on eight third down tries was 0 of 3 on fourth down and lost the possession battle by 15 minutes this offense has talent to be sure but this was one of the more concerning storylines from sunday next gen stats insight for cardinals chargers via nfl pro jeremiyah love forced six missed tackles in his nfl debut on 11 carries generating 38 of his 41 rushing yards after forcing a missed tackle most of his rushing production came on outside runs to the right side of the formation 28 yards on six carries with only two carries coming between the tackles nfl research mike lafleur became the first non interim head coach for the cardinals to win his first game since don coryell in 1973 back to top dan parr s takeaways raiders take baby steps it wasn t always pretty but first year head coach klint kubiak showed in the opener that he has elevated las vegas from the depths it fell to in recent years after spending the last two seasons at the bottom of the league the 27 13 win showed there is now a gap between them and a dolphins team that appears to be at the bottom right now it was the franchise s largest margin of victory since week 17 of the 2024 season and its first double digit win to open a season since 2017 ashton jeanty had one of the best games of his young career gaining 147 scrimmage yards on 29 touches 5 1 yards per touch and posting two touchdown catches the offensive line was functioning at a level that was missing all too often last year the raiders didn t even punt until the fourth quarter and scored 27 points a mark they reached only once last season in a week 9 loss qb questions for raiders are not going away kirk cousins isn t going to build confidence that he s long for the starting job with his performance on sunday yes cousins finished with three touchdown passes and completed 70 of his throws but he couldn t get much of anything going downfield he was 1 of 7 for 21 yards no tds and two interceptions on passes of 10 or more air yards per next gen stats he was without his top pass catcher tight end brock bowers but miami s four starters in the secondary had a combined three career starts entering sunday vegas is going to need more from cousins to be competitive against the league s better teams the drumbeat to start first overall pick fernando mendoza will grow louder with each week if the veteran qb can t connect with deep targets and turns the ball over like he did on sunday dolphins still have a long way to go week 1 confirmed that miami is very much in the beginning of a rebuild under new general manager jon eric sullivan and head coach jeff hafley in his first start with his new team quarterback malik willis had some nice moments but he also looked indecisive at times perhaps because his young wide receivers were not open and took five sacks the dolphins went 2 for 10 on third down and converted on only 1 of 3 trips to the red zone they didn t sack cousins and too often shot themselves in the foot including on special teams allowing two kick returns of 40 plus yards and missing a 41 yard field goal it s only going to get tougher from here with miami visiting the 49ers next week next gen stats insight for dolphins raiders via nfl pro the raiders used 21 personnel 2 rb 1 te 2 wr on 24 of their 67 offensive plays 35 8 their highest rate in the ngs era since 2016 las vegas posted 154 yards and two touchdowns out of 21 personnel averaging 6 4 yards per play both tds were scored by ashton jeanty who caught all four of his targets for 36 yards out of the grouping nfl research the raiders 27 point performance extended their streak to 38 consecutive games without reaching 30 points the longest active streak in the nfl back to top nick shook s takeaways flores defense keys comeback notorious for his penchant for dialing up blitzes minnesota defensive coordinator brian flores threw caution to the wind to start the season and sent his soldiers after the opposition all afternoon minnesota blitzed on 78 3 of defensive plays logging a pressure rate of 50 and throwing a massive purple and gold wrench into green bay s offensive plans though present throughout the contest and a frequent disruptor for green bay s offense in the first half the aggressive approach truly swung the game in favor of the vikings in the second half when flores understood green bay s offensive line could not properly handle his blitzes and he could manufacture one or more free rushers on any given down with the packers behind the sticks and desperate for a response flores unleashed his attacks wrecking jordan love s chances of keying a late rally and forcing takeaways that helped the vikings run away with the win even with an offseason of change intended to balance out the team s strengths the defense got the job done once again packers still can t overcome adversity for most of sunday s contest green bay appeared to be the better team the packers were leading despite lacking a running game their defense was causing all sorts of problems for carson wentz and the vikings offense they were outgaining minnesota significantly and it seemed they were one or two more stops from wrapping up a week 1 win over their division rivals it all fell apart in one possession though with a few questionable calls buying the vikings second third and fourth lives on a drive that ended with an aaron jones rushing score from there the wheels flew off the packers bus with flores sending relentless pressure and green bay s offensive line completely failing to pick up minnesota s blitzes jordan love melted down fumbling away possession and throwing an interception on the packers next drive in a fashion that was painfully reminiscent of the end of green bay s 2025 season in seemingly a flash the packers went from a likely week 1 winner to a runaway loser and despite all of the attempts to fix their issues in the offseason they ll walk away from this game mired in the same familiar feeling of disappointment nightmarish debut for kyler the kyler murray era was supposed to commence happily on sunday instead it began with an interception on murray s first attempt a desperation heave in the face of unblocked pressure murray s day didn t last much longer a third down scramble midway through the first quarter ended with murray sliding late and suffering a concussion when he was hit late sending the vikings back to the familiar place known as plan b carson wentz replaced murray and did a serviceable job but with murray entering concussion protocol the vikings might again find themselves in a position in which they must rely on a backup and hope for the best fortunately for them it worked out in their favor sunday next gen stats insight for packers vikings via nfl pro justin jefferson s 39 yard td reception from carson wentz was jefferson s first deep td 20 plus air yards since week 16 2024 nfl research sunday s win was the first game in vikings franchise history that it has won by 15 plus points despite being outgained by 150 plus total yards back to top kevin patra s takeaways eagles use big plays to outlast commanders much like the last several seasons the eagles offense wasn t pretty but it got the job done eking out a two point win over a division rival philly s offense was an inconsistent mess for much of the day with the offensive line struggling to pick up the new blocking scheme allowing far too many free runners into the backfield however nick sirianni s club used a trove of big plays that made the difference saquon barkley had a 42 yard scamper that helped set up a second quarter score jalen hurts who was up and down splashed three passes that went at least 30 yards including the difference making 43 yard catch and run td from dallas goedert the big plays covered for an offense that went three and out four times including three straight to start the second half there are obvious kinks to iron out with sean mannion s system but a win s a win commanders offense takes too long to get started like its counterpart washington s newly installed offense took time to make moves at times with both clubs breaking in new play callers sunday s game in philadelphia had a preseason feel through two quarters jayden daniels completed just six of 16 passes for 43 yards in the second half daniels picked things up used his legs more effectively and got an offense that was mostly stuck in the mud early into gear daniels guided the commanders to back to back fourth quarter touchdown drives using a slew of quick passes to knife through a good eagles d however a two point attempt shovel pass to tight end john bates was doa as the commanders fell shy new offensive coordinator david blough would probably like that call back returning after an injury riddled 2025 campaign to face a stout philly d in a new offense was a tough first ask for daniels washington s offense has a lot to clean up moving forward but at least the offensive line didn t get the qb killed allowing just two qb hits and one sack baun swarms for fangio s defense philly s lack of consistent pass rush is a concern especially given the state of the commanders offensive line yet linebacker zack baun continued to anchor the middle of the defense the pro bowler flew all over the field gobbling up 12 tackles including one for loss and generated the eagles only two passes defensed on the day baun stood out among a philly d that was solid but not otherworldly as they ve been cooper dejean got worked at times allowing seven catches on nine targets in coverage for 83 yards and a td the pass rush went silent for stretches and didn t provide enough pop the middle of the d led by jalen carter jordan davis and moro ojomo however was solid combining for 13 tackles two run stuffs and ojomo destroyed the two point attempt the eagles held the commanders to 295 total yards the 19th game holding their opponent under 300 yards since vic fangio took over in 2024 second in the nfl behind the seahawks 21 next gen stats insight for commanders eagles via nfl pro jalen hurts completed six of nine downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage total on those throws was the eighth highest of his career while he threw three or more downfield touchdowns for just the sixth time nfl research the eagles won their sixth straight week 1 game the longest active streak in the nfl nick sirianni is the fifth head coach to win each of his first six career season openers joining jim harbaugh mike shanahan potsy clark and hall of famer george allen back to top grant gordon s takeaways what a way to kick off the harbaugh era jaxson dart was back so too were malik nabers and cam skattebo each of them making contributions to knock off the rival cowboys in head coach john harbaugh s gotham debut facing a franchise that popularized the triplets term the giants young franchise trio of dart nabers and skattebo proved to be the offensive catalyst buoyed by their defense forcing an opening three and out the giants offense responded with a 10 play 83 yard scoring march in which dart used his arm and legs to guide them when the quarterback took a dirty and savage hit along the sideline that drew a flag his teammates surrounded him in unity dart was marvelous to the tune of 23 of 29 passing for 230 yards three touchdowns and 54 rushing yards nabers six receptions for 69 yards got his first licks out of the way coming back from a torn acl and meniscus that had sidelined him since week 4 of last year after his opening score skattebo coming back from a busted ankle predictably backflipped and proceeded to churn out 81 hard yards this was the start harbaugh and the franchise needed and wanted their young guns were firing against a hated adversary this wasn t a pretty game too many penalties too many fumbles some drops but for harbaugh and new york it was a beautiful result for the franchise s new dawn cowboys start big season with dud brian schottenheimer dak prescott and co haven t shied away from proclaiming their belief that they can and will be going to the super bowl an uncharacteristically drama free offseason helped to fuel the confidence but dallas fell flat to start the season with an surprisingly dreadful offensive performance that equated to a loss to a division rival it s used to dominating deep into the fourth quarter prescott s offense had less than 200 yards ceedee lamb and george pickens had bad drops prescott 175 yards two touchdowns had an ugly interception and everything looked off even when the cowboys made it a one score game javonte williams foolishly drew an unsportsmanlike penalty on his touchdown catch high hopes aren t shot down in week 1 but dallas was reminded nothing s coming easy and these cowboys aren t riding into the sunset anytime soon if they don t execute to their potential harbaugh giants hold tight john harbaugh s time in baltimore came to a close after his 19th season with the campaign ending well short of expectations thanks to five one score losses and three blown fourth quarter leads in 2025 the first of those was a bitter 41 40 loss to the bills on sunday night to open the campaign last september the 2025 giants meanwhile blew an incredible five fourth quarter leads in a victory symbolic of exorcising the ghosts of blown leads past these giants held on when the cowboys cut the deficit to the final score big blue s second year qb found his most fitting target isaiah likely who converted a third and 9 with a 12 yard pick up likely converted another third down later on the drive before skattebo salted away the win with the final first down needed likely a longtime former raven had a game high eight catches for 78 yards and two scores in so many ways this is a great vibes win for new york as it aims to build a winner next gen stats insight for cowboys giants via nfl pro odell beckham playing his first game with the giants since dec 12 2018 played 11 snaps with seven routes run and no targets nfl research sunday night saw the giants defeat the cowboys for just the third time in the last 19 meetings it was the 12th week 1 meeting between the rivals and new york won for just the second time in such instances back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top
