news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 1: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 1 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 1 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below early window chicago bears 59 carolina panthers 37 cincinnati bengals 33 tampa bay buccaneers 27 detroit lions 31 new orleans saints 30 ot buffalo bills 36 houston texans 31 baltimore ravens 41 indianapolis colts 23 jacksonville jaguars 34 cleveland browns 10 pittsburgh steelers 20 atlanta falcons 13 new york jets 23 tennessee titans 10 late window arizona cardinals 26 los angeles chargers 14 las vegas raiders 27 miami dolphins 13 minnesota vikings 39 green bay packers 22 philadelphia eagles 24 washington commanders 22 sunday night new york giants 28 dallas cowboys 20 dan parr s takeaways bears offense enters a new orbit after jumping from the bottom of the league to sixth overall in total yards last season chicago s offense used week 1 to send the clearest message that it has an extra gear to hit in year 2 of the ben johnson era the bears dropped 59 points on carolina their most in a game since the 1980 season with a balanced and unrelenting attack caleb williams looked masterful for much of the game making highlight reel plays with his arm and legs he s the first player in franchise history to post 200 plus passing yards two or more passing touchdowns 50 plus rushing yards and two or more rushing scores in a single game per nfl research running backs d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai each reached the century mark in rushing yards on a day when the defense gave up 37 points chicago won by 22 points for so many years that kind of outcome was something bears fans could only dream about turnovers porous defense crush panthers hopes it was a disastrous day for the carolina defense which had received an infusion of talent this offseason thanks to the marquee free agent signings of devin lloyd and jaelan phillips the reigning nfc south champions were torched for 552 yards including 291 on the ground still if not for a muffed punt by jimmy horn and a fumble by tetairoa mcmillan maybe the team could have turned the tide on sunday scoring 37 points should be enough to win most of the time there was also a costly offside penalty on derrick brown which wiped out a bobby brown interception on a williams throw to the end zone the collection of errors became too much for dave canales team to overcome by the fourth quarter bryce young s 361 passing yards second most in his career weren t nearly enough loveland silenced in a somewhat shocking development given the bears offensive explosion their starting tight end colston loveland was held without a catch loveland the team s leading receiver last season was targeted just twice caleb williams threw behind an open loveland in the third quarter on a pass that fell incomplete one of the quarterback s few misses on the day it might go down as a blip on the radar when looking back in a few weeks if loveland rebounds but it was a tough day for fantasy managers who went all in on the second year te in their drafts next gen stats insight for bears panthers via nfl pro d andre swift rushed for 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries 6 9 yards per carry against the panthers the seventh year veteran recorded a 55 6 rushing success rate fourth highest of his career minimum 15 carries and forced seven missed tackles tied for his third most in a single game since entering the league nfl research with 96 points between the two teams sunday s bears panthers shootout was the highest scoring week 1 game in nfl history it beat the previous record of 88 combined points in 2018 bucs 48 saints 40 back to top nick shook s takeaways revamped bengals defense is for real cincinnati s offseason was defined by the moves its front office made to address its leaky defense capping an aggressive roster construction period by trading a first round pick for dexter lawrence those efforts paid off tremendously sunday the bengals forced four turnovers the second time they ve done so in week 1 in franchise history including a 27 yard return of a baker mayfield fumble for a demetrius knight touchdown and forced a mayfield fumble just short of the goal line that prevented a buccaneers touchdown and set up an 80 yard touchdown drive for the bengals in what ended up being a fairly high scoring game cincinnati s defense proved to be the difference limiting tampa bay s opportunities in the first half and enjoying contributions from a collection of familiar and new faces myles murphy barrett carter jonathan allen boye mafe at all three levels of the defense bengals defenders played with increased intensity and collectively produced results for which their fans have yearned for years an incredibly encouraging sign to start a season baker giveth baker taketh away just days after signing a three year extension that moved him into the 55 million per year club baker mayfield took the field with the same fire that has propelled him into the role of franchise quarterback in tampa bay that competitive inferno caused problems for the buccaneers on sunday mayfield s refusal to give up on plays contributed directly to two turnovers that led to two bengals touchdowns and his three total giveaways created an uphill battle which mayfield tried to push the buccaneers past but ultimately fell short it s part of the agreement when signing up for a season quarterbacked by mayfield he ll produce plenty of thrills never quit and often be the main reason the buccaneers are in contention but it always comes with risk on sunday that risk was just too much for the buccaneers to overcome cincinnati s offense successfully evolves the bengals typically explosive offense underwent a bit of a transformation in the offseason requiring joe burrow to take more snaps from under center in an attempt to become more multiple and thus less predictable it caused some growing pains during camp and inspired some minor concerns they might not be as productive as they were in previous years those worries can be put to bed for at least a week burrow looked perfectly comfortable operating in offensive coordinator dan pitcher s scheme found plenty of profit when targeting tight end mike gesicki enjoyed a quality day from running back chase brown and remembered he can always rely on tee higgins when he needs it most converting the game sealing first down on an 18 yard connection with higgins the traditionally slow starting bengals looked much better than they typically do in week 1 which is a big win for cincinnati next gen stats insight for buccaneers bengals via nfl pro baker mayfield s three lost fumbles decreased the buccaneers win probability by a combined 32 9 percentage points in sunday s loss to the bengals nfl research josiah trotter recorded one sack and one interception return touchdown in week 1 against the bengals trotter is the first player since at least 1982 to record a sack and pick six in his nfl debut he joined paul tripoli 1987 as one of only two tampa bay buccaneers players with a pick six in their nfl debut back to top kevin patra s takeaways lions survive epic collapse with ot win the lions took a 21 0 lead midway through the third quarter as tyler shough and the saints offense bungled things then detroit took its foot off the pedal allowing new orleans to control much of the rest of the contest and force overtime jahmyr gibbs motored the lions down the field and amon ra st brown capped off the opening drive of overtime with a score the saints matched the touchdown but fell short on the game winning two point attempt which fell incomplete it would have been a brutal loss for the lions after they built a three score lead as expected the offense ran through gibbs who took a career high 29 carries for 156 rushing yards and two tds he also added five catches for 30 yards the lions leaned on the run particularly early and it paid off late as gibbs gashed through holes particularly in ot expect the lions to lean on the rb until the passing attack catches up shough overcomes terrible start to give the saints a shot tyler shough looked like a second year quarterback who didn t take any preseason snaps early in the contest the qb was scattershot and jittery in the pocket missed reads and threw some shockingly awful passes his two second half turnovers allowed the lions to take a big lead on the ensuing drive after a fumble turned the game into a 21 0 deficit shough hit chris olave on a deep strike after escaping the pocket the pass settled down the passer he picked apart the lions secondary from there on shough led the saints on scoring drives on five of their final six possessions the early skittishness disappeared and he made some beautiful up and down throws stretching the field shough finished with 410 yards on 35 of 56 passing with three touchdowns and two interceptions took five sacks and lost a fumble if not for the wobbly early play from the qb the saints would have swiped a big time road upset to open the season kellen moore s club will be a tough out in 2026 lions secondary struggled in second half it was a given detroit could have some issues in the defensive backs group particularly early in the season the unit played solidly early but was taken advantage of as the game wore on defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard threw a trove of blitzes particularly from dbs at shough the pressures sped up the young qb early and led to the issues when the lions didn t have time to get home with new orleans throwing quick passes the secondary was exposed five of the saints six 20 plus yard completions came in the second half or overtime aidan hutchinson was his usual disruptive self generating two sacks four qb hits two tackles for loss and 10 qb pressures the lions also got solid play from linebacker derrick barnes who had a sack and an interception detroit got to 1 0 thanks to building its big lead but against more experienced passers the lions need to figure out how to protect the secondary to avoid bigger letdowns as the season progresses next gen stats insight for lions saints via nfl pro jared goff aligned under center on 47 snaps in week 1 against the saints tied for the most of his lions career from shotgun goff completed 17 of 22 passes for 134 yards and both of his touchdowns lions rushers carried the ball 30 times for 145 yards and two scores with goff under center nfl research jahmyr gibbs became the fifth player in nfl history with 50 plus touchdowns in their first 50 career games week 1 was gibbs 50th career game with two touchdowns in week 1 gibbs 51 career touchdowns only trail chuck foreman 55 jim brown 53 marcus allen 52 and larry johnson 52 on that list back to top bobby kownack s takeaways bills pull through in unexpected barnburner buffalo versus houston was expected to be one of the best matchups of week 1 that was certainly the case much less expected was the teams combining for 67 points in the end the bills did just enough on both ends to start the season with a win twice retaking the lead after houston was able to pull ahead in the fourth quarter their game winning drive was a seven play 96 yard march led by josh allen who hit dalton kincaid for a 35 yarder to flip the field and later josh palmer on a beautiful 34 yard strike for the go ahead score the drive was a microcosm of buffalo s day on offense as the bills still found resistance against houston s stellar d but was simply able to overcome it james cook nearly fumbled the game away on the drive s first play and allen threw a gimme to kamari lassiter one snap before buffalo s score that the cornerback couldn t corral despite racking up the most points houston has allowed since the 2023 season the bills still required a stop on defense as c j stroud began a potential statement drive with 1 36 remaining he did march the texans down to buffalo s 9 yard line but there the bills refused to break as deone walker sacked stroud on first and goal and gregory rousseau later clinched the win with a third down strip sack it was going to take a total team effort to beat a club of houston s quality and buffalo got one montgomery delivers back in workhorse role david montgomery came to houston for more opportunities and he saw plenty in his first game with the texans although he was inefficient on his carries 3 0 yards per attempt on 20 totes he exhibited a nose for the end zone scoring three of houston s four touchdowns he scored his first when the texans who notably struggled running in the red zone last year trusted him with three consecutive goal line carries his second an 18 yarder came as he cut into a huge hole opened by the texans offensive line and streaked untouched to the end zone montgomery also had three receptions for 19 yards including a 7 yard score he benefited the passing game beyond just his presence too the texans having a legitimate rushing game helped c j stroud 26 of 38 for 274 yards and two tds settle in and make some stellar throws it didn t result in a win sunday but the trade for montgomery looks like it will boost a texans offense that too often failed to hold up its end of the bargain in 2025 moore enjoys new digs it took a while for josh allen to target new acquisition dj moore but once he did the pair made the most of the new partnership moore collected his first look as a bill for an 18 yard catch with just under five minutes to play in the second quarter on the very next play he drew a 46 yard pass interference penalty that set up a 1 yard allen td plunge moore then made a brilliant catch on the following possession snagging the ball over a diving reed blankenship and keeping his feet in before streaking down the sideline for a 43 yard score though he was topped by dalton kincaid s 130 receiving yards which marked a career high for the tight end moore finished with a team leading eight targets five receptions 100 yards and the score his impact on buffalo s offense should silence those who thought he might be done after chicago or fail to carve out a role in a passing attack that loves to spread the ball around next gen stats insight for bills texans via nfl pro houston blitzed on only 18 8 of dropbacks allowing 287 passing yards two touchdowns and a 144 7 passer rating on plays without blitzing nfl research josh allen became the 12th player to reach 80 rushing touchdowns by his ninth season and the first quarterback in the nfl to have 80 career scores on the ground back to top bobby kownack s takeaways impressive ravens offense stalled by injuries baltimore s offense functioned seamlessly early on against the colts to put up 31 points before halftime the team s second most first half points to ever open a season the output was especially impressive considering lamar jackson and co were breaking in offensive coordinator declan doyle s new system jackson who struggled with injuries sapping his effectiveness throughout a trying 2025 season looked especially rejuvenated although he did lose a fumble jackson s signature elusiveness appeared to be back he rushed four times for 43 yards excluding three kneel downs and a score escaped sure sacks on several occasions and threw it tremendously too with 324 yards on 17 of 22 passing derrick henry continues to look ageless rumbling his way to 144 rushing yards and three touchdowns with a ferocity and the jackson zay flowers connection was unstoppable jackson enjoyed a perfect 158 3 passer rating on his six targets to flowers which went for five catches 150 yards and a touchdown unfortunately flowers left before halftime with a hamstring injury and rookie ja 39 kobi lane who was involved and caught a touchdown that was called back for offensive holding also got knocked out by a wrist injury the offense understandably looked different in the second half following those departures leaning on henry even more while adding just 10 more points while it was a tremendous play calling debut by doyle the injuries could loom large moving forward taylor was one of few bright spots for colts it was ugly for indianapolis which fell into a 28 6 hole after marching 65 yards for a touchdown to open the game outside of forcing a second quarter turnover to prevent baltimore from potentially putting together a third consecutive td drive and fortifying a bit after lamar jackson no longer had zay flowers to torment them with the colts were completely lost on defense they gave up 506 total net yards and were ineffective against the pass and the run perhaps the most important takeaway for indy long term is that daniel jones came away looking healthy but he never got much going jones finished 19 of 31 for 166 yards an early pick and a mostly meaningless late touchdown to tyler warren as has often been the case in recent years jonathan taylor proved to be the colts surest means of production he punched in two scores and collected 121 yards on 22 touches while averaging 5 2 yards per carry with five of his attempts going for 10 plus yards per next gen stats it s great knowing the colts can count on taylor but everyone else around him needs to raise their game minter gets a in first game as head coach it s hard to imagine a head coaching debut going much better than jesse minter s his ravens destroyed the colts even the lopsided 41 23 score made the result seem far closer than it was baltimore s defense the coach s specialty was unable to limit jonathan taylor but marlon humphrey did force and recover a fumble from the rb at a point when the game still felt somewhat in the balance roquan smith contributed 11 tackles and collected an interception after going without one for the first time in his career last year trey hendrickson also fit in spectacularly as he delivered a game high eight quarterback pressures and when things got a little hairy in the second half following an injury to zay flowers baltimore made the correct adjustments counting on derrick henry to help milk the game away this was minter s seventh week 1 as an nfl coach having spent four years on the ravens staff previously and the past two years as the chargers defensive coordinator his teams are now 7 0 in week 1 and his defenses have allowed 10 4 points per game in those contests per nfl research next gen stats insight for ravens colts via nfl pro the ravens defense posted a 58 6 pressure rate and two sacks when trey hendrickson was on the field nfl research zay flowers recorded a career high 150 receiving yards prior to leaving in the second quarter with a hamstring injury flowers has averaged 102 0 receiving yards per game in week 1 in his career the fourth most by a player in nfl history to have played multiple week 1 games michael irvin 106 8 tyreek hill 104 9 and antonio brown 103 3 back to top nick shook s takeaways jaguars pick up right where they left off one of the most entertaining storylines of the latter portion of the 2025 season existed in jacksonville where liam coen s offense hit its stride and became one of the most explosive units in football judging by how it performed sunday rust never had a chance of affecting this group trevor lawrence was dialed in from the start leading two touchdown drives that ended in much different but equally impressive lawrence touchdown passes jacksonville moved up and down the field with ease piling up 363 offensive yards and converting over 50 percent of its third downs at times it seemed as if lawrence was spending his sunday playing 7 on 7 bhayshul tuten got off to an encouraging start in his new role as lead back receiving 15 carries for 66 yards and parker washington five catches 83 yards one touchdown continued to be the most important player not named lawrence in jacksonville collectively it was business as usual in jacksonville which is just how the jaguars like it watson s first start goes even worse than expected deshaun watson s selection as browns starter defied logic and his performance sunday only made reality more frustrating for browns fans watson threw an ugly interception on his third pass attempt of the season routinely appeared overwhelmed by the speed of the game and a pass rush that eagerly feasted on his unusually long pass drops and frequently missed his targets even when free from pressure his only high quality throw of the game came in garbage time when he launched a deep ball to denzel boston for the rookie s first touchdown sure the browns didn t help themselves 11 accepted penalties for 75 yards but in any other scenario with any other team there would be no reason watson is playing these browns are a unique case though and they ll likely subject their fans to this misery again for at least one more week jacksonville s pass rush feasts when reviewing the jaguars entering the 2026 season it was fair to have some questions regarding their defense could josh hines allen and travon walker key a consistently effective pass rush might the secondary come together quickly especially with travis hunter back in the mix for one week the answer was a resounding yes jacksonville piled up five sacks hines allen and walker combined for three of them limited the browns to 1 of 8 on third down forced two turnovers and was inches from a third and held cleveland to 132 total yards through three quarters this is only one game and isn t a proper barometer for where the jaguars stand but for one sunday it was magically delicious next gen stats insight for browns jaguars via nfl pro trevor lawrence was pressured on just five pass attempts and completed two for 62 yards and two touchdowns posting a stellar passer rating of 126 7 under duress nfl research the jaguars have won nine consecutive games dating back to last season tied for the second longest win streak in franchise history their 24 point victory is the second largest margin of victory in a season opener back to top kevin patra s takeaways watt d carried steelers to victory with the steelers offense unable to cash in t j watt decided to do it himself the star pass rusher plucked a cooper rush pass and dashed to the end zone for the eventual game deciding touchdown the pittsburgh defensive line controlled most of the contest holding bijan robinson down early and bamboozling rush the stars shined for the steelers watt generated two sacks ditto for alex highsmith cameron heyward was playing volleyball swatting three passes pittsburgh held atlanta to 2 of 12 on third downs and 238 total yards it might not have been pretty but the steelers d showed it can keep the club stable until the offense gets clicking bijan can t do it alone the star running back generated 173 of the falcons 263 scrimmage yards 83 rushing yards on 21 carries 90 receiving yards on eight catches with a td cooper rush was thrust into a tough spot making the week 1 start after joining the club late in the process the issues were obvious rush was inconsistent missing targets and rarely threatening downfield ten of his 21 attempts came behind the line of scrimmage with very little passing threat the steelers defense was able to prioritize slowing the ground attack it was a testament to robinson s talent that he averaged 4 0 yards per carry until the falcons qb situation is sorted atlanta will struggle to put up points pittsburgh offense dk had a forgettable week 1 the positive a 42 year old aaron rodgers looked spry enough and comfortable in mike mccarthy s offense rodgers attempted to stretch the field more than last year but had little success doing so going 0 of 6 on passes of 20 plus air yards a few of those deep tosses should have connected but dk metcalf struggled to come down the ball repeatedly metcalf caught just four of 10 targets for 40 yards and was called for a couple of offensive pass interference penalties metcalf flubbed several potential big plays on beautiful throws from rodgers the run game was silenced averaging 2 8 yards per carry with neither jaylen warren nor rico dowdle able to find any consistency put in poor down and distance repeatedly the steelers generated just 15 first downs and 264 total yards while going 3 13 on third downs next gen stats insight for steelers falcons via nfl pro aaron rodgers 9 2 air yards per target against the falcons are the most he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw being the third highest average in a game as a steeler on passes under 10 air yards rodgers completed 20 of his 24 attempts 83 3 with 11 of these pass attempts being quick passes under 2 5 second ttt as he pushed the ball on downfield throws 10 plus air yards his passing efficiency dropped completing just four of 12 33 3 of his passes for 73 yards and one touchdown nfl research t j watt joined julius peppers as the only players with 100 plus sacks and 10 plus interceptions since sacks were first tracked in 1982 back to top jeremy bergman s takeaways jets start season at cruising altitude aaron glenn didn t earn his first win as head coach until week 8 of his first season in charge one game into 2026 his jets boast a winning record for the first time since week 3 of the 2024 campaign and deservedly so gang green was clicking all sides of the ball with a few exceptions geno smith played error free ball spreading the ball around to eight different receivers breece hall and braelon allen paced the offense with a plus rushing attack 142 yards on 32 carries new york dominated time of possession in part thanks to a second quarter near 12 minute drive glenn s defense much maligned in 2025 was stalwart allowing just 112 yards and six first downs through three quarters as the jets built a 20 3 lead qwan 39 tez stiggers and the jets special teams delivered some key stops and a takeaway on titans returns too new york hasn t looked this composed in all three phases in some time the jets lowly opponent notwithstanding they couldn t have asked for a better week 1 underwhelming start of saleh era in nashville donning fresh kits and a new outlook the titans looked on sunday like the same outfit that stumbled to a 3 14 campaign in 2025 robert saleh s defense was run through and put little pressure on new york s offensive line brian daboll s offense had no explosion the titans longest play was 14 yards and tennessee averaged just 4 0 yards per play cam ward was swamped by the jets pass rush getting pressured on 41 of his dropbacks and taking three sacks nissan stadium emptied out early partially due to a stifling tennessee heat but mostly due to the titans poor play leaving remaining local fans to boo and scream fire saleh audibly enough to be picked up by cbs boom mics and a sizable jets contingent to break out their notorious j e t s chants for saleh a former jets coach the result was the last thing he could have wanted with so much new in nashville an adjustment period is to be expected but the new look titans still look like a team at least a year away from contending gang green rookies don t look green the jets used their three first round picks to load up on talent with pass rusher david bailey tight end kenyon sadiq and wide receiver omar cooper all three made their presences felt on sunday if only briefly cooper delivered a yac happy 30 yard catch and run on new york s opening scoring drive that march ended with a nifty end around touchdown run for sadiq an athletic tight end with the motor to beat linebackers to the edge in the process sadiq joined hall of famer ozzie newsome 1978 as the only tes in nfl history with a rushing td in their first career game bailey got home in the third quarter logging his first nfl sack with help from the boundary and was a constant force in the backfield the no 2 pick logged a game high six qb pressures the one drawback cooper was forced from the game in the first half with an ankle injury and did not return but for bailey and sadiq the latter of whom was held out of most of training camp with an injury the opener was an unquestioned success and hopefully for new york a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for jets titans via nfl pro the jets ran from under center on 69 4 of called runs their highest rate under aaron glenn totaling 25 of their 36 called runs for 115 yards and two rushing touchdowns breece hall led with 17 under center rushing attempts for 85 yards and a touchdown including three explosive runs 10 yards tied for a career high nfl research the jets outgained tennessee by 172 total yards their largest total yards margin in week 1 since 2014 the last time geno smith was new york s week 1 starter back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways cards capitalize on chargers fourth quarter miscues mike lafleur s bunch was sunday s biggest surprise snapping a nine game losing streak carried over from the 2025 season the cardinals had a fourth quarter for the books one that included a blocked punt and two huge defensive stands the dam began to break for the chargers early in the fourth trailing 16 14 when cardinal
